item.title: 该论文发现，在权重冻结的国际象棋Transformer中提高条件化技能水平，会单调地将计算迁移到更深的注意力层，使深层注意力头被招募执行更专门化的计算，且这种深度迁移在骑士双叉等特定战术上尤为显著。
item.description:
提高技能水平会在冻结的国际象棋Transformer中招募更深的注意力层

Increasing Skill Level Recruits Deeper Attention Layers in a Frozen Chess Transformer

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23917

该论文发现，在权重冻结的国际象棋Transformer中提高条件化技能水平，会单调地将计算迁移到更深的注意力层，使深层注意力头被招募执行更专门化的计算，且这种深度迁移在骑士双叉等特定战术上尤为显著。

国际象棋在确定性环境中涉及复杂的推理，这使其成为研究Transformer内部计算机制的有用场景。Maia-3国际象棋Transformer将Elo（衡量竞技国际象棋水平的指标）作为预训练网络的输入，因此我们可以在不改变网络权重的情况下调节网络所条件化的技能水平。在此，我们研究了调节这个技能旋钮如何影响自注意力机制。通过在700到2500的每个Elo级别上消融每一个注意力头，我们发现：1）提高技能水平会使计算中的因果质心向更深层单调推移，这在我们测量的每一种棋子和走法类型上都成立；2）对于特定战术，尤其是骑士双叉（knight forks），这种深度迁移远大于其他走法类型；3）这种迁移的机制是更深的注意力头被招募来执行更专门化的计算，同时一个共享的浅层注意力头保持大致恒定的贡献。这些结果可能有助于揭示……

arXiv:2609.23917v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Chess involves complex reasoning in a deterministic environment, which makes it a useful setting for studying the mechanisms of computation inside transformers. The Maia-3 chess transformer takes Elo, a measure of competitive chess skill, as an input to the pre-trained network, so we can vary the skill the network is conditioned on with no change to its weights. Here we investigate how turning this skill dial affects self-attention. Ablating every attention head at every Elo from 700 to 2500, we find 1) increasing skill pushes the causal center of mass of the computation deeper, monotonically, for every chess piece and move type we measured; 2) the depth migration is much greater for specific tactics, especially knight forks, than for other move types; 3) the migration consists of deeper heads getting recruited for more specialized computations while one shared shallow head keeps a roughly constant contribution. 本文提出一种端到端框架，通过改进的KPConv语义分割和两阶段拓扑推断（电杆实例聚类验证与基于轻量级ResNet分类器的档距判别），从大规模航空激光雷达点云中重建架空电力网络拓扑并提取档距级物理元数据。

本文提出了一个端到端框架，用于从大规模航空激光雷达（LiDAR）数据中重建架空电力网络的拓扑结构并提取档距级的物理元数据。该流程首先使用改进的基于KPConv的模型对输入点云进行语义分割，其中对数据采样和损失函数进行了调整，以突出电杆和导线（电线）类别。随后，网络拓扑推断分两个阶段进行：(i) 通过对电杆类别的点进行聚类，并利用几何准则（包括通过PCA估计的高度和垂直度）验证候选对象，从而获得电杆实例；(ii) 利用启发式方法和基于轻量级ResNet的分类器，对电杆和导线点分布的2D俯视投影进行评估，以判断候选电杆对之间是否存在物理导线档距。通过显式地对候选档距进行分类，该方法缓解了启发式连接方法的常见失效模式。

item.title: 该论文提出了一种基于共享时空模式词表的离散生成模型，通过残差向量量化自编码器和分解式掩码变换器，解决了高密度微电极阵列中神经元尖峰数据稀疏且电极子集在不同实验间变化的问题，并在人类脑类器官和离体海马组织数据上验证了其有效性。
item.description:
微电极阵列上神经元尖峰活动的离散生成模型

A discrete generative model of neuronal spiking activity on microelectrode arrays

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23907

该论文提出了一种基于共享时空模式词表的离散生成模型，通过残差向量量化自编码器和分解式掩码变换器，解决了高密度微电极阵列中神经元尖峰数据稀疏且电极子集在不同实验间变化的问题，并在人类脑类器官和离体海马组织数据上验证了其有效性。

神经活动的生成模型可以帮助表征组织动力学、比较实验条件以及模拟群体活动，其应用范围涵盖疾病与药物反应研究到闭环实验。然而，现有方法通常假设一组固定的已分选神经元，而高密度微电极阵列产生的是极其稀疏的、覆盖整个阵列的二值尖峰体数据，其中观测到的电极子集在不同实验之间各不相同。我们提出了一种离散生成模型，利用共享的时空模式词表来表示这种活动。残差向量量化自编码器学习模式词表，而分解式掩码变换器预测活动发生的位置以及每个活跃位置上出现的模式。我们在涵盖人类脑类器官和急性离体人类海马组织的31个实验上对该模型进行了评估。学习到的模式被广泛复用：一个……

arXiv:2609.23907v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative models of neural activity could help characterize tissue dynamics, compare experimental conditions, and simulate population activity for applications ranging from disease and drug-response studies to closed-loop experimentation. Existing approaches, however, typically assume a fixed set of sorted neurons, whereas high-density microelectrode arrays produce extremely sparse, array-wide binary spike volumes in which the observed subset of electrodes varies across assays. We introduce a discrete generative model that represents this activity using a shared vocabulary of spatiotemporal motifs. A residual vector-quantized autoencoder learns the motif vocabulary, while a factorized masked transformer predicts where activity occurs and which motif appears at each active location. item.title: 本文提出了一种基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）集成的新算法，用于预测随机系统中向量值目标的条件联合分布，并引入了一种新的差异度量方法。

基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络的多变量分位数回归

Multivariate quantile regression via Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks

本文提出了一种基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）集成的新算法，用于预测随机系统中向量值目标的条件联合分布，并引入了一种新的差异度量方法。

本文提出了一种新颖的算法，用于预测随机系统中向量值目标的条件联合分布，其中随机性是系统内在的，而非源于观测误差或加性噪声。多变量分位数回归同样涉及条件联合分布的建模，但代表着一个难度较低的任务：它预测向量值目标落入预定义区域的概率，识别对应于预定义概率水平的区域，或同时执行这两项任务。所提出的识别技术采用Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）集成作为灵活的函数逼近器。尽管所建议的技术在理论上并不局限于KAN，但KAN特别适合所提出的构造，因此在本研究中被广泛使用。除了训练过程之外，本工作还引入了一种新的差异度量方法，用于……（摘要原文在此处被截断）

It predicts the probability that vector-valued targets fall within predefined regions, identifies regions corresponding to predefined probability levels, or performs both tasks simultaneously. The proposed identification technique employs ensembles of Kolmogorov--Arnold networks (KANs) as flexible function approximators. Although the suggested technique is not theoretically restricted to KANs, KANs are particularly well suited to the proposed construction and are therefore used throughout this study. item.title: 提出了GDN Tree-Scan——一个集成到vLLM的面向Gated-DeltaNet循环-混合语言模型的树式投机解码验证器，通过在树验证中正确重建各分支路径上的循环状态，在Qwen3.6-27B-FP8上将每次事件提交的token数提升17.2%，且验证开销接近原生。
item.description:
GDN Tree-Scan：面向循环-混合语言模型的服务化树式验证

GDN Tree-Scan: Served Tree Verification for Recurrent-Hybrid Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23900

提出了GDN Tree-Scan——一个集成到vLLM的面向Gated-DeltaNet循环-混合语言模型的树式投机解码验证器，通过在树验证中正确重建各分支路径上的循环状态，在Qwen3.6-27B-FP8上将每次事件提交的token数提升17.2%，且验证开销接近原生。

树式投机解码可在一次目标模型前向传播中验证多个候选续写序列。对于仅含注意力的Transformer，验证器主要只需一个祖先关系掩码。而循环-混合语言模型打破了这一假设：每个候选行还必须携带原生顺序解码沿其从根到节点路径所产生的循环状态。否则，验证器即使使用了正确的注意力掩码，仍可能基于不可能出现的循环历史进行条件计算。我们提出了GDN Tree-Scan，一个集成到vLLM中的、面向Gated-DeltaNet混合语言模型的服务化验证器。该系统结合了FlashAttention-2树偏置注意力、分支局部的GDN扫描/重放、设备端多草稿提交，以及仅发布被接受链的状态。在公开的Qwen3.6-27B-FP8检查点上，在温度0.6的干净批大小为1（B=1）的SWE/Codex解码门控测试中，六节点的根分支树使每次事件提交的token数提升了17.2%，同时验证开销接近原生水平。

arXiv:2609.23900v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tree speculative decoding verifies multiple candidate continuations in one target forward pass. For attention-only transformers, the verifier mainly needs an ancestry mask. Recurrent-hybrid language models break this assumption: a candidate row must also carry the recurrent state that native sequential decode would have produced along its root-to-node path. Otherwise, a verifier can use a correct attention mask while still conditioning on an impossible recurrent history. We present GDN Tree-Scan, a served verifier for Gated-DeltaNet hybrid language models integrated into vLLM. The system combines FlashAttention-2 tree-bias attention, branch-local GDN scan/replay, device-side multidraft commitment, and accepted-chain-only state publication. On the public Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 checkpoint, in a clean batch-one (B=1) SWE/Codex decode gate at temperature 0.6, a six-node root-branch tree increases committed tokens/event by 17.2% at near-native ver

item.title: 提出Circuit-Diff方法，通过对模型施加低秩事实编辑并检测归因图中特征角色的变化，自动定位与被编辑知识相关的电路节点，从而免去人工解读归因图的繁琐过程。
item.description:
Circuit-Diff：一种基于事实编辑的干预方法，用于在归因图中定位知识

Circuit-Diff: Factual Edit-based Intervention Method for Localizing Knowledge in Attribution Graphs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23892

提出Circuit-Diff方法，通过对模型施加低秩事实编辑并检测归因图中特征角色的变化，自动定位与被编辑知识相关的电路节点，从而免去人工解读归因图的繁琐过程。

机制可解释性将特征定义为神经网络的基本单元，将电路定义为执行其计算的加权子图。由于单个神经元具有多义性，跨层转码器被引入作为一种通过生成归因图来近似模型电路的方法。然而，该图的节点是未标注的特征：阅读一张归因图意味着先对其进行剪枝，然后手动弄清楚每个保留节点的含义。为了让CLT更易于用于电路发现，我们提出了Circuit-Diff，该方法通过对模型本身施加低秩事实编辑来进行干预，并将在该编辑下其在归因图中角色发生变化的特征视为与被编辑知识相关的特征。在我们所检验的编辑中，被标记的节点不仅仅是对象词元的检测器：从CLT发布的特征仪表板中读取，它们包含了与历史、地理以及关联相关的特征……

arXiv:2609.23892v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability defines features as the fundamental units of a neural network and circuits as the weighted subgraphs that carry out its computation. Because individual neurons are polysemantic, Cross-Layer Transcoders (CLTs) were introduced as a way to approximate a model's circuits by generating an attribution graph. The nodes of that graph, however, are unlabeled features: reading a graph means pruning it and then working out by hand what each surviving node means. To make CLTs easier to use for circuit discovery, we introduce Circuit-Diff, which intervenes on the model itself with a low-rank factual edit and takes the features whose role in the attribution graph changes under that edit as related to the edited knowledge. item.title: 发布首个专家级吸脂手术数据集HumynexSurg-1，通过同步采集吸引压力、六轴力/力矩、RGB-D视频等多模态传感数据及语音讲解标注，填补了机器人基础模型训练语料中美容手术数据的空白。
item.description:
HumynexSurg-1：一个精心策划的专家级吸脂手术数据集

HumynexSurg-1: A Curated Expert Liposuction Dataset

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23885

发布首个专家级吸脂手术数据集HumynexSurg-1，通过同步采集吸引压力、六轴力/力矩、RGB-D视频等多模态传感数据及语音讲解标注，填补了机器人基础模型训练语料中美容手术数据的空白。

机器人基础模型从大型演示语料库中学习操作技能，但这些语料库中缺少手术数据：在整个780小时的Open-H手术数据集中，只有一个数据集包含同步的力数据，且没有一个涵盖美容手术。吸脂术是其中的难点案例，因为器械在皮肤下操作，外科医生依靠触觉和判断进行手术。Humynex Robotics正是为此类手术构建精心策划的专家数据集。HumynexSurg-1是首个发布版本：一位资深吸脂外科医生在猪腹部组织上进行手术，同时对每个决策进行语音讲解，记录内容包括同步的吸引压力、六轴手部力/力矩、俯视RGB-D视频、侧面视频和领夹式麦克风录音——共14个片段、42,738帧、35.6分钟、356条语音讲解，其中95%可编译为吸脂专用标签模式。数据采集遵循一项正在申请专利的传感方案，该方案围绕策略所需的物理量进行组织，因此一个通道

arXiv:2609.23885v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Robot foundation models learn manipulation from large demonstration corpora, but surgery is missing from those corpora: across the 780-hour Open-H surgical collection, one dataset carries synchronized force and none covers an aesthetic procedure. Liposuction is the hard case, because the instrument works under the skin and the surgeon operates by feel and by judgment. Humynex Robotics builds curated expert datasets for this kind of procedure. HumynexSurg-1 is the first release: a master liposuction surgeon performing on porcine abdominal tissue while narrating every decision, recorded with synchronized suction pressure, six-axis hand force/torque, top-down RGB-D video, side video and a lavalier microphone -- 14 episodes, 42,738 frames, 35.6 minutes, 356 utterances of which 95% compile into a liposuction-specific label schema. The capture follows a patent-pending sensing plan organized around the quantities a policy needs, so a channel

item.title: 该论文提出了一种将人类分析师纳入决策回路的协同流式异常检测系统，通过集成共识聚合、代理模型解释和人机交互调整，实现了高速数据流中稳健且可解释的异常检测。
item.description:
基于交互式解释与集成共识的协同流式异常检测

Collaborative Streaming Anomaly Detection with Interactive Explanations and Ensemble Consensus

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23883

该论文提出了一种将人类分析师纳入决策回路的协同流式异常检测系统，通过集成共识聚合、代理模型解释和人机交互调整，实现了高速数据流中稳健且可解释的异常检测。

我们提出了一种面向高速数据流的协同流式异常检测系统，该系统明确地将人类分析师纳入决策回路。该系统结合了异构检测器，并通过基于归一化的加权共识来聚合它们的输出，同时辅以工件感知规则以在部署过程中稳定异常评分。为了提高可解释性，该系统推导出代理模型来近似集成共识，并揭示与异常行为相关的人类可读的传感器条件。分析师可以通过审查异常事件、调整共识行为以及优化用于异常预测的代理规则来主动干预，从而产生一个由人类调整的集成系统。我们在一个包含26万个事件和3个异常事件的工业数据流上评估了该方法，展示了稳健的检测能力和可操作的人机交互。

arXiv:2609.23883v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a collaborative streaming anomaly detection system for high-speed data streams that explicitly integrates human analysts into the decision loop. The system combines heterogeneous detectors and aggregates their outputs through a normalization-based weighted consensus, complemented by artifact-aware rules to stabilize anomaly scoring under deployment. To improve interpretability, it derives surrogate models that approximate the ensemble consensus and expose human-readable sensor conditions associated with anomalous behavior. Analysts can actively intervene by reviewing anomaly episodes, adjusting consensus behavior, and refining surrogate rules used for anomaly prediction, producing a human-adjusted ensemble. We evaluate the approach on an industrial stream with 260\,000 events and 3 anomalous episodes, showing robust detection and actionable human-AI interaction.

item.title: 提出基于图的全局-局部重建框架GLR-MM，通过互补的局部跨模态与全局图注意力分支重建缺失模态嵌入，在50%模态缺失的ICU早期死亡率预测中取得更高的AUROC和AUPRC。
item.description:
GLR-MM：基于图的全局-局部重建方法，用于模态缺失下鲁棒的多模态胸部X光与电子健康记录表示学习

GLR-MM: Graph-Based Global-Local Reconstruction for Robust Multimodal Chest X-ray and EHR Representation Learning under Missing Modalities

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23876

提出基于图的全局-局部重建框架GLR-MM，通过互补的局部跨模态与全局图注意力分支重建缺失模态嵌入，在50%模态缺失的ICU早期死亡率预测中取得更高的AUROC和AUPRC。

临床多模态模型常常需要在所有胸部X光（CXR）和电子健康记录（EHR）输入都可用之前就进行预测。现有方法对齐已观测的表示、建模缺失情况或进行跨模态重建，但未能联合利用患者内部以及临床相似患者之间的证据。我们提出了GLR-MM，一个用于ICU早期死亡率预测的基于图的全局-局部重建框架。该框架将五种CXR-EHR模态映射到共享空间，通过互补的局部跨模态分支和全局图注意力分支重建缺失的嵌入表示，自适应地融合两者的估计结果，并优化类别平衡的预测、重建和对比学习目标。在9,620例源自MIMIC的ICU住院记录上，我们使用共享的确定性掩码评估了10%、30%和50%的随机模态缺失情况。结果表明，在轻度和中度缺失下MUSE表现更好，而在50%缺失时，GLR-MM通过……取得了更高的AUROC和AUPRC。

arXiv:2609.23876v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Clinical multimodal models must often predict before all chest X-ray (CXR) and electronic health record (EHR) inputs are available. Existing approaches align observed representations, model missingness, or reconstruct across modalities, but do not jointly exploit within-patient and clinically similar inter-patient evidence. We propose GLR-MM, a Graph-Based Global-Local Reconstruction framework for early ICU mortality prediction. It maps five CXR-EHR modalities to a shared space, reconstructs missing embeddings through complementary local cross-modal and global graph-attention branches, adaptively fuses their estimates, and optimizes class-balanced prediction, reconstruction, and contrastive objectives. On 9,620 MIMIC-derived ICU stays, we evaluate 10%, 30%, and 50% random modality missingness with shared deterministic masks. MUSE performs better under mild and moderate missingness, whereas GLR-MM achieves higher AUROC and AUPRC at 50% by

item.title: 提出了VISTA，一种基于注意力的可扩展多智能体强化学习架构，通过实体中心注意力、循环记忆和指针式动作解码，实现对可变规模目标目录和分布式传感网络的不确定性驱动持续编目维护。
item.description:
VISTA：一种用于空间态势感知传感器任务分配的基于注意力的多智能体强化学习架构

VISTA: An Attention-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Architecture for Space Situational Awareness Sensor Tasking

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23875

提出了VISTA，一种基于注意力的可扩展多智能体强化学习架构，通过实体中心注意力、循环记忆和指针式动作解码，实现对可变规模目标目录和分布式传感网络的不确定性驱动持续编目维护。

空间驻留物体的快速增长正在增加空间态势感知传感器任务分配的复杂性，随着需要在日益庞大的目标目录中分配有限的、异构的、分布式的感知资源，经典优化方法面临严峻挑战。现有的深度强化学习方法在简化场景中展现出前景，但固定维度的状态和动作表示限制了其扩展到大型动态目录和分布式传感网络的能力。我们提出了VISTA（可变实体智能传感器任务分配架构），这是一种可扩展的深度强化学习架构，用于在可变目标数量和传感器配置下进行持续的、不确定性驱动的目录维护。VISTA将基于物理和任务信息的top-K检索与以实体为中心的注意力机制、循环记忆以及基于指针的动作解码相结合，从而使每个智能体的观测空间和动作空间保持与目录规模无关。

arXiv:2609.23875v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid growth of resident space objects is increasing the complexity of space situational awareness sensor tasking, challenging classical optimization methods as they allocate finite, heterogeneous, and distributed sensing resources across ever-larger catalogues. Existing deep reinforcement learning approaches show promise in reduced settings, but fixed-dimensional state and action representations limit their ability to scale to large, dynamic catalogues and distributed sensing networks. We introduce VISTA (Variable-Entity Intelligent Sensor Tasking Architecture), a scalable deep reinforcement learning architecture for persistent uncertainty-driven catalogue maintenance across variable object populations and sensor configurations. VISTA combines physics- and mission-informed top-K retrieval with entity-centric attention, recurrent memory, and pointer-based action decoding, thereby keeping each agent's observation and action spaces ind

item.title: 本文针对间歇连接去中心化学习中的对等节点选择问题，建立了考虑证据因链路过期和模型漂移而衰减的最优停止理论，证明接收方存在由保留值（Snell包络）刻画的最优停止策略，并给出漂移感知的集中不等式与极大极小认证规则。
item.description:
PROSE：间歇连接去中心化学习中基于易逝证据的对等节点选择最优停止理论

PROSE: A Theory of Optimal Stopping with Perishable Evidence for Peer Selection in Intermittently Connected Decentralised Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23845

本文针对间歇连接去中心化学习中的对等节点选择问题，建立了考虑证据因链路过期和模型漂移而衰减的最优停止理论，证明接收方存在由保留值（Snell包络）刻画的最优停止策略，并给出漂移感知的集中不等式与极大极小认证规则。

去中心化联邦学习移除了聚合服务器，但使得协作依赖于对等节点的瞬时可用性。在移动和间歇连接的系统中，评估一个有潜力的对等节点会消耗接触时间，甚至可能导致交换机会本身消失，因此学习者收集的关于对等节点的证据是易逝的：由于链路过期，以及旧测量数据老化期间对等节点模型发生漂移，证据会不断衰减。本文为由此产生的对等节点选择问题建立了一套自洽的最优停止理论。我们将接收方在接触期间的决策形式化为一个具有昂贵信息获取和未来到达外部选项的有限时域马尔可夫最优停止问题，并证明该问题存在一个由保留值（Snell包络结构）刻画的最优策略。围绕这一形式化，我们证明了：(i) 阶段一致、漂移感知的集中不等式以及一个极大极小认证规则……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.23845v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Decentralised federated learning removes the aggregation server but makes collaboration dependent on transient peer availability. In mobile and intermittently connected systems, evaluating a promising peer consumes contact time and may cause the exchange opportunity itself to vanish, so that the evidence a learner gathers about a peer is perishable: it decays because links expire and because peer models drift while old measurements age. This paper develops a self-contained theory of optimal stopping for the resulting peer-selection problem. We formalise a receiver's within-contact decision as a finite-horizon Markov optimal-stopping problem with costly information acquisition and a future-arrival outside option, and prove that it admits an optimal policy characterised by a reservation value (Snell-envelope structure). Around this formulation we prove: (i) stage-uniform, drift-aware concentration and a maximin certification rule that is c

item.title: 该论文提出利用行列式点过程（DPP）建模客户端多样性，设计了联邦学习中的自适应行列式客户端调度方法（ADCS），通过梯度信息与质量分数构建核矩阵实现质量与多样性的灵活权衡，并给出了收敛性保证。
item.description:
联邦学习中的自适应行列式客户端调度

Adaptive Determinantal Client Scheduling in Federated Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23843

该论文提出利用行列式点过程（DPP）建模客户端多样性，设计了联邦学习中的自适应行列式客户端调度方法（ADCS），通过梯度信息与质量分数构建核矩阵实现质量与多样性的灵活权衡，并给出了收敛性保证。

在联邦学习中，由于数据异构性和系统异构性的存在，为模型训练调度客户端至关重要。以往的大多数工作关注被调度客户端的质量，以实现更快的收敛速度、更短的墙钟收敛时间或更好的平均模型性能，却很少考虑客户端的多样性，而多样性对于对抗异构性、改善最不利客户端的性能十分重要。在本工作中，我们提倡使用行列式点过程（DPP）来建模并增强客户端调度中的多样性。我们首先利用梯度信息和质量分数设计DPP的核矩阵，从而天然地支持灵活的质量-多样性权衡。通过对DPP应用快速MAP（最大后验）推断，我们提出了联邦学习中的自适应行列式客户端调度方法（ADCS）。我们进一步量化了ADCS的梯度近似误差，并针对一般性的带偏客户端选择建立了收敛性分析。

arXiv:2609.23843v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scheduling clients for model training is critical in federated learning due to both data and system heterogeneity. Most previous works focus on the quality of the scheduled clients to achieve faster convergence, shorter wall-clock convergence time, or better average model performance. They rarely consider the diversity of clients, which is important to counter heterogeneity and improve performance for the worst-off clients. In this work, we advocate the use of determinantal point processes (DPPs) to model and enhance the diversity in client scheduling. We first design the kernel matrices of DPPs using gradient information and quality scores, which inherently enables a flexible quality-diversity trade-off. Applying fast MAP inference over DPPs, we propose Adaptive Determinantal Client Scheduling (ADCS) in FL. We further quantify the gradient approximation error of ADCS and develop convergence analysis for general biased client selection i

item.title: 本文通过区域特定模型、多区域模型和留一区域实验，评估了大气传输模拟器在南美洲、东亚、南亚和北非四个区域间的空间可迁移性，为将高速模拟器从区域扩展到全球应用提供了依据。
item.description:
从区域到全球：大气传输模拟器的迁移学习

From Regional to Global: Transfer Learning for Atmospheric Transport Emulators

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23838

本文通过区域特定模型、多区域模型和留一区域实验，评估了大气传输模拟器在南美洲、东亚、南亚和北非四个区域间的空间可迁移性，为将高速模拟器从区域扩展到全球应用提供了依据。

温室气体排放估算可以通过反演方法获得，即将大气浓度观测数据与化学传输模型相结合。后者传统上使用物理驱动的模拟器，如拉格朗日粒子扩散模型（LPDM），这类模型运行成本高昂，且难以很好地扩展到现代卫星的高分辨率数据。此前，我们开发了一个高性能的大气传输模拟器，能够以比英国气象局LPDM快约1,000倍的速度近似其输出（“足迹”）。然而，向全球模拟扩展并非易事，因为大气传输具有区域异质性。本文通过区域特定模型、多区域模型以及留一区域实验，评估了模型在四个世界区域（南美洲、东亚、南亚、北非）之间的空间可迁移性，并在输入变量的背景下对区域差异进行了表征。

arXiv:2609.23838v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Greenhouse gas emissions estimates can be derived using inverse methods by combining atmospheric concentration observations with chemical transport models. The latter traditionally use physics-driven simulators such as Lagrangian Particle Dispersion Models (LPDMs), which are expensive to run and do not scale well to modern satellites' high resolution data. Previously we developed a performant atmospheric transport emulator that approximates LPDM outputs ("footprints") over South America ~1,000X faster than the UK Met Office's LPDM. Expanding towards global emulation is not straightforward, as atmospheric transport is regionally heterogeneous. This paper evaluates spatial transferability capabilities of models across four world regions: South America, East Asia, South Asia, North Africa using both region-specific and multi-region models, and leave-one-region-out experiments. Regional differences are characterised in the context of input v

item.title: 该论文证明了确定性算法求解非光滑非凸优化的Goldstein驻点需要 $(1/\epsilon)^{\Omega(d)}$ 的指数级复杂度，否定了多项式复杂度确定性算法的存在，并由此解决了Jordan等人提出的公开问题。
item.description:
非光滑非凸优化中确定性的指数代价

The Exponential Price of Determinism in Nonsmooth Nonconvex Optimization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23837

该论文证明了确定性算法求解非光滑非凸优化的Goldstein驻点需要 $(1/\epsilon)^{\Omega(d)}$ 的指数级复杂度，否定了多项式复杂度确定性算法的存在，并由此解决了Jordan等人提出的公开问题。

我们研究了寻找非光滑非凸Lipschitz函数的 $(\delta,\epsilon)$-Goldstein驻点的复杂度。目前已知，随机一阶算法能够以与维度无关的oracle复杂度解决该任务 [Zhang et al., 2020]，而确定性算法则无法做到，因为其复杂度必须至少随维度 $d$ 线性增长 [Jordan et al., 2023, Tian and So, 2024]。这留下了一个悬而未决的问题：确定性算法是否仍能以关于 $d$ 的多项式oracle复杂度解决该问题。我们通过证明确定性算法存在量级为 $(1/\epsilon)^{\Omega(d)}$ 的下界，对这一问题给出了否定回答，从而填补了此前已知的下界与上界之间的指数级差距，并解决了 Jordan et al. [2023] 提出的一个公开问题。我们进一步讨论了该结果对更弱驻点概念、寻找下降方向等方面的若干扩展与影响。

arXiv:2609.23837v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the complexity of finding $(\delta,\epsilon)$-Goldstein stationary points of nonsmooth nonconvex Lipschitz functions. By now, it is known that randomized first-order algorithms can solve this task with a dimension-free oracle complexity [Zhang et al., 2020], whereas deterministic algorithms cannot, as their complexity must scale at least linearly with the dimension $d$ [Jordan et al., 2023, Tian and So, 2024]. This leaves open whether deterministic algorithms can nevertheless solve the problem with oracle complexity polynomial in $d$. We answer this question negatively by proving a lower bound of order $(1/\epsilon)^{\Omega(d)}$ for deterministic algorithm, closing the exponential gap between the previously known lower and upper bounds and resolving an open problem posed by Jordan et al. item.title: 本文利用美国某公立学区引入开放式注册初中高级课程这一政策变革前后的新颖观测数据，研究学生选修高级课程对学业结果的因果效应，并应对学生自选择带来的识别难题。
item.description:
从观测数据中获得可行动的洞察：K-12教育中高级课程的案例

Actionable Insights from Observational Data: The Case of Advanced Classes in K-12 Education

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23836

本文利用美国某公立学区引入开放式注册初中高级课程这一政策变革前后的新颖观测数据，研究学生选修高级课程对学业结果的因果效应，并应对学生自选择带来的识别难题。

K-12教育中一个根本性的难题是：修读更多高级或更具挑战性的课程会产生何种效果。这个问题尤为复杂，因为学生（和/或其家长）自行决定是否选修这些课程，使得因果分析充满挑战。在本文中，我们利用来自美国一个公立学校系统的新颖数据集开始着手解决这一问题。该数据集记录了在一个学区范围内按学科引入可选的开放式注册初中高级课程这一变革前后，学生的课程选修决策、过往学业记录、人口统计特征以及随后的结果。这是一个丰富的观测数据集，但高级课程的选修是由学生特征和选择所驱动，而非随机分配。这带来了一个核心的识别挑战：影响高级课程选修的相同因素同样能够预测学业结果……

arXiv:2609.23836v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A fundamentally challenging question in K-12 education is about the effects of taking more advanced or challenging classes. It is particularly complex because students (and/or their parents) choose whether to enroll in these classes, making causal analysis challenging. In this paper, we begin to tackle this question by taking advantage of a novel dataset from a public school system in the US. This dataset records students' course enrollment decisions, prior academic histories, demographics, and subsequent outcomes around the time of a district-wide change that introduced optional open-enrollment advanced middle-school courses in subject areas. This is a rich observational dataset, but enrollment in advanced classes is driven by student characteristics and choices rather than random assignment. This creates a core identification challenge: the same factors that influence enrollment in advanced courses are also predictive of academic outco

item.title: 本文提出物理条件神经算子（PCNO），一种基于Transformer的代理模型，能以收缩压和组织特性为条件，实时预测二尖瓣和三尖瓣的瓣叶位移、应变和应力场，相比精细网格有限元模拟实现高达15,260倍的加速，为心脏瓣膜疾病的临床快速评估与早期精准干预提供了新工具。
item.description:
基于物理条件神经算子的实时可泛化心脏瓣膜力学用于临床疾病评估

Real-time Generalizable Heart Valve Mechanics for Clinical Disease Assessment via a Physics-Conditioned Neural Operator

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23826

本文提出物理条件神经算子（PCNO），一种基于Transformer的代理模型，能以收缩压和组织特性为条件，实时预测二尖瓣和三尖瓣的瓣叶位移、应变和应力场，相比精细网格有限元模拟实现高达15,260倍的加速，为心脏瓣膜疾病的临床快速评估与早期精准干预提供了新工具。

二尖瓣反流是全球最常见的心脏瓣膜疾病，影响全球超过2%的人口，在75岁以上成年人中这一比例上升至至少10%，并导致约15%的瓣膜性心脏病相关死亡。然而，只有少数重度患者接受矫正手术。对瓣膜力学的快速评估可以实现更早、更精确的干预，但传统有限元模拟对于临床时间尺度和参数扫描而言仍然太慢。我们提出了物理条件神经算子，这是一种基于Transformer的代理模型，能够预测二尖瓣和三尖瓣几何形状上的瓣叶位移、应变和应力场，并以收缩压和组织特性作为条件输入。PCNO在功能性、反流性和病理瓣膜（包括腱索牵拉、P2脱垂和瓣环扩张）数据上训练，相比精细网格有限元模拟实现了高达15,260倍的加速。

arXiv:2609.23826v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mitral regurgitation is the most common heart valve disorder worldwide, affecting over 2% of the global population, rising to at least 10% in adults over 75, and causing approximately 15% of valvular heart disease-related deaths. Yet only a minority of patients with severe disease undergo corrective surgery. Rapid assessment of valve mechanics could enable earlier, more precise intervention, but traditional finite element simulations remain too slow for clinical timelines and parameter sweeps. We introduce the Physics-Conditioned Neural Operator (PCNO), a transformer-based surrogate that predicts leaflet displacement, strain, and stress fields across mitral and tricuspid geometries, conditioned on systolic blood pressure and tissue properties. Trained on functional, regurgitated, and pathological valves, including tethering, P2 prolapse, and annular dilation, PCNO achieves up to a 15,260x speedup over fine mesh finite element simulations

item.title: 本文将广义朴素贝叶斯扩展到连续特征，证明其结构学习仅依赖双变量边缘分布的成对copula且该结构对应拟阵的基，从而提出通过最小化KL散度的贪心算法来寻找最优GNB结构。
item.description:
关于具有连续特征的广义朴素贝叶斯

On Generalized Naive Bayes with Continuous Features

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23819

本文将广义朴素贝叶斯扩展到连续特征，证明其结构学习仅依赖双变量边缘分布的成对copula且该结构对应拟阵的基，从而提出通过最小化KL散度的贪心算法来寻找最优GNB结构。

广义朴素贝叶斯（GNB）模型最初是为离散和分类随机变量引入的，作为经典朴素贝叶斯的扩展。本文将GNB框架适配到连续解释变量。论文的一个核心结果是，GNB的结构学习仅依赖于双变量边缘分布的成对copula。我们证明了GNB结构可以对应于拟阵的基，因此我们给出了在训练数据上寻找最优GNB结构的贪心算法，其优化目标是最小化Kullback-Leibler散度。论文考虑了三种情况：联合高斯分布；一个更灵活的模型，其中假设依赖结构由具有任意边缘分布的高斯copula描述；以及一个更加灵活的情况，即联合连续概率分布完全任意，即copula和边缘分布均为任意。此外还提出了一种基于t……的模型简化方法（摘要原文在此处被截断）。

arXiv:2609.23819v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Generalized Naive Bayes (GNB) model was introduced for discrete and categorical random variables as an extension of classic Naive Bayes. We now accommodate the GNB framework to continuous explanatory variables. A central result of the paper is that structure learning of the GNB depends only on the pair copulas of the bi-variate marginals. We proved that the GNB structure can be assigned to the basis of a matroid, therefore we give greedy algorithms for finding the optimal GNB structure on the training data, in sense of minimizing Kullback-Leibler divergence. Three cases are considered: joint Gaussian distribution, then a more flexible model where we suppose the dependence structure to be described by a Gaussian copula with arbitrary marginals, and an even more flexible case where the joint continuous probability distribution is arbitrary, i.e. copula and marginal distributions are arbitrary. item.title: 本文提出用于字典学习的迭代原子精化（IAR）算法，并基于新颖的原子选择概率单调性原理建立了严格收敛理论，证明某个原子微小的初始优势会被逐步放大，仅需三步精化即可分离出真实原子。
item.description:
迭代原子精化：字典学习的单调性原理

Iterative Atom Refinement: A Monotonicity Principle for Dictionary Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23812

本文提出用于字典学习的迭代原子精化（IAR）算法，并基于新颖的原子选择概率单调性原理建立了严格收敛理论，证明某个原子微小的初始优势会被逐步放大，仅需三步精化即可分离出真实原子。

字典学习旨在从观测数据 ${\bf y}_i = A{\bf x}_i$ 中恢复未知的字典 $A$，其中 ${\bf x}_i$ 为稀疏系数向量。我们提出了迭代原子精化算法，这是一种用于恢复单个字典原子的简单方法。IAR 从一个随机方向出发，反复选择与当前迭代结果最相关的观测数据，并通过对所选数据取平均来更新方向。我们的主要贡献是建立了 IAR 的严格收敛理论。利用高维概率估计和一种新颖的原子选择概率单调性原理，我们证明了某个原子的微小初始优势会被不断放大，直到该原子被分离出来。在我们的模型假设下，IAR 仅需三步精化即可识别出一个生成原子。数值实验支持了该理论，并表明所得动力学能够准确捕捉所观察到的行为。

arXiv:2609.23812v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dictionary learning seeks to recover an unknown dictionary $A$ from observations ${\bf y}_i = A{\bf x}_i$ with sparse coefficient vectors ${\bf x}_i$. We introduce the \emph{Iterative Atom Refinement} (IAR) algorithm, a simple procedure for recovering individual dictionary atoms. Starting from a random direction, IAR repeatedly selects the observations most strongly correlated with the current iterate and updates the direction by averaging the selected data. Our main contribution is a rigorous convergence theory of IAR. Using high-dimensional probabilistic estimates and a novel monotonicity principle for atom-selection probabilities, we show that a small initial advantage of one atom is amplified until that atom is isolated. Under our model assumptions, IAR identifies a generating atom after only three refinement steps. Numerical experiments support the theory and show that the resulting dynamics accurately capture the behavior observed

item.title: 该论文提出Belted Engression框架，通过在生成式分布回归中嵌入结构瓶颈实现充分降维，建立端到端的“先压缩后生成”范式，并从理论上证明了标准SDR条件等价于保分布的生成式分解以及有限样本保证。
item.description:
带式Engression：面向生成式分布回归的充分降维方法

Belted Engression: Sufficient Dimension Reduction for Generative Distributional Regression

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23789

该论文提出Belted Engression框架，通过在生成式分布回归中嵌入结构瓶颈实现充分降维，建立端到端的“先压缩后生成”范式，并从理论上证明了标准SDR条件等价于保分布的生成式分解以及有限样本保证。

现代条件生成模型在学习复杂的协变量依赖关系时面临重大挑战。虽然充分降维（SDR）为压缩这些依赖关系提供了一种有原则的方法，但传统的SDR框架并非为条件生成而设计。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了Belted Engression，这是一个统一且在架构上参数高效的生成式分布回归框架。我们的方法建立了一个由充分表示学习驱动的端到端“先压缩后生成”范式，在生成架构中嵌入了一个结构瓶颈。在理论方面，我们证明了标准的SDR条件等价于一种保持分布的生成式分解，该分解在总体Belted Engression目标的全局最优解处得以实现。此外，通过揭示能量分数损失的一种局部化Bernstein型控制，我们建立了有限样本一致性……

arXiv:2609.23789v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern conditional generative models face significant challenges when learning complex covariate dependencies. While sufficient dimension reduction (SDR) provides a principled approach to compress these dependencies, traditional SDR frameworks were not formulated for conditional generation. To bridge this gap, we propose Belted Engression, a unified and architecturally parameter-efficient framework for generative distributional regression. Our approach establishes an end-to-end compress-then-generate paradigm driven by sufficient representation learning, embedding a structural bottleneck into the generative architecture. Theoretically, we prove that the standard SDR condition is equivalent to a law-preserving generative factorization, which is achieved at the global optimum of the population Belted Engression objective. Furthermore, by uncovering a localized Bernstein-type control for the energy-score loss, we establish finite-sample con

item.title: 提出坠落树——一种在保持单调递减风险约束的同时允许树状分支的新型可解释模型，并开发GRAVITree算法学习其Rashomon集合，在临床数据和公开基准上匹配或超越坠落规则列表等可解释基线。
item.description:
坠落树：一种用于可解释风险优先级排序的模型类

Falling Trees: A Model Class for Interpretable Risk Prioritization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23780

提出坠落树——一种在保持单调递减风险约束的同时允许树状分支的新型可解释模型，并开发GRAVITree算法学习其Rashomon集合，在临床数据和公开基准上匹配或超越坠落规则列表等可解释基线。

许多现实世界的决策需要对高风险案例进行优先级排序，例如临床医生需要将高风险患者排在低风险患者之前。坠落规则列表（FRL）是一组具有单调递减风险的有序“如果-那么”规则，为此类任务提供了可解释的框架；然而，其单路径结构导致模型类受到高度限制。我们提出了坠落树，这是一类新的可解释模型，它在保持相同单调风险约束的同时，允许树状分支结构。我们提出了GRAVITree，这是一种新颖的带边界动态规划算法，用于在深度和分支约束下学习坠落树的Rashomon集合。我们的方法可以在规则列表和完整决策树之间进行插值，实现用户所需的模型表达能力。在一个新的临床数据集和许多公开的分类基准测试中，坠落树匹配或超越了FRL和其他可解释基线模型，通常……

arXiv:2609.23780v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many real-world decisions require prioritizing high-risk cases, such as clinicians prioritizing high-risk patients before lower-risk ones. Falling rule lists (FRLs), which are ordered if--then rules with monotonically decreasing risks, provide an interpretable framework for such tasks; however, their single-path structure yields a highly restricted model class. We introduce falling trees, a new family of interpretable models that enforces the same monotonic risk constraint while permitting tree-structured branching. We present GRAVITree, a novel dynamic-programming-with-bounds algorithm for learning the Rashomon set of falling trees under depth and branching constraints. Our formulation can interpolate between rule lists and full decision trees, enabling user-desired model expressivity. item.title: 该论文提出了一个由基于Transformer的动作值函数预测热启动的鲁棒强化学习算法，结合R污染模型与保形预测，给出了统计上严格的收敛性保证以及几乎无需真实转移核知识的预认证停止规则。
item.description:
Transformer编码器加速的鲁棒强化学习的统计收敛性

Statistical Convergence of Transformer Encoder-Accelerated Robust Reinforcement Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23775

该论文提出了一个由基于Transformer的动作值函数预测热启动的鲁棒强化学习算法，结合R污染模型与保形预测，给出了统计上严格的收敛性保证以及几乎无需真实转移核知识的预认证停止规则。

在马尔可夫决策过程中，在大规模状态-动作空间中获取最优动作值函数的计算开销十分巨大。在本研究中，我们针对一种鲁棒强化学习算法给出了统计上严格的收敛性结果，该算法由基于Transformer的动作值函数预测进行热启动，其中自然语言提示用于编码任务规范。我们的框架采用R污染模型来刻画状态转移核中的不确定性，并通过由收缩Bellman残差构造的轨迹级非一致性分数，利用保形预测来认证收敛性。由此得到的保形分位数在所有迭代过程中同时界定了当前动作值函数与最优动作值函数之间的差距，从而产生了一种预认证的停止规则，该规则几乎无需了解真实转移核的知识。论文还在不同规模的扰动迷宫环境中进行了数值案例研究。

arXiv:2609.23775v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Obtaining the optimal action-value function in Markov decision processes is computationally intensive in large state--action spaces. In this study, we present statistically rigorous convergence results for a robust reinforcement learning algorithm warm-started by a transformer-based action-value function prediction, where natural language prompts encode task specifications. Our framework adopts the R-contamination model to characterize uncertainty in the state transition kernel, and employs conformal prediction to certify convergence via trajectory-level nonconformity scores constructed from the contracting Bellman residual. The resulting conformal quantile bounds the gap between the running and optimal action-value functions simultaneously over all iterations, thereby yielding a pre-certified stopping rule that requires little knowledge of the true transition kernel. item.title: 提出SAGE，一种基于最优停止理论、在单次模型交换预算下自适应决定何时停止探测的去中心化联邦学习同伴选择方法，并以高概率保证所选同伴不劣于随机gossip。
item.description:
SAGE：面向去中心化联邦学习的最优停止同伴选择方法

SAGE: Optimal-Stopping Peer Selection for Decentralised Federated Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23773

提出SAGE，一种基于最优停止理论、在单次模型交换预算下自适应决定何时停止探测的去中心化联邦学习同伴选择方法，并以高概率保证所选同伴不劣于随机gossip。

去中心化联邦学习用点对点模型交换取代了服务器聚合，使得协作者选择成为不确定性下的本地决策。固定的探测预算在容易的选择上浪费精力，而在同伴难以区分时又显得不足。我们提出SAGE（Sequential Anchor-Gated Exchange，顺序锚点门控交换），一种在单次承载模型交换预算下的最优停止同伴选择器。接收者基于其自有的锚点证据对候选邻居进行评分，一旦优势得到认证即完成选择。只有当进一步的证据能够补偿其成本时，选择器才继续探测，否则回退到随机gossip。我们证明该停止问题存在可在有限阶段达到的最优规则，并且锚点调度在同伴风险差距和置信水平上是阶数最优的。我们进一步证明该选择器以高概率绝不会返回比随机gossip更差的同伴，并证明对于（固定预算的）选择器而言不存在这样的保证。

arXiv:2609.23773v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Decentralised federated learning replaces server aggregation with peer-to-peer model exchange, making collaborator selection a local decision under uncertainty. Fixed probe budgets waste effort on easy choices yet fall short when peers are hard to distinguish. We propose SAGE (Sequential Anchor-Gated Exchange), an optimal-stopping peer selector under a one-model-bearing-exchange budget. A receiver scores candidate neighbours on receiver-owned anchor evidence and selects once an advantage is certified. It continues probing only while further evidence repays its cost, and otherwise falls back to random gossip. We show that the stopping problem admits an optimal rule attained at a finite stage, and that the anchor schedule is order-optimal in the peer-risk gap and the confidence level. We further show that the selector never returns a peer worse than random gossip with high probability, and prove that no such guarantee holds for selectors

item.title: 提出了 TriFleetRCA，一个完全运行在单块本地 GPU 上的 Kubernetes 根因分析流水线，通过多范围证据收集、模板去重加 BM25 排序以及运行手册摄取防护，在模型和上下文预算受限的条件下实现可靠且可抵御运行手册篡改的根因分析。
item.description:
TriFleetRCA：基于本地部署大语言模型的 Kubernetes 根因分析

TriFleetRCA: On-Premise LLM Root Cause Analysis for Kubernetes

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23766

提出了 TriFleetRCA，一个完全运行在单块本地 GPU 上的 Kubernetes 根因分析流水线，通过多范围证据收集、模板去重加 BM25 排序以及运行手册摄取防护，在模型和上下文预算受限的条件下实现可靠且可抵御运行手册篡改的根因分析。

远程站点的根因分析速度缓慢：证据分散在 Pod 日志、Kubernetes 事件和集群级对象之中，而且许多运维人员根本无法将生产日志发送给云端托管模型。本地部署推理消除了第二个限制，但也提出了一个现有实时集群基准测试尚未解决的问题：当一块工作站 GPU 同时固定了模型和上下文预算时，应该如何检索证据？当模型所参考的运行手册被篡改时又会发生什么？我们提出了 TriFleetRCA，这是一个完全运行在单块本地 GPU 上的流水线，它在三个范围（Pod、命名空间、集群）之一收集证据，先通过模板去重再用 BM25 进行排序，通过摄取防护机制过滤运行手册，并返回根因及其支持证据行。我们在一个实时 Kubernetes 集群上进行评估，向其中注入四种故障，因此真值在构建时即为已知，并使用 Qwen 进行了 100 次分析。

arXiv:2609.23766v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Root cause analysis at a remote site is slow: evidence is scattered across pod logs, Kubernetes events and cluster-level objects, and many operators cannot send production logs to a hosted model at all. On-premise inference removes the second constraint but raises a question live-cluster benchmarks have not addressed: when one workstation GPU fixes both the model and the context budget, how should evidence be retrieved, and what happens when the runbooks the model consults have been tampered with? We present TriFleetRCA, a pipeline running entirely on one on-premise GPU that collects evidence at one of three scopes (pod, namespace, cluster), ranks it by template de-duplication then BM25, filters runbooks through an ingest guard, and returns a root cause with the evidence lines supporting it. We evaluate on a live Kubernetes cluster into which we inject four faults, so ground truth is known by construction, across 100 analyses with Qwen

item.description:
GenVoid：基于经实验验证的物理信息生成模型的亚表面材料缺陷不确定性感知学习

GenVoid: Uncertainty-Aware Learning of Subsurface Material Defects with an Experimentally Validated Physics-Informed Generative Model

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23761

提出了GenVoid框架，将力学控制方程融入生成式模型，仅凭表面位移测量即可在不确定性和噪声条件下，对复杂二维和三维固体中的内部空隙进行跨弹性、超弹性和塑性材料行为的概率化识别与重建。

内部空隙是制造结构中普遍存在的缺陷，但由于其几何形状是隐藏的，只能通过可获取的测量进行间接推断，因此对其表征仍然极具挑战性。本文提出了GenVoid，这是一个基于物理信息生成模型的框架，仅利用表面位移测量即可识别复杂二维和三维固体中的内部空隙。通过将主导力学方程融入生成式推理框架，GenVoid能够在线性弹性、超弹性和塑性等多种材料行为下实现空隙识别，并适用于复杂的二维和三维结构几何形状。重要的是，该框架显式地考虑了位移测量中的不确定性和噪声，能够生成内部空隙几何形状的概率性重建，而非单一的确定性估计。我们使用高保真（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.23761v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Internal voids are ubiquitous defects in manufactured structures, yet their characterization remains challenging because their geometry is hidden and can only be inferred indirectly from accessible measurements. Here we introduce \textit{GenVoid}, a physics-informed generative model-based framework for identifying internal voids in complex two- and three-dimensional solids from surface displacement measurements alone. By incorporating the governing mechanics into a generative inference framework, \textit{GenVoid} enables void identification across linear elastic, hyperelastic and plastic material behaviours and accommodates complex two- and three-dimensional structural geometries. Importantly, the framework explicitly accounts for uncertainty and noise in displacement measurements, producing probabilistic reconstructions of internal void geometry rather than a single deterministic estimate. item.title: 提出OnlineWM在线训练框架，通过主动模拟器交互和因果感知优化，解决了静态离线数据分布不匹配与虚假相关性两大问题，持续提升生成式世界模型的动作可控性与动力学建模可靠性。
item.description:
OnlineWM：面向有效世界建模的因果感知主动在线学习

OnlineWM: Causality-Aware Active Online Learning for Effective World Modeling

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23753

提出OnlineWM在线训练框架，通过主动模拟器交互和因果感知优化，解决了静态离线数据分布不匹配与虚假相关性两大问题，持续提升生成式世界模型的动作可控性与动力学建模可靠性。

生成式世界模型旨在基于动作条件预测未来状态，其中动作可控性是实现可靠动力学建模的基础。尽管近期研究利用模拟器生成的数据来增强这一能力，但现有的训练流程面临两个根本性局限。首先，静态的离线数据收集导致训练集与模型不断演化的错误模式之间存在分布不匹配，无法解决动力学预测仍然不可靠的关键长尾场景。其次，最小化观测差异的标准目标往往促使模型利用虚假相关性，而非捕捉潜在的动作-效果因果关系。为解决这些局限，我们提出了OnlineWM，这是一个通过主动模拟器交互和因果感知优化来持续改进世界建模的在线训练框架。OnlineWM引入了两个关键创新……

arXiv:2609.23753v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generative world models aim to predict future states conditioned on actions, where action controllability is fundamental for reliable dynamics modeling. While recent efforts leverage simulator-generated data to enhance this capability, existing training pipelines face two fundamental limitations. First, static offline data collection leads to a distribution misalignment between training sets and the model's evolving error patterns, failing to resolve critical long-tail scenarios where dynamics predictions remain unreliable. Second, the standard objective of minimizing observational discrepancy often encourages the model to exploit spurious correlations instead of capturing the underlying action-effect causality. To address these limitations, we propose OnlineWM, an online training framework that continuously improves world modeling through active simulator interaction and causality-aware optimization. item.description:
边缘校准不可组合：模块化机器人导航中的隐藏依赖性

Marginal Calibration Does Not Compose: Hidden Dependence in Modular Robot Navigation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23731

该论文揭示了模块化机器人系统中各模块单独的边缘校准无法保证组合后的系统级校准——模块间误差的隐藏相关性被忽略会使系统过度自信或过度保守，而建模联合协方差可以恢复系统校准。

机器人系统通常由多个独立开发的模块组成，这些模块协同工作以感知环境、进行预测并采取行动。尽管每个模块在单独运行时可能表现可靠，但将它们组合起来并不一定能在系统层面保持不确定性校准。在这项工作中，我们表明，经过良好校准的组件接口在组合之后并不一定能产生经过校准的下游行为。通过一个移动障碍物预测流水线，我们证明了位置估计器和速度估计器各自单独来看校准良好，但它们误差之间相关方式的差异会导致对未来状态不确定性的估计大相径庭。因此，假设各模块相互独立可能使系统要么过度自信，要么不必要地保守，从而直接影响下游的规划决策与安全性。通过仿真实验，我们表明对联合协方差进行建模可以恢复……

arXiv:2609.23731v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Robotic systems are typically composed of multiple independently developed modules that work together to perceive, predict, and act in the environment. Although each module may perform reliably in isolation, composing them does not necessarily preserve uncertainty calibration at the system level. In this work, we show that well-calibrated component interfaces do not necessarily produce calibrated downstream behavior after composition. Using a moving-obstacle prediction pipeline, we demonstrate that position and velocity estimators can each appear well calibrated individually, yet differences in how their error are correlated lead to substantially different estimates of future-state uncertainty. Consequently, assuming independence can make the system either overly confident or unnecessarily conservative, directly influencing downstream planning decisions and safety. item.title: 提出STEVE稳定化框架，通过仅从错误样本生成梯度的“错误驱动精炼”和基于保留集防止性能回退的“正则化验证”两种耦合机制，有效稳定文本梯度提示优化过程，减少性能退化并生成更鲁棒的提示。

STEVE：通过错误驱动精炼与正则化验证稳定基于文本梯度的提示优化

STEVE: Stabilizing Textual Gradient-Based Prompt Optimization via Error-Driven Refinement and Regularized Verification

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23716

提出STEVE稳定化框架，通过仅从错误样本生成梯度的“错误驱动精炼”和基于保留集防止性能回退的“正则化验证”两种耦合机制，有效稳定文本梯度提示优化过程，减少性能退化并生成更鲁棒的提示。

文本梯度方法通过自然语言反馈实现提示优化的自动化，但其迭代更新可能不稳定。我们识别出这种不稳定性的两个来源：由已经正确的样本产生的噪声梯度，以及对困难样本的过度特化（这会降低在较简单输入上的性能）。我们提出了STEVE，一个包含两个耦合机制的稳定化框架。错误驱动精炼仅从被错误处理的样本生成梯度，将更新集中在有信息量的失败案例上。正则化验证将每次更新视为临时性的，只有当在困难样本上的改进不会对保留集造成不可接受的性能回退时才接受该更新。在十个推理基准、三个评估器/优化器模型以及成熟的提示优化基线上，STEVE减少了性能退化并产生了更鲁棒的提示。此外，使用gpt-5.4-mini/gpt-5.4在符号推理、GSM8K-Pla……（摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2609.23716v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Textual-gradient methods automate prompt optimization through natural-language feedback, but their iterative updates can be unstable. We identify two sources of this instability: noisy gradients produced from already-correct examples and over-specialization to hard cases that degrades performance on simpler inputs. We introduce STEVE, a stabilization framework with two coupled mechanisms. Error-Driven Refinement generates gradients only from incorrectly handled examples, concentrating updates on informative failures. Regularized Verification treats every update as provisional and accepts it only when improvement on hard cases does not cause unacceptable regression on a preservation set. Across ten reasoning benchmarks, three evaluator/optimizer models, and established prompt-optimization baselines, STEVE reduces degradation and produces more robust prompts. 金融语言模型能够将非结构化的公司特定新闻转化为结构化的决策信号，但金融人工智能研究缺乏一个集成的部署框架，用于评估这些信号在金融决策系统中是否仍然有用。计算机科学研究已经为时间序列预测、文本分类、多模态股票预测、基于图的市场建模和机器学习运维等领域开发了强大的方法，然而这些研究方向并未提供一个领域特定的协议，能够在事件时间可观测性、概率校准、执行时机、交易成本、流动性约束、容量限制、运营诊断和统计推断等条件下联合检验金融语言模型的输出。我们提出了MFAST，一个市场摩擦感知的情绪到交易框架，它将带时间戳的金融文本转化为可审计、可复现且市场可行的交易决策。该应用...

arXiv:2609.23703v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Financial language models can transform unstructured firm-specific news into structured decision signals, but financial AI research lacks an integrated deployment framework for evaluating whether those signals remain useful in financial decision systems. Computer science research has developed strong methods for time-series forecasting, text classification, multimodal stock prediction, graph-based market modeling, and machine-learning operations, yet these streams do not provide a domain-specific protocol that jointly tests financial language-model outputs under event-time observability, probability calibration, execution timing, transaction costs, liquidity constraints, capacity limits, operational diagnostics, and statistical inference. We introduce MFAST, a Market-Friction-Aware Sentiment-to-Trading framework that converts timestamped financial text into auditable, reproducible, and market-feasible trading decisions. item.title: TEMPER是一种将时序自编码器、可微分掩码神经决策森林、CRPS训练与高斯混合后处理相结合的单变量时间序列概率预测算法，能够在多个预测步长上同时实现准确的核心预测和校准的不确定性估计。
item.description:
TEMPER：用于时间序列预测的时序编码器-掩码概率集成回归器

TEMPER: Temporal Encoder-Masked Probabilistic Ensemble Regressor for Time-Series Forecasting

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23701

TEMPER是一种将时序自编码器、可微分掩码神经决策森林、CRPS训练与高斯混合后处理相结合的单变量时间序列概率预测算法，能够在多个预测步长上同时实现准确的核心预测和校准的不确定性估计。

概率预测需要准确的核心预测以及经过校准的不确定性估计。本文提出了TEMPER（时序编码器-掩码概率集成回归器），这是一种单变量时间序列预测算法，它结合了时序自编码器、可微分掩码神经决策森林、连续排序概率评分（CRPS）训练以及高斯混合后处理。其R语言实现基于torch for R构建，可返回按预测步长划分的密度函数、分布函数、分位数函数和采样器函数。我们在三个包含趋势、周期、状态切换、非线性阈值和异方差成分的确定性合成水平序列上对TEMPER进行了评估。在预测步长为t+1、t+5、t+20和t+60的96次滚动起点预测中，经过最多300轮训练后，TEMPER获得了以起点水平归一化的2.824%平均CRPS、3.635%的中位绝对误差以及68.8%的90%经验区间覆盖率。

arXiv:2609.23701v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Probabilistic forecasting requires accurate central predictions and calibrated uncertainty estimates. This paper presents TEMPER, the Temporal Encoder-Masked Probabilistic Ensemble Regressor, a univariate time-series forecasting algorithm that combines a temporal autoencoder, a differentiable masked neural decision forest, continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) training, and Gaussian-mixture post-processing. The R implementation is built on torch for R and returns horizon-wise density, distribution, quantile, and sampler functions. We evaluate TEMPER on three deterministic synthetic level series with trend, periodic, regime-switching, nonlinear-threshold, and heteroskedastic components. Across 96 rolling-origin forecasts at horizons t + 1, t + 5, t + 20, and t + 60, TEMPER obtains 2.824% mean CRPS normalized by origin level, 3.635% median absolute error, and 68.8% empirical 90% interval coverage after training with a 300-epoch cap

item.title: 提出TrustMOPD方法，以专家模型RL训练前后相对于共享参考模型的位移作为token级可靠性代理，实现无标签的多教师加权蒸馏监督分配，将学生模型性能恢复率从54.4%大幅提升至91.5%。
item.description:
蒸馏你所信任的：可靠性感知的多教师在线策略蒸馏

Distill What You Trust: Reliability-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23697

提出TrustMOPD方法，以专家模型RL训练前后相对于共享参考模型的位移作为token级可靠性代理，实现无标签的多教师加权蒸馏监督分配，将学生模型性能恢复率从54.4%大幅提升至91.5%。

多教师在线策略蒸馏允许学生在自身生成的轨迹上从互补的专家模型中学习。然而，基于领域路由的方法在每个样本中仅选择一个教师，并在整个响应生成过程中保持固定。这种设计既依赖于混合训练语料库中通常缺失的标签，也无法在轨迹内部所需专业知识发生变化时调整教师选择。我们提出了TrustMOPD，它用无标签的、token级别的监督分配取代样本级教师选择。在每个学生生成的前缀处，TrustMOPD将每个专家模型经强化学习（RL）后相对于共享的RL前参考模型的位移作为局部可靠性的代理指标，跨教师对这些分数进行校准，并构建加权的蒸馏目标。在数学、代码和指令遵循任务上，TrustMOPD优于最强的无标签基线，将恢复率从54.4%提升至91.5%。

arXiv:2609.23697v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation allows a student to learn from complementary specialists on its own trajectories. Domain-routed approaches, however, select one teacher per example and keep it fixed throughout the response. This design both depends on labels that mixed training corpora often lack and cannot adapt teacher selection when the expertise required changes within a trajectory. We propose \textbf{TrustMOPD}, which replaces example-level teacher selection with label-free, token-level supervision allocation. At each student-generated prefix, TrustMOPD uses each specialist's RL-induced displacement from a shared pre-RL reference as a proxy for local reliability, calibrates these scores across teachers, and constructs a weighted distillation target. item.title: 该论文在具有低维信息子空间的近低秩高斯对抗分类模型中，证明了主子空间见证点可迫使近最优预测器控制尾部权重，并通过边界归一化给出由主维度和总尾部能量决定的局部化有限样本泛化保证。

近低秩对抗分类中的尾部权重控制与局部化泛化

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23688

该论文在具有低维信息子空间的近低秩高斯对抗分类模型中，证明了主子空间见证点可迫使近最优预测器控制尾部权重，并通过边界归一化给出由主维度和总尾部能量决定的局部化有限样本泛化保证。

我们研究了在高斯模型中、欧氏对抗扰动下的范数约束线性分类问题，该模型具有低维信息子空间和独立的噪声尾部。对于有界的ramp损失，我们证明了主子空间中风险低于二分之一的见证点会迫使每个近最优预测器具有较小的尾部权重。一条路径特定的密度界在无需正尾部方差的情况下给出了相应常数。在各向同性的主协方差下，我们建立了唯一的总体极小值点与联合局部增长。随后，边界归一化从中心化边际中移除了常见的攻击惩罚，从而给出由主维度和总尾部能量所控制的局部化有限样本保证。全局化增长在较弱的常数下移除了进入条件；而模型感知的比较则保留了局部保证。二十次配对重复的实验表明，超额风险与尾部使用随样本量增加而下降，且几乎未……

arXiv:2609.23688v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study norm-constrained linear classification under Eu clidean adversarial perturbations in a Gaussian model with a low-dimen sional informative subspace and an independent noise tail. Boundary normalization then removes the common attack penalty from centered margins, giving localized finite-sample guarantees governed by principal dimension and total tail energy. A multi-temporal dataset for mapping burned areas in the Brazilian Cerrado using time series of remote sensing imagery

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23687

该论文发布了一个基于CBERS-4A、CBERS-4和AMAZONIA-1卫星影像的巴西塞拉多草原火烧区域多时相数据集，并利用随机森林分类器验证了区分完全燃烧、部分燃烧和未燃烧区域的有效分类方法。

本文介绍了一个源自卫星影像的多时相表格数据集，用于绘制巴西戈亚斯州查帕达杜斯维德罗斯国家公园的火烧区域，覆盖2020年至2022年。该数据集包含来自CBERS-4A、CBERS-4和AMAZONIA-1卫星上WFI传感器的蓝、绿、红和近红外波段，以及BAI、EVI、GEMI、NDVI和NDWI光谱指数，并以规则网格形式组织。我们应用随机森林分类器，基于标记为完全燃烧、部分燃烧和未燃烧的样本开发并验证了模型。研究测试了两种分类方法：一种是将燃烧区域和未燃烧区域合并为二元类别，另一种是区分完全燃烧（TB）、部分燃烧（PB）和未燃烧（NB）三个类别。七种验证方法评估了不同的分类后组合，重点关注准确率、精确率、召回率和交并比。

The dataset contains blue, green, red, and near-infrared bands, as well as the BAI, EVI, GEMI, NDVI, and NDWI spectral indices from the WFI sensor on the CBERS-4A, CBERS-4, and AMAZONIA-1 satellites, organized into a regular grid. We applied the Random Forest classifier to develop and validate models based on samples labeled as totally burned, partially burned, and non-burned. Two classification approaches were tested: one combining burned and non-burned areas into binary classes and another distinguishing between totally burned (TB), partially burned (PB), and non-burned (NB) classes. item.title: 该论文提出自回归轨迹蒸馏（ATD），发现冻结父模型的递归轨迹比观测未来更易拟合，据此用轻量级并行出口实现可选加速执行（ATD-8 达 5.54 倍端到端加速且质量稳定），但同时指出更少的调用并不能自动消除父模型固有的预测误差。
item.description:
一个补丁，三种角色：自回归时间序列预测中究竟什么被耦合在一起？

One Patch, Three Roles: What Is Actually Coupled in Autoregressive Time-Series Forecasting?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23686

该论文提出自回归轨迹蒸馏（ATD），发现冻结父模型的递归轨迹比观测未来更易拟合，据此用轻量级并行出口实现可选加速执行（ATD-8 达 5.54 倍端到端加速且质量稳定），但同时指出更少的调用并不能自动消除父模型固有的预测误差。

基于补丁的自回归时间序列预测通常将输入表示、学习到的转移以及递归执行这三个角色绑定在同一个补丁长度上。我们探究这些角色中哪些可以被独立调整。一项支持性的原子编码研究发现，在所评估的参数网格上，模型对模型宽度的敏感性大于对原子分组的敏感性。我们的主要发现是：冻结父模型的递归轨迹比观测到的未来序列更容易用轻量级并行出口来拟合。自回归轨迹蒸馏将这一发现转化为可选的 ATD-1/2/4/8 执行模式，其中 ATD-1 能够精确恢复父模型。在配对的四数据集比较中，ATD-8 实现了 5.54 倍的端到端加速，且在不同模型宽度下质量保持稳定。更少的调用并不会自动消除父模型已有的预测误差：ATD 在全部 21 个种子运行中都提升了轨迹保真度，但相对于匹配的干净未来监督，仅在 15 个运行中提升了预测精度。我们进一步发现一个相关……

arXiv:2609.23686v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Patch-based autoregressive time-series forecasting often ties input representation, learned transitions, and recursive execution to one patch length. We ask which of these roles can be adjusted separately. A supporting atomic-encoding study finds greater sensitivity to model width than to atom grouping on the evaluated grid. Our main finding is that a frozen parent's recursive trajectory is easier to fit than the observed future with lightweight parallel exits. Autoregressive Trajectory Distillation (ATD) turns this into selectable ATD-1/2/4/8 execution, with ATD-1 exactly recovering the parent. On a paired four-data-set comparison, ATD-8 reaches $5.54\times$ end-to-end speedup with stable quality across widths. item.title: 提出了一种利用有效电阻正则化的非迭代图拉普拉斯估计方法，在样本数少于节点数的欠定情形下，以一定的边与权重恢复精度为代价，大幅降低了中等规模图的计算成本。
item.description:
基于有效电阻的快速图拉普拉斯估计

Fast Graph Laplacian Estimation using Effective Resistance

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23668

提出了一种利用有效电阻正则化的非迭代图拉普拉斯估计方法，在样本数少于节点数的欠定情形下，以一定的边与权重恢复精度为代价，大幅降低了中等规模图的计算成本。

从含噪节点观测中推断网络拓扑是图信号处理中的一个核心问题。本文考虑高斯马尔可夫随机场的拉普拉斯约束图估计问题，重点关注样本数量少于图节点数量的欠定情形。现有方法通常将该问题表述为稀疏正则化的最大似然估计问题，这类方法虽然有效，但通常需要迭代优化，且计算开销较大，尤其是在拉普拉斯约束下。作为替代，我们提出了一种利用有效电阻进行正则化的非迭代图拉普拉斯估计器，并通过简单的稀疏化流程对该方法进行评估。实验表明，在所考虑的数据集上，尽管在边和权重的恢复方面存在一定折中，但中等规模图的计算成本可以大幅降低。

arXiv:2609.23668v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Inferring network topology from noisy node observations is a central problem in graph signal processing. In this paper, we consider Laplacian-constrained graph estimation for Gaussian Markov random fields, focusing on the underdetermined regime in which the number of samples is smaller than the number of graph nodes. Existing approaches often formulate the problem as a sparsity-regularized maximum-likelihood estimation problem. While effective, such methods typically require iterative optimization and are often computationally demanding, particularly under Laplacian constraints. Instead, we propose a non-iterative estimator of graph Laplacians that uses effective resistance for regularization, and evaluate the method using a simple sparsification procedure. Experiments show that with some trade-off in edge and weight recovery on the considered dataset, computational cost for moderately sized graphs can be substantially reduced.

item.title: 该论文提出了ETH-TraceBench——一个覆盖13.5亿笔交易、50.1亿条日志的大规模以太坊DeFi事件流基准，通过时间、协议、基础设施和符号四类偏移划分评估模型泛化能力，并揭示简单模型在时间测试上表现优异但在协议新颖性下性能大幅下降。

以太坊去中心化金融（DeFi）提供了公开的、带时间戳的交易级事件流记录，但这些公开符号同样可能造成强烈的机器学习捷径（shortcut）。我们提出ETH-TraceBench，一个用于评估以太坊DeFi表示在时间、协议、资金池/基础设施以及符号偏移下表现的基准。原始事件全集覆盖2021年1月至2025年12月，包含13.5亿笔带日志的交易和50.1亿条原始日志行。模型评估使用固定的911,267个实例的有监督样本，在2021-2024年数据上训练，在2025年上半年进行模型选择，在2025年下半年进行测试。简单模型在聚合时间测试上表现强劲：TraceStats-GB在标准DEX测试集上达到0.953的宏平均F1，TopicEmitterHashMLP达到0.959。而在协议新颖性场景下性能急剧下降，TraceStats-GB、TopicEmitterTrace-SGD和TopicEmitterHashMLP的宏平均F1分别降至0.794、0.743和0.766，而严格的未……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.23659v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ethereum decentralized finance (DeFi) provides a public, time-stamped record of transaction-level event streams, but the same public symbols can create strong machine-learning shortcuts. We introduce ETH-TraceBench, a benchmark for evaluating Ethereum DeFi representations under temporal, protocol, pool/infrastructure, and symbolic shift. The raw event universe covers January 2021-December 2025 and contains 1.35 billion transactions with logs and 5.01 billion raw log rows. Model evaluation uses a fixed 911,267-instance supervised sample, training on 2021-2024, selecting models on 2025H1, and testing on 2025H2. item.description:
为什么视频扩散模型会违反物理规律？揭示注意力机制的缺陷

Why Do Video Diffusion Models Violate Physics? Unveiling the Flaws in Attention Mechanisms

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23658

该论文首次对文本到视频扩散模型的“运动规划”过程进行可解释性研究，发现旋转位置编码（RoPE）引起的空间注意力过度衰减导致候选区域过早锁定在物理不合理位置，这是模型生成违反物理规律内容的根本原因。

尽管视觉质量令人印象深刻，最先进的视频扩散模型经常生成违反现实世界物理定律的内容。虽然现有的解决方案依赖于外部先验或专门的数据，但我们通过探索这些模型的内部机制来研究其根本原因。具体而言，我们首次对文本到视频扩散模型的“运动规划”过程进行了可解释性研究，揭示了运动轨迹在早期去噪阶段是如何形成的。基于“先形状，后细节”的发现，我们将交叉注意力轨迹模式与因果头贡献相结合，识别出驱动运动规划的特定注意力头子集。此外，我们的自注意力分析表明，旋转位置编码会导致过度的空间注意力衰减。这导致早期候选区域过早地锁定在物理上不合理的位置，抑制了合理的轨迹……

arXiv:2609.23658v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Despite impressive visual quality, state-of-the-art video diffusion models often generate content that violates real-world physical laws. While existing solutions rely on external priors or specialized data, we investigate the root cause by exploring the internal mechanisms of these models. Building upon the ''first shape, then details'' finding, we combine cross-attention trajectory patterns with causal head contributions to identify a specific subset of attention heads driving motion planning. Further, our self-attention analysis shows that Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) induces excessive spatial attention decay. item.title: 提出BAS-VLA任务语义动作校准框架，通过以语义破坏为中心的校准核心与证据门控的保持辅助模块，使VLA模型在场景外观变化时保持动作稳定，而在任务语义改变时产生显著不同的行为。
item.description:
超越外观变化：面向VLA模型的任务语义动作校准

Beyond Appearance Shifts: Task-Semantic Action Calibration for VLA Models

提出BAS-VLA任务语义动作校准框架，通过以语义破坏为中心的校准核心与证据门控的保持辅助模块，使VLA模型在场景外观变化时保持动作稳定，而在任务语义改变时产生显著不同的行为。

视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在具身操作任务中已取得优异表现，但仍缺乏一种明确的机制来平衡行为稳定性与任务语义敏感性。我们识别出两种互补的失败模式：在任务保持型变化下（即任务语义不变，但场景外观发生变化，例如风格、光照、杂乱程度或指令改写），策略往往表现出不必要的动作漂移；相反，在语义破坏型变化下（即关键任务语义如目标物体或约束被改变），策略常常无法产生足够不同的行为，而是继续沿原轨迹执行。为填补这一空白，我们提出BAS-VLA，一个构建在冻结基础VLA之上的任务语义动作校准框架。BAS-VLA采用以破坏为中心的校准核心作为默认路径，并引入一个选择性的、由证据门控的保持辅助模块，该模块仅在……（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.23650v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong performance in embodied manipulation, but still lack a clear mechanism to balance behavioral stability with task-semantic sensitivity. We identify two complementary failure modes. Under task-preserving changes, where task semantics remain unchanged but scene appearance varies (e.g., style, illumination, clutter, or paraphrasing), policies often exhibit unnecessary action drift. Conversely, under semantic-breaking changes, where key task semantics such as the target object or constraint are altered, policies frequently fail to produce sufficiently distinct behaviors and instead follow the original trajectory. To address this gap, we propose BAS-VLA, a task-semantic action calibration framework built on top of a frozen base VLA. item.title: 提出了基于StyleGAN潜在空间的高效语义攻击方法BoundStyle（比现有最先进攻击快约9.5倍），并在此基础上构建了高效的对抗训练方案StyleAT，用于防御人脸识别模型免受语义攻击。
item.description:
StyleAT：防御人脸识别免受语义攻击

StyleAT: Defending Face Recognition Against Semantic Attacks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23596

提出了基于StyleGAN潜在空间的高效语义攻击方法BoundStyle（比现有最先进攻击快约9.5倍），并在此基础上构建了高效的对抗训练方案StyleAT，用于防御人脸识别模型免受语义攻击。

随着人脸识别模型如今被广泛应用于日常身份验证和监控系统中，近期研究指出了一个关键弱点：这些模型对对抗性语义编辑仍然极其脆弱。也就是说，对输入进行对抗性生成的语义改变，例如轻微的年龄变化或姿态变化，可以诱导模型产生误分类。某些现有攻击方法虽然强大，但计算成本高昂，使其难以用于开发防御手段（例如通过对抗训练）。为填补这一空白，我们提出了BoundStyle，一种在StyleGAN丰富潜在空间中运行的强大语义攻击方法，旨在最大化误分类率。值得注意的是，BoundStyle在实现高攻击成功率的同时，比现有最先进的攻击方法快约9.5倍，使其适用于对抗训练。基于BoundStyle，我们进一步开发了StyleAT，一种结合低预算攻击的高效对抗训练方案。

arXiv:2609.23596v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: With face-recognition models now embedded in everyday authentication and surveillance, recent works have pinpointed a critical weakness: these models remain acutely vulnerable to adversarial semantic edits. I.e., adversarially produced semantic alterations to the input, such as slight aging or pose changes, can induce misclassifications. Certain existing attacks are powerful, but they can be computationally costly, rendering them inadequate for developing defenses (e.g., through adversarial training). To fill the gap, we introduce BoundStyle, a potent semantic attack operating in StyleGAN's rich latent space to maximize misclassification rates. Notably, BoundStyle achieves high attack success rates while being ${\sim}{\times}9.5$ faster than existing state-of-the-art attacks, making it suitable for adversarial training. item.title: 提出双线性优化散度（BOD）诊断框架，揭示LoRA因子正交性在不同参数化与任务状态下对组合更新的保护差异，并据此提出半冻结正交路由（SFOR）与权重残差投影（WRP）以提升LoRA持续学习效果。
item.description:
双线性优化散度：诊断因子约束的LoRA持续学习

Bilinear Optimization Divergence: Diagnosing Factor-Constrained LoRA Continual Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23594

提出双线性优化散度（BOD）诊断框架，揭示LoRA因子正交性在不同参数化与任务状态下对组合更新的保护差异，并据此提出半冻结正交路由（SFOR）与权重残差投影（WRP）以提升LoRA持续学习效果。

LoRA因子中的正交性本身并不能说明组合更新究竟保护了什么：答案取决于任务起始状态、参数化方式以及优化器实际产生的位移。我们通过双线性优化散度（BOD）将这一问题形式化，这是一种相对于锚点的诊断工具，用于衡量在选定历史特征上的有效更新响应。有限步分析区分了两种情况：在共享适配器中，保护路由位移仍会通过不断变化的伴随因子留下学习锚点残差；而在全新的零输出块中，一个可行的路由状态可以在两个当前因子保持可训练的同时保护组合更新。这些条件催生了面向共享适配器的半冻结正交路由（SFOR）以及面向累积O-LoRA的当前块硬保护；权重残差投影（WRP）则在优化器更新步骤之后强制实现所需的位移。受控的双任务轨迹验证了上述预测。

In a fresh zero-output block, a feasible routing state can protect the composed update while both current factors remain trainable. These conditions yield Semi-Frozen Orthogonal Routing (SFOR) for shared adapters and current-block hard protection for cumulative O-LoRA; Weight Residual Projection (WRP) enforces the required displacement after the optimizer step. item.title: 该论文提出一种将物理动作掩码与紧急投影机制同基于预测的经济建议相分离的成本感知PPO强化学习方法，用于价差收窄市场环境下的电池储能调度，但实验表明其净利润仍低于代理成本MPC基准。
item.description:
面向价差受抑市场变化下电池储能调度的成本感知强化学习：动作掩码与投影方法

Cost-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Action Masking and Projection for Battery Energy Storage Dispatch under Suppressed-Spread Market Shifts

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23590

该论文提出一种将物理动作掩码与紧急投影机制同基于预测的经济建议相分离的成本感知PPO强化学习方法，用于价差收窄市场环境下的电池储能调度，但实验表明其净利润仍低于代理成本MPC基准。

电池储能系统（BESS）的调度必须在保持运行可行性的同时应对价格价差收窄导致充放电循环收益空间被压缩的问题。我们研究了一种近端策略优化（PPO）控制器，其预选择物理动作掩码和紧急投影机制与因果的、基于预测的经济建议模块相分离。所有依赖预测的方法均接收相同的因果24步预测和电网侧结算数据。在五个PPO随机种子下，开启经济建议时的净利润在336小时的T1和T2窗口分别为30.59和18.04美元，而代理成本MPC分别为36.77和22.94美元；PPO在两个时期均低于该参考基准。经济建议将T2利润从16.45美元提升至18.04美元，同时降低了吞吐量，但在T1中影响甚微。在不相交的周区块测试中，PPO在日度、周度和混合季节性预测下保持稳定，在持续性预测下表现减弱，且始终低于代理成本MPC。配对诊断将性能变化定位于观测到的（原文截断）

arXiv:2609.23590v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Battery energy storage system (BESS) dispatch must preserve operational feasibility while declining price spreads reduce the margin available to pay for cycling. We study a proximal policy optimization (PPO) controller whose pre-selection physical action mask and emergency projection are separated from a causal, forecast-informed economic advisory. All forecast-dependent methods receive the same causal 24-step forecast and grid-side settlement. Across five PPO seeds, advice-on net profit is 30.59 and 18.04 USD per 336-hour T1 and T2 window, versus 36.77 and 22.94 USD for proxy-cost MPC; PPO remains below this reference in both periods. Advice raises T2 profit from 16.45 to 18.04 USD while reducing throughput, but is immaterial in T1. On disjoint weekly blocks, PPO is stable under daily, weekly, and blended seasonal forecasts, weakens under persistence, and remains below proxy-cost MPC. item.title: 该论文提出Sink拓扑一致性（STC）指标，发现4比特NF4量化下首token注意力头的全局排序高度保持（ρ_s≥0.980），但top-k集合重叠显著下降，且存在层间和跨域的局部失效，表明仅凭全局排序在量化前复用sink头映射并不安全。
item.description:
全局排序得以保持，选中注意力头却发生偏移：4比特仅权重量化下的BOS-Sink拓扑

Global Ranks Survive, Selected Heads Shift: BOS-Sink Topology under 4-bit Weight-Only Quantization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23585

该论文提出Sink拓扑一致性（STC）指标，发现4比特NF4量化下首token注意力头的全局排序高度保持（ρ_s≥0.980），但top-k集合重叠显著下降，且存在层间和跨域的局部失效，表明仅凭全局排序在量化前复用sink头映射并不安全。

感知Sink的部署方式可以在模型量化之前识别重要的首token注意力头，然后在边缘端复用该映射图。我们测试了这种捷径在4比特NF4仅权重训练后量化（PTQ）下何时是安全的。我们提出的Sink拓扑一致性（STC）指标将全局排序保持、top-k集合重叠和逐层sink质量偏移区分开来，并将逐输入敏感性与校准映射迁移区分开。在Qwen2.5-0.5B、Qwen2.5-1.5B和Llama-3.2-1B上，在4096个token长度下，bf16到4比特的全局排序仍然很高（ρ_s ≥ 0.980），但top-k Jaccard重叠仅为0.619-0.793，对应76.5-88.5%的成员保留率。全局统计量还掩盖了局部失效：Qwen的末端层偏移达其模型均值的6.2-7.9倍，而Llama-3.2-1B则表现出较低且近乎均匀的漂移。在C4到LongBench的域偏移下，两个Qwen模型的跨域重叠比域内精度比较退化得更为严重。

arXiv:2609.23585v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Sink-aware deployment may identify important first-token attention heads before a model is quantized, then reuse that map at the edge. We test when this shortcut is safe for 4-bit NF4 weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ). Our Sink Topology Consistency (STC) metrics separate global rank preservation, top-$k$ set overlap, and layerwise sink-mass shift, and distinguish per-input sensitivity from calibration-map transfer. Across Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen2.5-1.5B, and Llama-3.2-1B, global bf16-to-4-bit ranks remain high at 4,096 tokens ($\rho_s \geq 0.980$), yet top-$k$ Jaccard overlap is only 0.619-0.793, corresponding to 76.5-88.5% membership retention. The global statistic also masks local failures: terminal Qwen layers shift by 6.2-7.9x their model means, whereas Llama-3.2-1B shows low, nearly uniform drift. item.title: ARID是一种可在8GB Jetson Orin NX边缘设备上离线部署的系统，通过双教师过滤、噪声感知数据合成、单次路由决策、4位推理和语法约束解码，将工业维护工单可靠地提取为固定模式的JSON，实现84.8%的token-F1并保证超过99.8%的解析成功率。
item.description:
ARID：一种可部署的边缘AI系统，用于从工业维护工单中提取结构化信息

ARID: A Deployable Edge AI System for Structured Information Extraction from Industrial Maintenance Work Orders

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23582

ARID是一种可在8GB Jetson Orin NX边缘设备上离线部署的系统，通过双教师过滤、噪声感知数据合成、单次路由决策、4位推理和语法约束解码，将工业维护工单可靠地提取为固定模式的JSON，实现84.8%的token-F1并保证超过99.8%的解析成功率。

维护工单通常需要在嵌入式硬件上离线处理，而下游软件需要可预测的结构化输出。我们提出了ARID（面向工业部署的航空启发式路由系统），它能够在8 GB的NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上，将组件、故障模式、症状和维护动作提取为固定模式的JSON。ARID结合了保守的双教师过滤、针对性的噪声感知合成、每个工单仅一次的路由决策、4位推理以及语法约束解码。从2,326条未标注的OMIn记录中，系统保留了716个训练对，并额外添加了99条针对动作提取的拓扑约束记录。在300条人工标注的记录上，ARID在参考技术栈上达到84.8%的token-F1，在部署的Jetson上达到82.9%。常驻服务在12.5 W功耗下实现了5,310/5,656 ms的P50/P99延迟。在零样本MaintNet迁移测试中，语义F1降至46.4%，但解析器成功率仍保持在至少99.8%，这表明输出有效性……

arXiv:2609.23582v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Maintenance work orders must often be processed offline on embedded hardware, yet downstream software requires predictable structured output. We present ARID (Aviation-inspired Routing for Industrial Deployment), which extracts component, failure mode, symptom, and maintenance action into fixed-schema JSON on an 8 GB NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. ARID combines conservative dual-teacher filtering, targeted noise-aware synthesis, one routing decision per work order, 4-bit inference, and grammar-constrained decoding. From 2,326 unlabeled OMIn records, it retains 716 training pairs and adds 99 topology-constrained records targeting action extraction. On 300 human-labeled records, ARID reaches 84.8% token-F1 on the reference stack and 82.9% on the deployed Jetson. Resident serving achieves 5,310/5,656 ms P50/P99 at 12.5 W. item.title: PACE通过在特征打分规则前插入冻结的预训练表格基础模型编码器，将特征扩展为高维上下文表示，从而以极小的额外成本显著提升高维表格数据的特征筛选效果和下游预测性能。
item.description:
PACE：基于预训练表格基础模型的即插即用上下文嵌入特征筛选方法

PACE: Plug-and-Play Contextual Embedding for Feature Screening with Pretrained Tabular Foundation Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23574

PACE通过在特征打分规则前插入冻结的预训练表格基础模型编码器，将特征扩展为高维上下文表示，从而以极小的额外成本显著提升高维表格数据的特征筛选效果和下游预测性能。

在高维表格学习中，特征筛选提供了一种轻量级、与模型无关的方法，可在模型拟合前去除无关特征。然而，直接对原始值进行打分可能会遗漏非线性或分布结构。我们提出了PACE（即插即用上下文嵌入），它在现有的特征打分规则之前插入一个冻结的表格基础模型（TFM）列编码器，将每个特征扩展为更高维度的上下文表示。在对照研究中，PACE仅以适度的额外编码成本，改进了对复杂非线性依赖关系的原始空间筛选。这些收益进一步转化为TALENT数据集上的下游预测性能提升：PACE-DC将二分类AUC提升了0.077，多分类宏平均AUC提升了0.064，在十个学习器上归一化RMSE的中位数改进为0.063。匹配的随机权重和随机特征对照实验表明，PACE的收益来自预训练结构本身，而非单纯的维度扩展。

arXiv:2609.23574v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In high-dimensional tabular learning, feature screening provides a lightweight, model-agnostic way to remove irrelevant features before model fitting. However, scoring raw values directly can miss nonlinear or distributional structure. We introduce PACE (Plug-and-Play Contextual Embedding), which inserts a frozen tabular foundation model (TFM) column encoder before an existing feature-scoring rule, expanding each feature into a higher-dimensional contextual representation. Across controlled studies, PACE improves raw-space screening of complex nonlinear dependence with only modest additional encoding cost. These gains translate to downstream prediction on TALENT datasets: PACE-DC improves binary AUC by 0.077 and multiclass macro-AUC by 0.064, with a median normalized RMSE improvement of 0.063 across ten learners. Matched random-weight and random-feature controls show that PACE gains from pretrained structure beyond generic dimensional

item.title: 该论文提出物理残差机器学习方法，将Tafel方程外推与随特征空间距离衰减的学习残差修正相结合，仅凭稀疏极化测量（每个候选材料两次测量、35个标记催化剂）即可准确预测超出训练范围的析氧催化剂活性，误差比纯数据驱动模型低约6.5倍。
item.description:
物理残差机器学习从稀疏极化测量中预测超出训练范围的析氧催化剂活性

Physics-residual machine learning predicts oxygen-evolution catalyst activity beyond the training range from sparse polarization measurements

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23549

该论文提出物理残差机器学习方法，将Tafel方程外推与随特征空间距离衰减的学习残差修正相结合，仅凭稀疏极化测量（每个候选材料两次测量、35个标记催化剂）即可准确预测超出训练范围的析氧催化剂活性，误差比纯数据驱动模型低约6.5倍。

在组合库上筛选析氧催化剂时，需要决定哪些候选材料将接受剩余的测量。而决定性的活性位于每个候选材料已测电位窗口之外，且往往高于拟合期间记录的所有活性。我们通过物理残差机器学习来预测这一活性：Tafel方程对候选材料自身测量的电流和斜率进行外推，一个随特征空间距离衰减的学习残差对幅值进行修正，适用域评分则在测量之前识别出超出训练范围的预测。在一个单独制备的包含322个候选材料的库中（其中282个高于训练最大值），每个候选材料仅需两次测量即可达到0.203 mA cm⁻²的平均绝对误差，而所选的数据驱动机器学习模型误差为1.330。训练范围内的误差仍保持相当水平，且仅需35个标记催化剂即可完成拟合。在两个独立数据集中，同样的……（原文在此截断）

arXiv:2609.23549v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Screening oxygen-evolution catalysts on combinatorial libraries requires deciding which candidates receive the remaining measurements. The deciding activity lies beyond each candidate's measured potential window and often above every activity recorded during fitting. We predict it by physics-residual machine learning: the Tafel equation extrapolates the candidate's own measured current and slope, a learned residual attenuated with feature-space distance corrects the magnitude, and an applicability-domain score identifies predictions above the training range before measurement. In a separately fabricated 322-candidate library, 282 above the training maximum, two measurements per candidate gave a mean absolute error of 0.203 mA cm$^{-2}$ against 1.330 for the selected data-driven machine-learning model. Errors inside the training range remained comparable, and 35 labelled catalysts were enough to fit it. In two independent datasets the sam

item.title: 提出MINT框架，将图提示学习中的节点-提示分配建模为带提示侧边际约束的熵正则化最优传输问题，在保证局部几何兼容性的同时防止分配过度集中于少数提示，从而保持图提示的全局几何完整性。
item.description:
通过测度约束最优传输保持图提示学习中的几何完整性

Preserving Geometric Integrity in Graph Prompting via Measure-Constrained Optimal Transport

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23547

提出MINT框架，将图提示学习中的节点-提示分配建模为带提示侧边际约束的熵正则化最优传输问题，在保证局部几何兼容性的同时防止分配过度集中于少数提示，从而保持图提示的全局几何完整性。

图提示学习通过轻量级提示参数，使冻结的图神经网络能够以参数高效的方式适应下游任务。然而，随着路由机制日益节点自适应化，独立优化的局部决策可能会共同将分配质量集中到有限的共享提示库的一个小子集上，即使单个节点与提示的匹配在局部仍然是有意义的。我们提出MINT（Measure-INtegrity Transport，测度完整性传输），一个熵正则化的最优传输框架，将节点到提示的适应过程表述为一个全局耦合的分配问题。传输代价偏向于局部几何兼容性，而预设的提示侧边际分布则显式地控制全图范围内的提示利用率。我们进一步推导出一个精确的方差分解，将提示侧的几何方差分离为保留的提示更新变化和节点内重心离散度，并结合一个条件稳定性……

arXiv:2609.23547v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graph prompt learning enables parameter-efficient adaptation of frozen Graph Neural Networks to downstream tasks through lightweight prompt parameters. As routing becomes increasingly node-adaptive, however, independently optimized local decisions can collectively concentrate assignment mass on a small subset of a finite shared prompt bank, even when individual node--prompt matches remain locally meaningful. We propose MINT (Measure-INtegrity Transport), an entropically regularized optimal transport framework that formulates node-to-prompt adaptation as a globally coupled allocation problem. The transport cost favors local geometric compatibility, while a prescribed prompt-side marginal explicitly controls graph-wide prompt utilization. We further derive an exact variance decomposition that separates prompt-side geometric variance into retained prompt-update variation and within-node barycentric dispersion, together with a conditional st

item.title: 提出了一种不依赖条件独立性检验、结构评分或函数假设的解耦因果发现方法DCD，通过加权函数解耦非目标变量直接识别马尔可夫边界，并利用结构不对称性迭代构建CPDAG，在噪声环境下表现尤为出色。
item.description:
解耦因果发现

Decoupled Causal Discovery

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23535

提出了一种不依赖条件独立性检验、结构评分或函数假设的解耦因果发现方法DCD，通过加权函数解耦非目标变量直接识别马尔可夫边界，并利用结构不对称性迭代构建CPDAG，在噪声环境下表现尤为出色。

从观测数据中进行因果发现是科学研究中一项基础但具有挑战性的任务。现有方法主要基于条件独立性检验、结构评分或限制性函数假设，我们提出了解耦因果发现（DCD），这是一种新颖的基于解耦的视角，不依赖于这些方法论。DCD通过加权函数对非目标变量进行解耦，直接识别马尔可夫边界（MB），使得在解耦分布下只有MB内的变量与目标保持依赖关系。在此基础上，DCD通过利用MB内的结构不对称性，迭代构建完全部分有向无环图（CPDAG）。我们建立了DCD的理论可识别性、可靠性和完备性。实证评估表明，DCD取得了优异的性能，特别是在具有挑战性的噪声环境中表现突出。

arXiv:2609.23535v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Causal discovery from observational data is a fundamental yet challenging task in scientific research. While existing approaches are primarily based on conditional independence tests, structure scores, or restrictive functional assumptions, we propose Decoupled Causal Discovery (DCD), a novel decoupling-based perspective that does not rely on these methodologies. DCD directly identifies the Markov boundary (MB) by decoupling non-target variables via weighting functions, such that only variables within the MB preserve dependence with the target under the decoupled distribution. Building on this, DCD iteratively constructs the Completed Partially Directed Acyclic Graph (CPDAG) by exploiting structural asymmetries within the MBs. We establish the theoretical identifiability, soundness, and completeness of DCD. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that DCD achieves strong performance, particularly excelling in challenging noise regimes.

item.title: 提出一种结构保持框架，将神经算子参数化为作用于椭圆算子特征值的谱滤波器，从而将能量范数误差精确分解为可观测的谱逼近项与分布相关项，使神经算子的分布外泛化变得可预测、可审计。
item.description:
通过可观测谱误差分解预测神经算子的分布外泛化

Predicting Out-of-Distribution Generalization of Neural Operators via Observable Spectral Error Decomposition

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23529

提出一种结构保持框架，将神经算子参数化为作用于椭圆算子特征值的谱滤波器，从而将能量范数误差精确分解为可观测的谱逼近项与分布相关项，使神经算子的分布外泛化变得可预测、可审计。

神经算子已成为求解偏微分方程（PDE）的强大代理模型，但其在分布偏移下的可靠性仍然是实际部署的关键障碍。现有的算子学习分布外（OOD）泛化方法在很大程度上是经验性和黑盒式的：它们仅报告聚合误差指标，却不解释误差为何产生或何时会增长。我们提出了一个结构保持框架，使OOD泛化变得可预测且可审计。我们的核心思想是将学习到的解算子参数化为作用于底层椭圆算子特征值的谱滤波器 $h_\theta(\lambda)$，通过切比雪夫多项式展开实现，并采用弱形式目标函数进行训练。这种参数化使得能量范数误差能够被精确分解为两个可观测的组成部分：一个依赖于模型的谱逼近项和一个依赖于分布的（摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2609.23529v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural operators have emerged as powerful surrogates for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), yet their reliability under distribution shift remains a critical barrier to deployment. Existing approaches to out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization in operator learning are largely empirical and black-box: they report aggregate error metrics without explaining why errors arise or when they will grow. We propose a structure-preserving framework that makes OOD generalization predictable and auditable. Our key idea is to parameterize the learned solution operator as a spectral filter $h_\theta(\lambda)$ acting on the eigenvalues of the underlying elliptic operator, implemented via Chebyshev polynomial expansions and trained with a weak-form objective. This parameterization admits an exact decomposition of the energy-norm error into two observable components: a model-dependent spectral approximation term and a distribution-dependent s

item.title: 该研究在双家庭联邦学习模拟中发现，轻度特征抑制虽无正式隐私保证，却在宏F1与最差组F1上全面优于提供隐私保证的DP-SGD，且所测试的DP-SGD配置对少数流量类别造成显著性能损失。
item.description:
特征抑制与差分隐私在住宅流量分类中的应用：双家庭联邦学习研究

Feature Suppression and Differential Privacy for Residential Traffic Classification: A Two-Home Federated Study

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23521

该研究在双家庭联邦学习模拟中发现，轻度特征抑制虽无正式隐私保证，却在宏F1与最差组F1上全面优于提供隐私保证的DP-SGD，且所测试的DP-SGD配置对少数流量类别造成显著性能损失。

住宅流量分类支持服务管理，但跨家庭的学习必须考虑异构流量与隐私约束。隐私感知训练可能在不同流量类别间造成不均衡的代价。我们在模拟的双客户端联邦学习中研究这一权衡，使用了涵盖六个类别的162万条经预处理的网关采集流量。我们在固定的记录级隐私设置下比较了全特征基线、特征抑制（FS）与差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）。轻度特征抑制（FS-mild）从16个模型输入中剔除了四个时序特征；它不提供正式的隐私保证。在按规模成比例聚合下，在分层切分与时间切分两种数据划分、两种模型容量以及全部五个随机种子中，FS-mild均取得了比DP-SGD更高的宏F1与最差组F1（即各家庭中每类F1的最小值）的组合表现。所测试的DP-SGD配置造成了显著的少数类别损失，

item.title: ITSY是首个针对不规则时间序列数据的连续优化因果发现方法，通过重构结构方程以利用最近可用历史进行预测并联合插补缺失值，在线性模型下显著提升了因果图的恢复效果。
item.description:
ITSY：从不规则时间序列数据中进行因果发现

ITSY: Causal Discovery From Irregular Time-Series Data

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23516

ITSY是首个针对不规则时间序列数据的连续优化因果发现方法，通过重构结构方程以利用最近可用历史进行预测并联合插补缺失值，在线性模型下显著提升了因果图的恢复效果。

时间序列的结构因果模型能够恢复同期效应和滞后效应，但大多数方法要求完整的观测窗口，当样本缺失时会导致模型设定错误。我们提出了ITSY，这是首个在线性模型下从不规则时间序列进行因果发现的连续优化方法。ITSY重新构造了结构方程，使预测利用最近可用的历史数据而非可能缺失的当前时间切片，并在学习两个图的同时联合插补缺失值。加权重建目标纠正了这种重构所引起的噪声变换。在改变缺失率、规模、图密度和噪声的多种合成场景中，以及在真实世界基准测试上，ITSY在因果图恢复方面始终优于代表性的基于SCM的基线方法，证明了所提方法的有效性。这些结果为不规则线性一阶（动态）问题建立了一个有针对性的解决方案。

arXiv:2609.23516v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Structural causal models for time series recover contemporaneous and lagged effects, but most methods require complete observation windows and become misspecified when samples are missing. We introduce ITSY, the first continuous-optimization method for causal discovery from irregular time series under a linear model. ITSY reformulates the structural equation so that prediction uses the nearest available history rather than the possibly missing current slice, and jointly imputes missing values while learning both graphs. A weighted reconstruction objective corrects the noise transformation induced by this reformulation. item.title: 本文在威斯康星乳腺癌数据集上将变分量子分类器（VQC）和量子核支持向量机（QSVM）与三种经典分类器进行对比，发现经典逻辑回归准确率最高（97.8%），量子VQC准确率较低（88.9%）但对良性类别的召回率达100%。
item.description:
量子机器学习模型与经典机器学习模型在二分类任务中的比较研究

Comparative Study of Quantum and Classical Machine Learning Models in Binary Classification

量子机器学习（QML）是一条潜在的前进道路，它旨在将量子计算与经典机器学习相结合，以提升计算效率和模型的表达能力。本文在威斯康星乳腺癌数据集上，将两种不同的量子分类器——变分量子分类器（VQC）和量子核支持向量机（QSVM）——与三种作为基线的经典分类器——逻辑回归、支持向量机（SVM）和多层感知机（MLP）——进行了比较。量子电路在PennyLane框架中构建，并在经典后端上进行模拟。然而，在准确率方面，经典逻辑回归表现最佳，准确率为97.8%；经典SVM和QSVM的准确率均为95.6%；而量子VQC的准确率较低，为88.9%，但其在良性类别上的召回率达到100%，尽管它正确识别了……

arXiv:2609.23476v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A potential path forward is Quantum Machine Learning (QML), which aims to leverage quantum computing in conjunction with classical machine learning to enhance computing efficiency and the expressiveness of models. item.title: TRACE是一种决策路径可审计的临床心电图诊断模型，其32维潜在空间由领域知识预先定义并划分为灌注、结构和传导三个子空间，在PTB-XL和Georgia数据集上超越了无约束分类器以及在一个千万条记录上预训练的心电图基础模型。
item.description:
TRACE：面向临床心电图的易处理路由自编码器

TRACE: Tractable Routing Autoencoder for Clinical ECG

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23460

TRACE是一种决策路径可审计的临床心电图诊断模型，其32维潜在空间由领域知识预先定义并划分为灌注、结构和传导三个子空间，在PTB-XL和Georgia数据集上超越了无约束分类器以及在一个千万条记录上预训练的心电图基础模型。

深度学习已经推动了自动化心电图（ECG）诊断的发展，但该领域最精确的模型——在数百万条记录上预训练的基础模型——其决策路径不可审计：临床医生无法将诊断追溯到某一生理通路，也无法针对某一通路进行干预。我们提出了TRACE，一种面向临床心电图的易处理路由自编码器，其32维临床潜在空间是根据领域知识预先指定的，而非通过优化发现的。TRACE将该空间划分为灌注、结构和传导三个子空间，通过设计将每个子空间路由到各自的诊断头，并利用正交性惩罚对划分进行正则化，同时通过一个允许潜在扰动的解码器重建心电图。在PTB-XL和Georgia数据集上，TRACE超越了无约束分类器，并在约……（通过线性探针在冻结特征上评估）领先于在一个千万条记录上预训练的心电图基础模型。

arXiv:2609.23460v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep learning has advanced automated electrocardiogram (ECG) diagnosis, but the field's most accurate models, foundation models pretrained on millions of recordings, are not decision-pathway auditable: a clinician cannot trace a diagnosis to a physiological pathway or intervene on one. RLVR²：基于可验证评分量规排序的强化学习

本文提出RLVR²，一种基于可验证评分量规排序的强化学习范式，用排序机制取代线性分数聚合，解决了多维度语义异质质量标准在RLVR训练中权衡不可靠的问题。

基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）正在从具有明确定义正确性信号的任务（如数学和代码）扩展到由多维度评分量规指定的多方面质量要求。由于策略优化在每次 rollout 中只消耗一个标量，基于评分量规的流程必须将多个标准的得分聚合为标量奖励。这种聚合通常被视为简单的分数缩放，但它实际上隐式地决定了训练过程中各质量维度之间的权衡方式。目前主流的做法是对每个标准进行归一化后取线性组合，这隐含地假设了基数分数差异在各标准之间是可比的，并且某一标准上的收益可以补偿另一标准上的失败；当各标准在语义上异质时，这两种假设都不可靠。我们提出了基于可验证评分量规排序的强化学习（RLVR²），这是一种面向基于评分量规的 RLVR 的可验证排序范式。对于每个标准……

arXiv:2609.23457v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is expanding from tasks with well-defined correctness signals, such as mathematics and code, toward multifaceted quality requirements specified by multi-dimensional rubrics. Since policy optimization consumes one scalar per rollout, rubric-based pipelines must map multiple criterion scores into a scalar reward. This aggregation is often treated as score scaling, but it implicitly determines how quality dimensions trade off during training. The prevailing practice, normalizing each criterion and taking a linear combination, assumes that cardinal score differences are comparable across criteria and that gains on one criterion compensate for failures on another; both assumptions are unreliable when criteria are semantically heterogeneous. item.title: 提出伪自蒸馏框架PSD，使小型语言模型无需访问闭源大模型的logits或隐藏状态，仅通过提示渠道引入黑盒oracle知识，即可实现单模型蒸馏并构建分层记忆表征，从而大幅降低记忆增强智能体的部署成本。

PSD：面向大语言模型智能体的记忆表征能力伪自蒸馏

记忆系统正在成为大语言模型（LLM）智能体的核心组件，但构建和维护记忆的成本依然高昂，因为它依赖于对大型专有语言模型的反复调用。这一成本成为大规模部署记忆增强智能体的主要障碍。本文提出了伪自蒸馏（Pseudo Self-Distillation，PSD），这是一个使小型语言模型（SLM）能够通过多阶段训练流程、从强大的黑盒oracle中蒸馏行为，从而构建分层记忆表征的框架。标准的蒸馏方法需要访问教师模型的logits或隐藏状态，而闭源模型并不会暴露这些信息。与传统的自蒸馏设置（其监督信号来自模型自身的预测、采样轨迹或聚合输出）不同，PSD在实现单模型蒸馏设置的同时，通过提示（prompt）这一渠道引入外部oracle的知识。PSD让一个小型模型承担两种角色：……

arXiv:2609.23449v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Memory systems are becoming a core component of LLM agents, but constructing and maintaining memory remains expensive because it relies on repeated calls to large proprietary language models. This cost creates a major barrier to deploying memory-enhanced agents at scale. In this paper, we present Pseudo Self-Distillation (PSD), a framework that enables small language models (SLMs) to construct hierarchical memory representations by distilling behavior from a strong black-box oracle through a multi-stage training pipeline. Standard distillation methods require access to teacher logits or hidden states, which closed models do not expose. Unlike conventional self-distillation settings, where supervision is derived from a model's own predictions, sampled rollouts, or aggregated outputs, PSD enables a single-model distillation setup while channeling external oracle knowledge through the prompt. item.description:
面向基于序列的组学任务中LLM领域自适应的工具增强在线策略蒸馏方法

Tool-Augmented On-Policy Distillation for LLM Domain Adaptation in Sequence-Based Omics Tasks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23435

该论文提出了首个多组学序列推理基准OmicsBench（包含1160个专家验证问题），发现科学领域LLM虽然在分类准确率上优于通用LLM，但在提供有效生物学证据链的推理能力上反而表现不佳。

多组学序列包含复杂的生物学模式，然而为其机制进行解码以实现自动化科学发现仍然充满挑战。随着大语言模型（LLM）开始解读这些序列，同时评估其预测结果和科学推理能力变得至关重要。然而，现有的多组学序列任务基准依赖于分类和回归指标，忽略了模型是否真正掌握底层的生物学证据。我们提出了OmicsBench，这是首个针对多组学序列的推理基准，包含1,160个经过专家验证的问题，涵盖DNA调控、RNA加工和蛋白质功能三大领域的六项任务。OmicsBench要求模型提供可追溯的证据链，并使用与领域专家共同开发的针对具体实例的评分标准进行评估。对17个大语言模型的评估揭示了一种反向关系：尽管科学领域专用LLM在序列分类准确率上优于通用LLM，但它们未能提供有效的证据……

arXiv:2609.23435v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multi-omics sequences contain complex biological patterns, yet deciphering their mechanisms for automated scientific discovery remains challenging. As large language models (LLMs) interpret these sequences, evaluating both predictions and scientific reasoning is critical.
