We introduce OmicsBench, the first reasoning benchmark for multi-omics sequences, comprising 1,160 expert-validated questions across six tasks spanning DNA regulation, RNA processing, and protein function. OmicsBench requires traceable evidence chains, evaluated using instance-specific rubrics developed with domain experts. item.description:
从匿名实验中盲发现热力学本体论

Blind Thermodynamic Ontology Discovery from Anonymous Experiments

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23387

该论文提出了一个操作性可辨识性理论与构造性多项式时间算法，能够仅凭匿名受控实验的未知线性混合测量，盲发现热力学本体论——识别广延量与强度量扇区、恢复其对偶配对并验证稳定性势函数。

在机器学习模型能够学习热力学状态方程之前，它必须先发现其测量数据究竟代表什么：哪些通道随系统规模缩放（广延量），哪些是强度共轭量，各扇区如何通过热接触配对，以及哪个势函数支配系统的稳定性。当传感器仅暴露出广延态与强度响应的未知线性混合时，被动观测无法将物理量与坐标伪影区分开来。我们提出了直接从匿名受控实验中发现这一隐藏热力学本体论的问题。我们给出了一个操作性可辨识性理论和一个构造性多项式时间算法：该算法从复制对比中提取广延与强度缩放扇区，从热接触与互易性中恢复其对偶余切配对，通过离散循环凹性验证全局可容许的凹势函数，并确定……的不变拟阵（原文在此处截断）。

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23383

提出信念流滤波器（BFF），通过在测试时用梯度下降更新流匹配模型权重来直接编码后验分布的演化，从而绕过粒子表示的可扩展性限制，实现高维复杂物理系统中的贝叶斯滤波。

贝叶斯滤波为不确定性条件下的在线状态估计提供了一个有原则的框架，但其在具有高维状态和复杂后验分布的系统中的应用仍然充满挑战。近期的生成模型（如流匹配）已在贝叶斯滤波中展现出潜力。然而，这些方法仍然依赖于基于粒子的后验表示，从而丢失了完整分布所包含的丰富信息，或者处理与贝叶斯滤波递归结构相冲突的轨迹级逆问题。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个新视角：将不断演化的分布直接编码到流匹配模型的权重中，即信念流滤波器。这是一个生成式滤波框架，在测试时通过梯度下降更新模型权重以跟踪后验分布的演化。由此，BFF 绕过了粒子表示的可扩展性问题或灵活性限制。

To address this, we propose a new perspective of directly encoding the evolving distribution into flow matching model weights, namely, the Belief Flow Filter (BFF). It is a generative filtering framework that updates model weights via gradient descent at test time to track the posterior evolution. item.title: 该论文提出了“物理表示语言发现”这一新问题，并给出可辨识性理论与多项式时间构造算法，能够直接从匿名受控实验中恢复测量的隐藏本体结构（包括载体、微分序列、测量类型、对偶结构及不可打破的残余等价关系等）。
item.description:
发现物理表示语言

Discovering Physical Representation Languages

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23381

该论文提出了“物理表示语言发现”这一新问题，并给出可辨识性理论与多项式时间构造算法，能够直接从匿名受控实验中恢复测量的隐藏本体结构（包括载体、微分序列、测量类型、对偶结构及不可打破的残余等价关系等）。

在机器能够发现物理定律之前，它必须先发现它的测量是什么：哪些观测存在于胞腔上，哪些是强度量或广延量，哪些扇区是对偶的，哪些区别仅仅是规范性的。我们引入了物理表示语言发现这一新问题，即直接从匿名受控实验中恢复这一隐藏本体论的问题。我们给出了一个可辨识性理论和构造性的多项式时间程序，该程序能够恢复载体和微分序列、测量类型和定向扭转、不可逆的细化语义、原-对偶麦克斯韦图，以及任何被允许的实验都无法打破的残余等价关系。该理论将材料干扰转化为交换子，利用细化将量与坐标分离，并且只有在其表示被恢复之后才选择物理。对于一个经过认证的有限实验族，我们证明了端到端的两阶段测量界……

arXiv:2609.23381v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Before a machine can discover a physical law, it must discover what its measurements are: which observations live on cells, which are intensive or extensive, which sectors are dual, and which distinctions are merely gauge. We introduce physical representation-language discovery, the problem of recovering this hidden ontology directly from anonymous controlled experiments. We give an identifiability theory and constructive polynomial-time procedure that recovers a carrier and differential sequence, measurement types and orientation twist, noninvertible refinement semantics, primal-dual Maxwell diagrams, and the residual equivalences that no permitted experiment can break. The theory turns material nuisance into a commutant, uses refinement to separate quantities from coordinates, and selects physics only after its representation has been recovered. item.title: 针对软件工程智能体强化学习中不同任务类别“此消彼长”的跷跷板问题，本文提出类别感知的专家训练与策略整合框架，通过SWE Labeler多轴证据标注、同源类别专家强化学习与RRE（刷新-修复-扩展）迭代机制，实现成功行为的显式巩固和策略自适应的任务选择，从而均衡提升各任务类别的表现。
item.description:
一对多，多对一：面向软件工程智能体的类别感知迭代专家训练

One to More, More to One: Category-Aware Iterative Expert Training for Software Engineering Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23377

针对软件工程智能体强化学习中不同任务类别“此消彼长”的跷跷板问题，本文提出类别感知的专家训练与策略整合框架，通过SWE Labeler多轴证据标注、同源类别专家强化学习与RRE（刷新-修复-扩展）迭代机制，实现成功行为的显式巩固和策略自适应的任务选择，从而均衡提升各任务类别的表现。

仓库级软件工程（SWE）包含异构的任务类别，在池化的智能体强化学习下，其进展可能不均衡：某些类别的提升伴随着其他类别的退化，而总体解决率掩盖了这些变化。受这种“类别跷跷板”现象的启发，我们开发了一个类别感知的专家训练与策略整合框架。可执行任务构建和SWE Labeler（一种基于证据的多轴标注系统）用于组织训练池。初始的类别特定强化学习提升了平均训练成功率，但仍存在实例级进展不均衡的问题，这促使我们显式地巩固成功行为并进行策略自适应的任务选择。同源类别专家交替进行长时程Agentic-miniRL与“刷新-修复-扩展”（RRE）流程：更新后的策略刷新实例掌握度，将其自身验证过的成功轨迹复用于修复式监督微调，并为后续训练重新选择任务……

arXiv:2609.23377v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Repository-level software engineering (SWE) comprises heterogeneous task categories, whose progress under pooled agentic reinforcement learning can be uneven: gains in some categories coincide with regressions in others, while aggregate resolution obscures these changes. Motivated by this category see-saw, we develop a category-aware expert-training and policy-integration framework. Executable task construction and SWE Labeler, an evidence-grounded multi-axis labeling system, organize the training pools. Initial category-specific RL improves average training success while leaving uneven instance-level progress, motivating explicit consolidation of successful behavior and policy-adaptive task selection. item.title: 提出OV-OrthKD，一种可靠性感知的非对称正交知识蒸馏框架，让边界线索更可靠的视觉教师信号主导定位决策，同时将音频信号作为互补的辅助子空间，从而提升开放词汇音视频事件定位的性能。
item.description:
若闻其声，助寻其踪：面向开放词汇音视频事件定位的正交知识蒸馏

If You Hear It, Help Find It: Orthogonal Knowledge Distillation for Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23376

提出OV-OrthKD，一种可靠性感知的非对称正交知识蒸馏框架，让边界线索更可靠的视觉教师信号主导定位决策，同时将音频信号作为互补的辅助子空间，从而提升开放词汇音视频事件定位的性能。

开放词汇音视频事件定位（OV-AVEL）旨在从视频、音频和语言中，将文本查询的事件在时间轴上进行定位。该任务可用的监督来源在时间边界的可靠性上可能存在差异：在OV-AVEBench上，我们配置的视觉教师模型比配置的音频教师模型能提供更可靠的边界线索，尽管后者是一个强大的预训练音频模型，仍然具有丰富的语义信息。这是针对特定设置的诊断结论，而非对视觉与音频模态的普遍性排序。我们将由此产生的挑战表述为“监督放置”问题：哪些教师信号可以塑造定位决策，哪些应保持辅助作用。基于这一视角，我们提出了OV-OrthKD，一个可靠性感知的非对称蒸馏框架。视觉特征迁移塑造与决策对齐的表示，音频特征迁移丰富互补的辅助子空间，文本原型锚定已见/未见类别……

arXiv:2609.23376v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Open-vocabulary audio-visual event localization (OV-AVEL) grounds a text-queried event in time from video, audio, and language. The supervision sources available to this task can differ in temporal-boundary reliability: on OV-AVEBench, our configured visual teacher gives more reliable boundary cues than the configured audio teacher, although the latter is a strong pretrained audio model and remains semantically informative. This is a setting-specific diagnostic rather than a universal ranking of vision and audio. We formulate the resulting challenge as supervision placement: which teacher signals may shape the localization decision, and which should remain auxiliary. Based on this view, we propose OV-OrthKD, a reliability-aware asymmetric distillation framework. item.title: 该论文提出用“证据阶梯”框架（从问题建模、回顾性识别到前瞻性评估与生命周期监测）来审视医疗强化学习，核心观点是策略在历史数据上的高分并不等于能改善真实医疗护理，并系统总结了每一级的假设、失效模式及累积评估的报告规范。
item.description:
医疗保健中强化学习的证据阶梯：从回顾性策略到可信干预

The Evidence Ladder for Reinforcement Learning in Healthcare: From Retrospective Policies to Trusted Interventions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23374

该论文提出用“证据阶梯”框架（从问题建模、回顾性识别到前瞻性评估与生命周期监测）来审视医疗强化学习，核心观点是策略在历史数据上的高分并不等于能改善真实医疗护理，并系统总结了每一级的假设、失效模式及累积评估的报告规范。

强化学习（RL）为那些后果随时间逐步显现的医疗决策提供了一种自然的建模语言，然而大多数已报道的进展仍远未达到常规临床干预的水平。现有的综述通常按算法或临床应用来组织该领域，而我们则通过一个“证据阶梯”来审视医疗强化学习：问题建模、回顾性识别、策略估计、压力测试、前瞻性评估和生命周期监测。这一视角将临床治疗、患者参与和医疗系统运营联系起来，同时揭示了一个反复出现的鸿沟：策略在历史数据集中得分良好的证据，并不等于它能够真正改善医疗护理的证据。我们综合了阶梯每一级上的假设和失效模式，识别了哪些证据可以在不同场景间迁移、哪些不能，并提出了用于累积评估的报告实践。不安分老虎机作为其中一个特例被纳入讨论，而非作为组织全文的框架。

arXiv:2609.23374v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a natural language for healthcare decisions whose conse- quences unfold over time, yet most reported progress remains far from routine intervention. Ex- isting surveys organize the field by algorithm or clinical application. We instead review healthcare RL through an evidence ladder: problem formulation, retrospective identification, policy estima- tion, stress testing, prospective evaluation, and lifecycle monitoring. This view connects clinical treatment, patient engagement, and health-system operations while exposing a recurring gap: evi- dence that a policy scores well in a historical dataset is not evidence that it will improve care. We synthesize the assumptions and failure modes at each rung, identify what evidence can and can- not transfer across settings, and propose reporting practices for cumulative evaluation. Restless bandits are included as one special case, not as the organizing framework

item.title: 该论文提出首个智能体间文档到状态协议 MII，通过双时间尺度写入器将文档编译为 56 个 token 的固定带宽规范状态、再由轻量级翻译器适配任意冻结读取器，在单一可迁移媒介中统一检索、推理与重建，并将查询成本从 O(N²) 降至 O(K)。
item.description:
机器可解释信息：将文档编译为可搜索且可读取的协议状态

Machine-Interpretable Information: Compiling Documents into Searchable and Readable Protocol States

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23371

该论文提出首个智能体间文档到状态协议 MII，通过双时间尺度写入器将文档编译为 56 个 token 的固定带宽规范状态、再由轻量级翻译器适配任意冻结读取器，在单一可迁移媒介中统一检索、推理与重建，并将查询成本从 O(N²) 降至 O(K)。

长上下文语言模型通过原始自然语言与外部知识进行交互。在检索增强系统中，这造成了一个持久的“索引-载荷”割裂问题：稠密向量虽能支持可搜索的路由，但模型必须以 O(N²) 的注意力成本重新摄取冗长的文本载荷才能进行推理；而现有的压缩方法所产生的私有状态又往往绑定于特定架构。我们提出了机器可解释信息，这是首个智能体到智能体（A2A）的文档到状态协议。一个双时间尺度的状态空间“写入器”将文档编译为规范的、固定带宽的状态（56 个 token），随后一个轻量级“翻译器”将其映射到任意冻结的“读取器”的嵌入空间中，从而将查询时的成本降至 O(K)。由此产生的 .mii 工件在单一可迁移媒介中统一了检索（可搜索的几何结构）、推理（全局记忆）与重建（有据可依的细节）。我们展示了强大的跨模型互操作性……（摘要被截断）

arXiv:2609.23371v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-context language models interface with external knowledge through raw natural language. In retrieval-augmented systems, this creates a persistent index-payload schism: dense vectors enable searchable routing, but models must re-ingest lengthy text payloads for reasoning at O(N^2) attention cost. Existing compression methods further produce private states tied to specific architectures. We introduce Machine-Interpretable Information (MII), the first agent-to-agent (A2A) document-to-state protocol. A dual-timescale state-space Writer compiles documents into a canonical, fixed-bandwidth state (56 tokens), and a lightweight Translator maps it into any frozen Reader's embedding space, reducing query-time cost to O(K). The resulting .mii artifact unifies Retrieval (searchable geometry), Reasoning (global memory), and Reconstruction (grounded details) in a single transferable medium. item.title: 该论文通过“预测商”框架形式化了循环模型中记忆保持与误差抑制之间的根本边界，证明精确的语义保持校正最多只能消除 d−k 个独立方向，且有限的预测状态可被精确校正，而连续统中可区分未来的状态一旦受扰动便无法恢复。
item.description:
循环状态可以安全遗忘什么？

What Can a Recurrent State Safely Forget?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23366

该论文通过“预测商”框架形式化了循环模型中记忆保持与误差抑制之间的根本边界，证明精确的语义保持校正最多只能消除 d−k 个独立方向，且有限的预测状态可被精确校正，而连续统中可区分未来的状态一旦受扰动便无法恢复。

循环模型必须保留那些会改变未来行为的信息，同时抑制隐藏状态的误差。这两个目标存在冲突：收缩提升了稳定性，但沿未来区分方向的收缩会破坏记忆。我们通过循环状态空间的“预测商”来形式化这一边界。当两个隐藏状态诱导出相同的条件未来时，它们是等价的；它们的等价类构成预测纤维。每一个精确的保持语义的校正器在该商上表现为恒等映射。在具有隐藏维度 d 和预测维度 k 的正则点处，它最多可以消除 d - k 个独立方向。这建立了一个离散-连续边界：有限的预测状态允许具有正半径的精确校正盆地，而在有限维欧几里得空间中，不可数的、可区分未来的连续状态在任意正半径扰动后无法被解码。

arXiv:2609.23366v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recurrent models must preserve information that changes future behavior while suppressing hidden-state error. These objectives conflict: contraction improves stability, but contraction along a future-distinguishing direction destroys memory. We formalize this boundary through the predictive quotient of a recurrent state space. Two hidden states are equivalent when they induce the same conditional future; their equivalence classes form predictive fibers. Every exact semantics-preserving corrector acts as the identity on this quotient. At a regular point with hidden dimension d and predictive dimension k, it can eliminate at most d - k independent directions. item.title: 该论文将频率卷积网络分解为低秩形式，使参数量减少35.9%且不损失精度，并发现训练噪声范围对模型抗噪性能的影响比架构设计大约两个数量级，从而在边缘设备上实现了实时且抗噪的音高估计。
item.description:
面向边缘设备实时音高估计的低秩频率卷积与噪声范围增强

Low-Rank Frequency Convolution and Noise-Range Augmentation for Real-Time Pitch Estimation on Edge Devices

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23340

该论文将频率卷积网络分解为低秩形式，使参数量减少35.9%且不损失精度，并发现训练噪声范围对模型抗噪性能的影响比架构设计大约两个数量级，从而在边缘设备上实现了实时且抗噪的音高估计。

边缘设备上的音高估计同时受到三方面限制：模型必须足够小、必须在输入含噪时保持准确、并且必须在一个帧周期内产出一帧结果。本报告将我们早期工作中的频率卷积网络分解为低秩形式，参数量减少了35.9%，从17,787降至11,397，且无论在域内数据还是在两个模型从未训练过的语料库上，准确率均未下降。报告还表明，训练时所使用噪声的范围在决定模型遭受严重干扰时的表现方面，比架构本身更具主导作用。当训练噪声底从+6.02 dB降低到-20 dB时，干净信号下的RPA50仅损失0.35个百分点，而-20 dB下的RPA50从2.44提升至22.41。这一效应比所测得的任何架构效应大约大两个数量级。此外，研究发现TDNN-F中使用的半正交约束是多余的。

arXiv:2609.23340v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Pitch estimation on an edge device is constrained in three ways at once. The model must be small, it must stay accurate when the input is noisy, and one frame must be produced inside the frame period. In this report the Frequency Convolution Network (FrCN) of our earlier work is factored into a low-rank form. The number of parameters is reduced by 35.9%, from 17,787 to 11,397, and accuracy is not reduced, either in domain or on two corpora the model was never trained on. The range of the noise used during training is also shown to dominate the architecture in setting how the model behaves when the interference is severe. When the training noise floor is lowered from +6.02 dB to -20 dB, 0.35 points of clean RPA50 are lost and RPA50 at -20 dB is raised from 2.44 to 22.41. item.title: 该论文揭示了随机重构（SR）中的对角位移在过参数化神经量子态中实质上充当统计滤波器，通过在岭回归框架下平衡有用更新方向的收缩与拟合采样残差噪声的方差，来实现有限样本下的良好泛化。
item.description:
随机重构作为过参数化神经量子态的统计滤波

Stochastic Reconfiguration as Statistical Filtering for Overparameterized Neural Quantum States

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23334

该论文揭示了随机重构（SR）中的对角位移在过参数化神经量子态中实质上充当统计滤波器，通过在岭回归框架下平衡有用更新方向的收缩与拟合采样残差噪声的方差，来实现有限样本下的良好泛化。

随机重构（SR）是神经量子态（NQS）的标准优化器，但现代神经量子态的参数量往往远多于蒙特卡洛样本数。我们证明，在这种过参数化情形下，对角位移不仅仅是一个数值稳定器，它还充当一种用于有限样本泛化的统计滤波器。在固定波函数下，SR 等价于从切空间特征到中心化局部能量的岭回归。其残差即为表达能力差距，也就是虚时演化中超出当前切空间的部分。该差距在总体意义上与切空间正交，但有限批次会使其表现为 SR 可能过拟合的噪声。因此，位移在有用更新方向的收缩与拟合采样残差带来的方差之间取得平衡。在 4×4 海森堡图上的精确诊断将过参数化的两种效应区分开来：更大的切空间在能缩小表达能力差距时会有帮助，但当……时反而可能有害（摘要原文在此处截断）。

arXiv:2609.23334v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Stochastic reconfiguration (SR) is the standard optimizer for neural quantum states (NQS), but modern NQS often have far more parameters than Monte Carlo samples. We show that in this regime the diagonal shift is more than a numerical stabilizer. It acts as a statistical filter for finite-sample generalization. At a fixed wave function, SR is ridge regression from tangent features to the centered local energy. Its residual is the expressivity gap, the part of imaginary-time evolution outside the current tangent space. This gap is orthogonal to the tangent space in population, but finite batches make it act as noise that SR can overfit. The shift therefore balances shrinkage of useful update directions against variance from fitting sampled residuals. 该论文提出一种患者世界模型，将数字健康营销活动的早期结果预测视为动态系统问题，通过为每位患者维护潜在状态并联合学习暴露条件下的状态动力学与每周转化风险，实现了从第4周截断点以仅2.9%的相对误差预测至第52周剩余新品牌处方量的能力。

数字直接面向消费者（DTC）健康营销活动通常是在事后才进行衡量，而活动进行中的预测通常依赖于针对每个截断点和预测时间范围的独立分类器。我们将这一任务视为动态系统问题，并构建了一个紧凑的患者世界模型。该架构为每位患者维护一个潜在状态，将暴露条件下的状态动力学与每周转化风险进行联合学习，并向前滚动以预测未来的转化曲线。我们在一个包含147,173名患者和520万风险人周的美国营销活动数据集上对该模型进行了评估。在以记录的未来暴露为条件的回顾性评估中，该模型从第4周截断点预测截至第52周的剩余新品牌处方量，相对误差仅为2.9%；从第8至26周的截断点预测，相对误差为0.8%–2.6%。最强的非循环基线模型——即在相同生存滚动和信息条件下运行的合并风险梯度提升模型——相对误差……（原文截断）

arXiv:2609.23333v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Digital direct-to-consumer (DTC) health campaigns are usually measured after the fact. In-flight forecasting commonly relies on a separate classifier for every cutoff and horizon. We treat this task as a dynamic-system problem and build a compact patient world model. The architecture maintains a latent state per patient, learns exposure-conditioned state dynamics jointly with a weekly conversion hazard, and rolls forward into future conversion curves. We evaluate it on a US campaign dataset with 147{,}173 patients and 5.2 million at-risk person-weeks. In a retrospective evaluation conditioned on recorded future exposures, the model forecasts the remaining new-to-brand prescription volume through week 52 with a relative error of 2.9\% from a week-4 cutoff and 0.8--2.6\% from cutoffs at weeks 8--26. https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23325

该论文通过162次受控训练运行的系统性基准测试发现，单细胞基础模型的高总体准确率掩盖了其在罕见细胞类型上的系统性失败，这一失败由数据集结构而非预训练驱动，且长尾损失函数无法有效解决。

单细胞基础模型（scGPT、scBERT、Geneformer）在我们的实验中实现了高达97.5%的细胞类型分类准确率，然而这种总体准确率可能掩盖了模型在罕见且通常与疾病相关的细胞群体上的系统性失败，而长尾损失函数被广泛认为能够解决这一问题。我们提出了一个系统性基准测试，涵盖六种长尾损失函数（交叉熵、加权交叉熵、类别平衡损失、焦点损失、LDAM、logit调整softmax），跨三种架构和三个数据集（多发性硬化症、Zheng68K、人类胰腺），共计162次受控训练运行（3个骨干网络 × 3个数据集 × 6种损失函数 × 3个随机种子）。在普通交叉熵下，总体准确率、Macro-F1与罕见类别召回率之间的差距在所有九种（架构，数据集）设置中保持一致，且该差距由数据集结构而非预训练所驱动。罕见类别的失败本身可划分为两种具有不同嵌入几何特征的模式……

arXiv:2609.23325v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Single-cell foundation models (scGPT, scBERT, Geneformer) achieve cell-type classification accuracy up to 97.5% in our experiments, yet this aggregate accuracy can mask systematic failure on rare, often disease-relevant cell populations that long-tail loss functions are widely assumed to address. We present a systematic benchmark of six long-tail loss functions (cross-entropy, weighted CE, class-balanced loss, focal loss, LDAM, logit-adjusted softmax) across three architectures and three datasets (Multiple Sclerosis, Zheng68K, human Pancreas), totaling 162 controlled training runs (3 backbones x 3 datasets x 6 losses x 3 seeds). The gap between overall accuracy, Macro-F1, and rare-class recall under plain cross-entropy is consistent across all nine (architecture, dataset) settings, driven by dataset structure rather than pretraining. item.description:
生产级扩散模型推理服务中LoRA适配器的共现模式

Co-occurrence Patterns of LoRA Adapters in Production Diffusion Model Inference Services

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23321

本文基于阿里巴巴生产数据集GenTD26，首次从图论视角系统量化了生产级扩散模型推理服务中LoRA适配器的共现模式，发现共现网络极度稀疏、使用频率呈重尾分布，且首个适配器引入66.1%的延迟开销后边际成本递减。

低秩适应（LoRA）已成为在云端服务大规模个性化大语言模型和扩散模型的关键技术。然而，在生产推理工作负载下，适配器的共现模式、资源竞争关系和演化规律尚未得到系统性和定量化的研究。基于阿里巴巴的生产级扩散模型推理数据集GenTD26，本文采用图论框架构建适配器共现网络，并从静态结构和动态演化两个维度进行特征刻画。主要发现如下：（1）共现网络极为稀疏，适配器使用频率呈显著的重尾分布；（2）引入第一个适配器会带来66.1%的执行延迟开销，此后边际成本递减；（3）共现关系由基础模型驱动：在……

arXiv:2609.23321v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has become a key technology for serving large-scale personalized large language models and diffusion models in the cloud. However, the co-occurrence patterns, resource contention relationships, and evolutionary regularities of adapters under production inference workloads have not been systematically or quantitatively studied. Based on GenTD26, Alibaba's production diffusion model inference dataset, this paper adopts a graph-theoretic framework to construct an adapter co-occurrence network and conducts a characterization from both static structure and dynamic evolution. Our main findings are as follows. (1) The co-occurrence network is extremely sparse, and adapter usage frequency follows a significant heavy-tailed distribution. item.title: 提出CSC框架，通过校准简洁性而非增加复杂性来解决大语言模型时代社交机器人检测中的模态冲突问题，即账户语义上像人类但图结构和跨模态一致性仍可疑的情况。
item.description:
CSC：面向大语言模型时代的冲突感知社交机器人检测的校准简洁性框架

CSC: Calibrated Simplicity for Conflict-Aware Social Bot Detection in the LLM Era

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23320

提出CSC框架，通过校准简洁性而非增加复杂性来解决大语言模型时代社交机器人检测中的模态冲突问题，即账户语义上像人类但图结构和跨模态一致性仍可疑的情况。

社交机器人检测对于保护在线平台免受虚假信息放大、协同操纵和公共舆论扭曲至关重要。然而，大语言模型使得仅从文本层面检测社交机器人变得困难得多，因为语义伪装如今变得廉价、流畅且可大规模扩展。由此带来的挑战是模态冲突：一个账户在语义上可能看起来像人类，但在图结构、个人资料属性或跨模态一致性方面仍然可疑。近期基于图的检测器通过增加图侧的复杂性来应对这一局限，例如稀疏原型选择、自适应门控或架构特定的控制逻辑，然而我们的实验表明，仅靠复杂性并非解决此类冲突最可靠的方式。因此，我们提出了CSC，一个面向大语言模型时代冲突感知社交机器人检测的校准简洁性框架。该框架结合了三项设计选择：一个简化的...

arXiv:2609.23320v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Social bot detection is essential for protecting online platforms from misinformation amplification, coordinated manipulation, and distorted public discourse. However, large language models have made social bots much harder to detect from text alone because semantic camouflage is now cheap, fluent, and scalable. The resulting challenge is modality conflict: an account may look human-like in semantics while remaining suspicious in graph structure, profile attributes, or cross-modal consistency. Recent graph-based detectors tackle this limitation by adding graph-side complexity, such as sparse prototype selection, adaptive gating, or architecture-specific control logic, yet our experiments suggest that complexity alone is not the most reliable way to resolve such conflict. item.title: 针对因QK归一化等技术导致注意力汇聚减弱的现代大语言模型，提出基于价值向量与缓存均值L2偏差进行token排序的ValueDiff淘汰方法，在2k-4k token预算下可保留密集注意力88-99%的性能。
item.description:
ValueDiff：面向注意力汇聚抑制型大语言模型的价值几何KV缓存淘汰方法

ValueDiff: Value-Geometric KV Cache Eviction for Sink-Suppressed LLMs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23314

针对因QK归一化等技术导致注意力汇聚减弱的现代大语言模型，提出基于价值向量与缓存均值L2偏差进行token排序的ValueDiff淘汰方法，在2k-4k token预算下可保留密集注意力88-99%的性能。

采用QK归一化、门控注意力、可学习注意力汇聚或logit软截断的现代大语言模型表现出更弱的持久注意力汇聚现象，而现有的KV缓存淘汰方法主要依赖这一现象。我们观察到，在这些模型中，更弱的汇聚现象伴随着相对于键向量离散度而言更大的价值向量离散度。受这种价值侧离散度的启发，我们提出了ValueDiff，一种价值几何淘汰方法，它根据token的价值向量与缓存均值之间的L2偏差对token进行排序。在关于未来注意力的最大熵假设下，同样的分数可作为最小扰动淘汰方案推导得出。我们在固定缓存预算下进行评估，在预填充阶段的每个块边界以及生成阶段的每个解码步骤执行淘汰。在RULER基准上，在紧凑的2k token预算下，ValueDiff在七个汇聚抑制模型上保留了密集注意力88--99%的性能（在7个模型中的6个上表现最佳）。在LongBench基准上，在4k预算下，ValueDiff平均保留92%的性能。

arXiv:2609.23314v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern LLMs with QK-normalization, gated attention, learned attention sinks, or logit softcapping exhibit weaker persistent attention sinks, on which existing KV cache eviction methods primarily rely. We observe that across these models, weaker sinks co-occur with greater value-vector dispersion relative to key-vector dispersion. Motivated by this value-side dispersion, we present ValueDiff, a value-geometric eviction that ranks tokens by the L2 deviation of their value vectors from the cache mean. The same score arises as the minimal-disturbance eviction under a max-entropy assumption about future attention. We evaluate under fixed cache budgets, with eviction at every block boundary during prefill and at every decoding step during generation. item.title: 该论文提出了OMST方法，将分层抽样建模为特征图上的路径选择问题，并通过精确的方差最小化二元优化求解，在不增加样本量的前提下显著提升在线A/B实验的统计功效，同时保持分层规则的可解释性。
item.description:
在线受控实验中用于分层抽样的最优多路决策树

Optimal Multi-way Decision Trees for Stratified Sampling in Online Controlled Experiments

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23308

该论文提出了OMST方法，将分层抽样建模为特征图上的路径选择问题，并通过精确的方差最小化二元优化求解，在不增加样本量的前提下显著提升在线A/B实验的统计功效，同时保持分层规则的可解释性。

在线受控实验（即A/B测试）被广泛用于估计数字平台上的因果效应。一个核心挑战是在不增加实验样本量的情况下提高实验的灵敏度（即统计功效）。分层抽样是一种经典的方差缩减技术；然而，其有效性在很大程度上取决于分层（层组）的构建方式。因此，我们提出了一种基于优化的分层抽样框架，利用最优多路决策树来实现分层。我们的方法称为最优多路分层树（Optimal Multi-way Stratification Trees，OMST），将分层问题建模为特征图上的路径选择问题。所选路径定义了可解释的分层规则，并通过精确的方差最小化二元优化公式进行求解，采用了连续比例分配以及Neyman型最优分配。我们引入有监督的最优分箱技术来生成与结果相关的（此处摘要内容不完整）

arXiv:2609.23308v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Online controlled experiments, or A/B tests, are widely used to estimate causal effects on digital platforms. A central challenge is to improve experimental sensitivity, or statistical power, without increasing the experimental sample size. Stratified sampling is a classical variance reduction technique; however, its effectiveness depends critically on how the strata are constructed. We thus propose an optimization-based stratification framework for stratified sampling using optimal multi-way decision trees. Our method, called Optimal Multi-way Stratification Trees (OMST), formulates stratification as a path-selection problem over a feature graph. The selected paths define interpretable stratification rules and are optimized using an exact variance-minimizing binary optimization formulation under continuous proportional allocation and a Neyman-type optimal allocation. item.title: Count Flow Map 是一种直接在计数空间中学习有限时间随机转移的生成模型，通过泊松出生与二项死亡机制保持非负整数计数，实现一步或少数几步的高效计数数据生成。
item.description:
面向计数数据的随机流映射

Stochastic Flow Map for Count Data

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23290

Count Flow Map 是一种直接在计数空间中学习有限时间随机转移的生成模型，通过泊松出生与二项死亡机制保持非负整数计数，实现一步或少数几步的高效计数数据生成。

高维计数数据在科学应用中十分常见，但大多数扩散模型和流模型是为连续数据或分类数据设计的，且生成过程通常需要多次顺序模型评估。我们提出了 Count Flow Map，这是一种直接在计数空间中学习有限时间转移的生成模型，可实现一步或少数几步生成。我们的模型直接学习有限时间区间上的随机转移，利用泊松出生和二项死亡过程来保持非负整数计数，且无需预先定义最大值。这些转移模型经过训练以匹配底层的局部生灭动力学，并在不同步长之间保持一致性。我们刻画了局部动力学与有限时间转移一致性之间的联系，并推导了生成误差的界。在包括高维、高计数设置在内的多个模拟中验证 Count Flow Map 之后，我们将其应用于单细胞药物（响应）……

arXiv:2609.23290v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: High-dimensional count data are common in scientific applications, but most diffusion and flow models are designed for continuous or categorical data, and generation often requires many sequential model evaluations. We propose Count Flow Map, a generative model that learns finite-time transitions directly in count space for one- or few-step generation. Our model directly learns stochastic transitions over finite time intervals, using Poisson births and Binomial deaths to preserve nonnegative integer counts without a predefined maximum. These transition models are trained to match the underlying local birth--death dynamics and to maintain consistency across step sizes. We characterize the connection between local dynamics and finite-time transition consistency and derive a bound on the generation error. After validating Count Flow Map in several simulations, including a high-dimensional, high-count setting, we apply it to single-cell dr

item.title: 提出“潜在心灵感应”方法，让每个机器人直接广播其自监督编码器产生的感知潜向量作为通信内容，无需额外计算且仅占用单个紧凑向量的带宽，使队友能够仅凭任务奖励学会利用这些感知信息，解决了去中心化多机器人系统中感知内容无法传递的问题。
item.description:
潜在心灵感应：基于自监督感知潜向量的多机器人通信

Latent Telepathy: Multi-Robot Communication with Self-Supervised Perceptual Latents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23269

提出“潜在心灵感应”方法，让每个机器人直接广播其自监督编码器产生的感知潜向量作为通信内容，无需额外计算且仅占用单个紧凑向量的带宽，使队友能够仅凭任务奖励学会利用这些感知信息，解决了去中心化多机器人系统中感知内容无法传递的问题。

在部分可观测环境下的去中心化多机器人团队中，决定机器人下一步行动的关键信息往往只有其队友才能观测到。现有的去中心化方法传递的是运动学信息，例如位置或规划轨迹，这些信息无法传达队友所感知到的内容。多智能体强化学习（MARL）中的学习型通信虽然可以携带感知内容，但由此产生的消息与任务耦合且不透明。我们提出潜在心灵感应方法：每个机器人广播其已经为自身使用而计算的感知潜向量——即由自监督联合嵌入预测目标训练的编码器的输出，该编码器被冻结并在整个团队中共享。队友仅通过任务奖励即可学习如何基于该信息采取行动。由于编码器本来就在为感知而运行，这种消息不产生额外的计算成本，且带宽仅为单个紧凑向量。由于编码器在任何策略训练之前就被冻结……

arXiv:2609.23269v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In a decentralized multi-robot team under partial observability, the fact that decides a robot's next action is often visible only to a teammate. Existing decentralized methods communicate kinematic information, such as position or planned trajectory, which cannot convey what the teammate perceives. Learned communication in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) can carry perceptual content, but the resulting messages are task-coupled and opaque. We propose Latent Telepathy. Each robot broadcasts the perceptual latent vector it already computes for its own use, the output of an encoder trained with a self-supervised joint-embedding predictive objective, frozen, and shared across the team. A teammate learns to act on it from task reward alone. Because the encoder already runs for perception, the message costs no additional computation and a single compact vector of bandwidth. Because the encoder is frozen before any policy is trained

item.title: 该论文针对前缀反馈下的重复先知不等式问题，提出结合经验逆向归纳、盒子可达奖励与相对下降聚合规则的高效算法，实现了匹配下界的 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$ 期望遗憾并消除了对盒子数量的多项式依赖，解决了 Liu 等人（2025）提出的开放问题。
item.description:
重复先知不等式的最优无遗憾学习

Optimal No-Regret Learning for Repeated Prophet Inequality

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23265

该论文针对前缀反馈下的重复先知不等式问题，提出结合经验逆向归纳、盒子可达奖励与相对下降聚合规则的高效算法，实现了匹配下界的 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$ 期望遗憾并消除了对盒子数量的多项式依赖，解决了 Liu 等人（2025）提出的开放问题。

我们研究前缀反馈下的重复先知不等式问题。在 $T$ 轮中的每一轮，学习者按固定顺序遇到从 $n$ 个盒子中独立抽取的新值，这些盒子服从未知的 $[0,1]$ 支撑分布，学习者必须不可撤销地接受其中一个，且只能观察到直到其停止盒子为止的前缀信息。遗憾度相对于知道分布的最优停止策略来度量。我们给出了一种高效算法，实现了 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$ 的期望遗憾，在对数因子范围内匹配了下界。我们的算法通过近优策略直接进行探索，将经验逆向归纳与针对各盒子的可达奖励相结合。随后，一种相对下降聚合规则利用观测前缀的嵌套结构来保持探索性，从而消除了对盒子数量 $n$ 的多项式依赖。这解决了 Liu 等人（2025）提出的一个开放问题。

arXiv:2609.23265v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study repeated prophet inequalities under prefix feedback. In each of $T$ rounds, a learner encounters fresh values drawn independently from $n$ boxes with unknown $[0,1]$-supported distributions in a fixed order and must irrevocably accept one, observing only the prefix up to its stopping box. Regret is measured against the optimal stopping policy that knows the distributions. We give an efficient algorithm achieving $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$ expected regret, matching the lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Our algorithm explores directly through near-optimal policies, combining empirical backward induction with box-specific reach bonuses. A relative-drop aggregation rule then exploits the nesting structure of observed prefixes to preserve exploration, thereby removing the polynomial dependence on the box number $n$. This resolves an open question posed by Liu et al. (2025).

item.title: 该论文通过学习动力学推导出链式跨任务核，首次从数学上严格解释了阈下学习中幽灵输出如何借助共享主干表征实现跨任务能力迁移的优化机制。
item.description:
为什么幽灵输出能够教学：基于核函数的阈下学习理解

Why Ghost Outputs Teach: A Kernel-Based Understanding of Subliminal Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23260

该论文通过学习动力学推导出链式跨任务核，首次从数学上严格解释了阈下学习中幽灵输出如何借助共享主干表征实现跨任务能力迁移的优化机制。

阈下学习（Subliminal Learning, SL）是最近被发现的一种现象：学生模型通过匹配来自教师的看似无关的辅助输出，即可获得下游任务能力，尽管它从未观察到任务标签、任务特定输出或原始训练数据。尽管近期研究已确定阈下信号可能存在的位置，但这一现象背后的优化机制仍知之甚少。在本工作中，我们通过学习动力学的视角为阈下学习提供了机制性理解。具体而言，我们推导出一个链式跨任务核，它通过共享的主干表征，显式地将幽灵输出监督与任务预测的变化联系起来。我们的统一分析框架为阈下学习中的三个核心经验谜题提供了严格的数学解释：（i）在共享初始化下，迁移算子形成严格半正定（PSD）结构，保证了……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.23260v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Subliminal Learning (SL) is a recently identified phenomenon in which a student model acquires downstream task capabilities by matching seemingly unrelated auxiliary outputs from a teacher, despite never observing task labels, task-specific outputs, or the original training data. While recent studies have identified where subliminal signals may reside, the optimization mechanism underlying this phenomenon remains poorly understood. In this work, we provide a mechanistic understanding of SL through the lens of learning dynamics. Specifically, we derive a chained cross-task kernel that explicitly links ghost-output supervision to changes in task predictions through shared backbone representations. Our unified analytical framework provides a rigorous mathematical explanation for three central empirical puzzles in SL: (i) under shared initialization, the transfer operator forms a strictly Positive Semi-Definite (PSD) structure, guaranteeing

item.title: CTRL框架将语义推理与定量预测解耦，利用LLM智能体作为控制器分析预测误差的分解成分并输出控制信号，再由轻量级残差解码器转化为预测修正，从而提升非平稳环境下时间序列预测的稳定性与可解释性。
item.description:
CTRL：基于控制的时间序列预测与LLM引导的残差学习

CTRL: Control-Based Time Series Forecasting with LLM-Guided Residual Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23257

CTRL框架将语义推理与定量预测解耦，利用LLM智能体作为控制器分析预测误差的分解成分并输出控制信号，再由轻量级残差解码器转化为预测修正，从而提升非平稳环境下时间序列预测的稳定性与可解释性。

时间序列预测是跨多个领域关键决策的基础。尽管大语言模型（LLM）提供了有前景的推理能力，但现有的基于LLM的时间序列预测方法要么将其简化为绕过其优势的数值预测器，要么允许直接生成预测，导致在非平稳环境中预测不稳定。我们提出了CTRL，一个将语义推理与定量预测解耦的框架。冻结的主干模型生成基础预测，而专门的LLM智能体充当控制器，通过分解的趋势、季节性和不规则成分来分析主干预测误差，将推理建立在可解释的时间结构之上。每个智能体输出紧凑的控制信号，由轻量级残差解码器将其转化为预测修正。CTRL还集成了无标签的测试时自适应机制，可从输入统计信息中检测分布偏移。

arXiv:2609.23257v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Time series forecasting underpins critical decision-making across diverse domains. While large language models (LLMs) offer promising reasoning capabilities, existing LLM-based time series forecasting approaches either reduce them to numerical predictors that bypass their strengths, or allow direct forecast generation that destabilizes predictions in non-stationary settings. We introduce CTRL, a framework that decouples semantic reasoning from quantitative prediction. A frozen backbone generates base forecasts, while specialized LLM agents function as controllers that analyze backbone prediction errors through decomposed trend, seasonal, and irregular components, grounding reasoning in interpretable temporal structure. Each agent outputs compact control signals that a lightweight residual decoder translates into forecast corrections. CTRL incorporates label-free test-time adaptation that detects distribution shift from input statistics

item.title: 该论文揭示自校准监测器的长期误报率保证本质上是一种与检测目标无关的会计恒等式，并给出精确的证据预算——阶跃漂移造成约 δ/η 的超额报警质量、斜坡漂移造成恰好 c/η 的平稳超额报警率，且窗口报警率的波动为 1/L 量级而非二项式的 1/√L。
item.description:
自校准的代价：自适应监测中的精确证据预算与人为制造的盲集

The Price of Self-Calibration: Exact Evidence Budgets and Manufactured Blind Sets in Adaptive Monitoring

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23254

该论文揭示自校准监测器的长期误报率保证本质上是一种与检测目标无关的会计恒等式，并给出精确的证据预算——阶跃漂移造成约 δ/η 的超额报警质量、斜坡漂移造成恰好 c/η 的平稳超额报警率，且窗口报警率的波动为 1/L 量级而非二项式的 1/√L。

自校准监测器在线调整其阈值，以保证在任意漂移下达到预设的长期误报率。我们计算了这一保证的代价，并对每条定律给出其精确的适用范围。首先，该保证本质上是一种会计恒等式，对监测器所要检测的对象并不敏感。两条证据恒等式使在线分位数追踪器的代价变得精确：高度为 δ 的持续性阶跃漂移产生的超额报警质量在一报警量内为 δ/η，而当 δ 是增益 η 的格点倍数时，逐路径地恰为 δ/η；斜率为 c 的斜坡漂移产生恰好为 c/η 的平稳超额报警率，与累积规模无关，直至边界 c = η(1-α)，该边界恰与报警率上限重合。其次，该保证证书自身的波动服从一条精确定律：窗口化报警率的标准差为 1/L 量级，而非二项式的 1/√L 量级，因为窗口化质量具有伸缩相消（telescoping）性质。

arXiv:2609.23254v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Self-calibrating monitors adapt their threshold online to guarantee a prescribed long-run false-alarm rate under arbitrary drift. We compute the price of that guarantee, stating every law with its exact domain of validity. First, the guarantee is an accounting identity, insensitive to what the monitor is meant to detect. Two evidence identities make the cost exact for the online quantile tracker: a persistent step of height $\delta$ yields excess alarm mass within one alarm of $\delta/\eta$, and exactly $\delta/\eta$ pathwise when $\delta$ is a lattice multiple of the gain $\eta$; a ramp of slope $c$ yields a stationary excess rate of exactly $c/\eta$, independent of accumulated size, up to a boundary $c=\eta(1-\alpha)$ coinciding with the alarm-rate cap. Second, the certificate's own fluctuation obeys an exact law: the windowed alarm rate has standard deviation of order $1/L$, not the binomial $1/\sqrt{L}$, since the windowed mass teles

item.title: 本文揭示了机器人世界模型对动作参数化方式（绝对关节目标与相对增量）不具备不变性——即使两种编码在信息上完全等价（可相互重建），切换参数化方式也会导致模型灾难性崩溃而非优雅退化。
item.description:
机器人世界模型对动作的书写方式不具备不变性

Robot World Models Are Not Invariant to How the Actions Are Written

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23252

本文揭示了机器人世界模型对动作参数化方式（绝对关节目标与相对增量）不具备不变性——即使两种编码在信息上完全等价（可相互重建），切换参数化方式也会导致模型灾难性崩溃而非优雅退化。

机器人策略通常采用两种动作参数化方式之一进行训练：绝对关节目标，或相对于当前状态的增量。这一选择是机器人学习中的一个现实工程决策，而以动作为条件的世界模型会默默继承这一选择。我们证明这种继承是灾难性的。在一个参数化上训练的潜在动力学模型，若被给予以另一种参数化书写的完全相同的指令轨迹，会发生崩溃：在三个机器人数据集和两种机器人形态上，检索性能下降2.6-13.4倍；目标条件下的动作选择成功率从53%降至15%；在PushT任务上，关于同一未来的两种信念几乎正交（cos = 0.067，最差情况为-0.377），因此预测器并非优雅地退化，而是在回答一个不同的问题。这并非通常意义上的分布偏移伪影：给定联合输入，两种编码可以相互重建（R² = 0.996），因此没有任何信息丢失。

arXiv:2609.23252v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A robot policy is trained with one of two action parameterizations: absolute joint targets, or deltas relative to the current state. The choice is a live engineering decision in robot learning, and a world model conditioned on actions inherits it silently. We show the inheritance is catastrophic. A latent dynamics model trained on one parameterization and handed the identical commanded trajectory written in the other collapses: retrieval degrades by 2.6-13.4x across three robot datasets and two morphologies, goal-conditioned action selection falls from 53% to 15%, and on PushT the two beliefs about the same future are near-orthogonal (cos = 0.067, worst case -0.377), so the predictor does not degrade gracefully, it answers a different question. This is not a distribution-shift artifact in the usual sense: the two encodings are mutually reconstructible at R^2 = 0.996 given the joint input, so no information is lost, and we give the test

item.title: 提出近端残差价值函数的端到端强化学习方法，将严格凸势函数与可学习的凸残差结合，实现了规划层与实时执行层在双时间尺度决策系统中的决策一致性，并在电商库存分配场景中验证了有效性。
item.description:
用于一致规划与实时执行的近端残差价值函数

Proximal Residual Value Functions for Consistent Planning and Real-Time Execution

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23242

提出近端残差价值函数的端到端强化学习方法，将严格凸势函数与可学习的凸残差结合，实现了规划层与实时执行层在双时间尺度决策系统中的决策一致性，并在电商库存分配场景中验证了有效性。

我们研究双时间尺度决策系统，其中规划层周期性地向实时优化器提供延续价值函数，实时优化器负责分配到达的资源，并以库存放置作为我们的驱动应用场景。我们提出一种端到端强化学习（RL）方法来学习该函数，其核心是近端残差价值函数——它将决策后库存的严格凸势函数与学习得到的凸残差相结合。这种一般化形式产生了一个适定的优化层，既支持端到端微分，又为实时执行保留了显式的凸目标函数。我们刻画了平滑价值函数在规划与执行两个时间尺度上产生一致决策的充分必要条件。在基于某大型电商零售商历史库存到达与需求模式的离线仿真中，学习到的近端残差价值函数……

arXiv:2609.23242v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study two-timescale decision systems in which a planning layer periodically supplies a continuation-value function to a real-time optimizer that allocates arriving resources, with inventory placement as our motivating application. We propose an end-to-end reinforcement learning (RL) method for learning this function using \emph{proximal residual value functions}, which combine a strictly convex potential of post-decision inventory with a learned convex residual. This general form yields a well-posed optimization layer that supports end-to-end differentiation while preserving an explicit convex objective for real-time execution. We characterize the necessary and sufficient conditions under which a smooth value function yields decisions that are consistent across the planning and execution timescales. In an offline simulation using historical inventory arrival and demand patterns from a large e-commerce retailer, learned proximal residu

item.title: 该论文在多组图对上系统比较了贝叶斯图对齐的多种收敛诊断方法，发现没有任何单一诊断在所有采样器和场景下占优，且在大规模图中诊断只能预测后续边缘变化而非后验误差。
item.description:
审计贝叶斯图对齐：诊断方法比较与参考失效

Auditing Bayesian Graph Alignment: Diagnostic Comparisons and Reference Failure

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23232

该论文在多组图对上系统比较了贝叶斯图对齐的多种收敛诊断方法，发现没有任何单一诊断在所有采样器和场景下占优，且在大规模图中诊断只能预测后续边缘变化而非后验误差。

贝叶斯图对齐用于估计对应关系概率，但对齐分数轨迹的收敛并不必然意味着对应边缘分布的准确。我们在240对来自四个源族的新精确图对、240对具有20-100个顶点的更大规模图对，以及一个独立的60例精确实现检验上审计了这一差距。在显式的边翻转似然下，我们比较了三种采样器以及基于分数、边缘、指示器、类别和分类器的诊断方法。对于精确知情采样器，边缘分歧在错误判别上优于分数R-hat，但其对普通局部采样的改进尚不确定。基于分配的R*和短指示器面板具有竞争力；没有任何一种诊断方法在所有采样器和端点上占优。在更大规模下，诊断方法预测的是后续边缘变化而非后验误差，且分类性能取决于漂移阈值。不相交窗口和留出链检验减弱了……（原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.23232v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Bayesian graph alignment estimates correspondence probabilities, but convergence of an alignment-score trace need not imply accurate correspondence marginals. We audit this gap on 240 new exact graph pairs from four source families, 240 larger pairs with 20-100 vertices, and a separate 60-case exact implementation check. Under an explicit edge-flip likelihood, we compare three samplers and score, marginal, indicator, categorical, and classifier-based diagnostics. Marginal disagreement improves error discrimination over score R-hat for the exact informed sampler, but its improvement for vanilla local sampling is uncertain. Assignment-based R* and short indicator panels are competitive; no diagnostic dominates across samplers and endpoints. At larger sizes, diagnostics predict subsequent marginal changes, not posterior error, and classification performance depends on the drift threshold. Disjoint-window and held-out-chain checks attenuat

item.title: 提出基于价差的时间层级预测框架THieF，通过联合协调小时电价与日内价差预测，在欧洲电力市场实现最高19.7%的准确率提升和10.4%的电池套利利润增长。
item.description:
窃取利润：面向日前电力市场的基于价差的时间层级预测

Stealing profits: Spread-based temporal hierarchy forecasting for day-ahead electricity markets

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23223

提出基于价差的时间层级预测框架THieF，通过联合协调小时电价与日内价差预测，在欧洲电力市场实现最高19.7%的准确率提升和10.4%的电池套利利润增长。

日前电价预测为交易和储能决策提供支持，但对于电池套利而言，预测日内价差比预测单个小时价格更为重要。本文表明，一种时间层级预测（THieF）框架通过联合协调小时电价预测与所有日内价差预测，在两个主要欧洲电力市场和三种不同预测架构上均能持续提升性能。基于德国和西班牙五年的样本外数据，相对于未协调的小时电价预测，我们获得了高达19.7%的准确率提升和高达10.4%的利润增长。即使对于高精度的预训练TabPFN基础模型，这些收益依然存在。我们的结果表明，利用经济相关预测目标之间的一致性关系，可以同时提升预测准确性和决策价值，并且更好的统计（原文在此截断）

arXiv:2609.23223v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Day-ahead electricity price forecasts support trading and storage decisions, but for battery arbitrage predicting intraday price spreads is more relevant than predicting individual hourly prices. Here we show that a temporal hierarchy forecasting (THieF) framework that jointly reconciles forecasts of hourly electricity prices and all intraday price spreads consistently improves performance across two major European electricity markets and three different forecasting architectures. Using five years of out-of-sample data from Germany and Spain, we obtain accuracy improvements of up to 19.7% and profit gains of up to 10.4% relative to unreconciled hourly price forecasts. The gains persist even for a highly accurate pretrained TabPFN foundation model. Our results demonstrate that exploiting coherent relationships between economically relevant forecasting targets can improve both predictive accuracy and decision value, and that better stati

item.title: 本文提出用混合学习的视角处理因果推断中的未观测混杂问题，将潜在混杂视为数据异质性的来源，通过恢复混合分布与成分机制来估计干预分布和因果估计量，并将该框架与面板数据中的潜在因子模型和合成干预方法相联系，进一步拓展到对反事实分布（而非仅均值）的建模。
item.description:
具有未观测混杂因素的因果推断：一种混合学习视角

Causal Inference with Unobserved Confounding: A Mixture Learning Perspective

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23219

本文提出用混合学习的视角处理因果推断中的未观测混杂问题，将潜在混杂视为数据异质性的来源，通过恢复混合分布与成分机制来估计干预分布和因果估计量，并将该框架与面板数据中的潜在因子模型和合成干预方法相联系，进一步拓展到对反事实分布（而非仅均值）的建模。

未观测混杂因素是从观测数据进行因果推断中的一个根本性挑战。本文发展了一种混合学习视角，将潜在混杂因素视为异质性的来源，这种异质性会在观测数据中诱导出混合结构。在适当的结构性和可识别性假设下，恢复混合分布及各成分机制能够实现对干预分布和因果估计量的估计。以伯努利混合的多种变体作为贯穿全文的示例，我们将混合学习技术及其结构假设置于具体情境中，并将其与面板数据设置中的因果推断联系起来，包括潜在因子模型和合成干预。随后，我们考虑了具有相依结果轨迹的高维指数族混合模型，超越反事实均值，对反事实分布进行建模。我们将这一视角与处理未观测混杂的其他互补方法进行了比较定位。

arXiv:2609.23219v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unobserved confounding is a fundamental challenge in causal inference from observational data. This article develops a mixture-learning perspective, viewing latent confounders as sources of heterogeneity that induce mixture structure in observed data. Under suitable structural and identifiability assumptions, recovering the mixing distribution and component mechanisms enables estimation of interventional distributions and causal estimands. Using variants of Bernoulli mixtures as a running example, we contextualize mixture-learning techniques and their structural assumptions, and connect them to causal inference in panel-data settings, including latent factor models and synthetic interventions.We then consider high-dimensional exponential-family mixtures with dependent outcome trajectories, moving beyond counterfactual means to model counterfactual distributions. item.title: 该研究通过黑盒触发器审计LLM解释器对主动推理智能体的解释报告，发现解释器无法检测被污染的观测数据，甚至在智能体出错时以80-95%的概率产生谄媚性合理化解释，揭示了LLM可解释性监督机制的关键失效风险。
item.description:
主动推理智能体中基于大语言模型的可解释性失效的触发器与诊断方法

Triggers and Diagnostics for LLM-Based Interpretability Failures in Active Inference Agents

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23215

该研究通过黑盒触发器审计LLM解释器对主动推理智能体的解释报告，发现解释器无法检测被污染的观测数据，甚至在智能体出错时以80-95%的概率产生谄媚性合理化解释，揭示了LLM可解释性监督机制的关键失效风险。

大语言模型（LLM）解释器越来越多地被附加到自主智能体上作为运行时监督手段，操作员阅读的是对智能体信念和行动的生成式描述，而非其内部状态。我们对这种描述本身进行审计：将一个跟踪德国电网需求并调整发电的主动推理（AIF）智能体与基于三种后端（GPT-4o、Claude-3-Opus、Gemini）的LLM解释器配对，并用三种黑盒触发器对该组合进行探测。以每步600 MW的幅度污染观测流会使智能体的后验偏移490 MW，约为电网容量的0.9%。在注入期间产生的30份解释中，没有任何一份在既定评分标准下标记出任何异常，且每一份都流畅地叙述了被污染的信念。在智能体采取客观错误行动的时间步上，三种解释器在80-95%的情况下（每个后端n=20）都会产生谄媚性的合理化解释。观测元数据字段中攻击者控制的文本会引导解释器……

arXiv:2609.23215v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM explainers are increasingly attached to autonomous agents as runtime oversight, with operators reading a generated account of the agent's beliefs and actions rather than its internal state. We audit the account itself, pairing an Active Inference (AIF) agent that tracks German grid demand and adjusts generation with an LLM explainer on three backends (GPT-4o, Claude-3-Opus, Gemini), and probing the pair with three black-box triggers. Corrupting the observation stream by 600 MW per step moves the agent's posterior by 490 MW, roughly 0.9% of grid capacity. None of the 30 explanations produced during the injection flag anything under a stated rubric, and each narrates the corrupted belief fluently. On timesteps where the agent takes an objectively wrong action, all three explainers produce a sycophantic rationalization 80-95% of the time (n = 20 per backend). item.title: 该论文提出B-DOR，将基于纸牌的序数回归概率化为贝叶斯框架，通过累积链接似然将空白纸牌数量与潜在价值差异关联，并提供哈密顿蒙特卡洛采样和约束凸优化两种推断算法以支持序贯偏好引出。
item.description:
基于纸牌的贝叶斯序数回归与序贯偏好引出方法

Bayesian Deck-of-cards-based Ordinal Regression with Sequential Preference Elicitation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23212

该论文提出B-DOR，将基于纸牌的序数回归概率化为贝叶斯框架，通过累积链接似然将空白纸牌数量与潜在价值差异关联，并提供哈密顿蒙特卡洛采样和约束凸优化两种推断算法以支持序贯偏好引出。

基于纸牌的序数回归（DOR）从参考备选方案的排序中推断价值函数，其中决策者（DM）在相邻等级之间插入空白纸牌以表达偏好强度。DOR及其随机扩展（SMAA-DOR）将这些回答视为硬约束，从而定义一组兼容的价值函数。我们提出B-DOR，这是DOR的一种概率化重构，其中每对相邻等级产生一个序数观测，即声明的偏好方向和纸牌数量，并通过累积链接似然函数建模，将空白纸牌数量与备选方案之间的潜在价值差异联系起来。论文提出了两种贝叶斯推断算法：BAYES-DOR通过哈密顿蒙特卡洛（HMC）采样整个后验分布；FTRL-DOR通过约束凸优化跟踪最大后验估计。此外，通过多步骤的引出过程，引出……

arXiv:2609.23212v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Deck-of-cards-based Ordinal Regression (DOR) infers a value function from a ranking of reference alternatives in which the Decision Maker (DM) inserts blank cards between consecutive levels to express preference intensity. DOR, and its stochastic extension (SMAA-DOR), treat these answers as hard constraints defining a set of compatible value functions. We propose B-DOR, a probabilistic reformulation of DOR in which each pair of adjacent levels yields an ordinal observation, the declared direction and the number of cards, modelled through a cumulative-link likelihood that relates the number of blank cards to the latent value difference between alternatives. Two Bayesian inference algorithms are proposed: BAYES-DOR samples the whole posterior distribution by Hamiltonian Monte Carlo; FTRL-DOR tracks the maximum a posteriori estimate by constrained convex optimization. item.title: 提出SDC-GON网络，通过奇异分解处理格林函数在源点附近的奇异行为，并通过一致性正则化显式保证格林函数与其梯度之间的一致性，在统一框架内提升线性偏微分方程的求解能力。
item.description:
SDC-GON：用于求解偏微分方程的奇异分解与一致性正则化格林算子网络

SDC-GON: Singular Decomposition and Consistency-Regularized Green's Operator Networks for Solving Partial Differential Equations

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23206

提出SDC-GON网络，通过奇异分解处理格林函数在源点附近的奇异行为，并通过一致性正则化显式保证格林函数与其梯度之间的一致性，在统一框架内提升线性偏微分方程的求解能力。

基于格林函数的算子近似为求解在不同边界条件和源项下的线性偏微分方程提供了一条高效途径。一旦学习到格林函数，对于新配置的解便可通过积分获得，而无需再次求解微分方程。现有的格林函数学习方法面临两个结构性挑战：其一是格林函数在源点附近的奇异行为，这给神经网络带来了困难的近似负担；其二是学习到的格林函数与其梯度之间缺乏显式的一致性，尽管这两个量都直接参与积分解的表示。本工作提出了SDC-GON，一种奇异分解与一致性正则化的格林算子网络，在统一框架内同时应对这两个挑战。格林函数被分解为一个……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.23206v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Green's function based operator approximation offers an efficient route for solving linear partial differential equations under varying boundary conditions and source terms. Once the Green's function is learned, solutions for new configurations are obtained through integration rather than by solving the differential equation again. Existing Green's function learning methods face two structural challenges. The first is the singular behavior of the Green's function near the source point, which places a difficult approximation burden on neural networks. The second is the absence of explicit consistency between the learned Green's function and its gradient, although both quantities enter the integral solution representation directly. This work proposes SDC-GON, a Singular Decomposition and Consistency-Regularized Green's Operator Network that addresses both challenges within a unified framework. item.title: 提出了一种结合U-Net像素空间残差校正与保证自编码器（GAE）的后处理流水线，在保证误差界限的前提下显著提升基于RVQ的科学数据压缩重建质量。
item.description:
保证误差界限下用于科学数据压缩的神经残差建模

Neural Residual Modeling for Scientific Data Compression under Guaranteed Error Bounds

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23185

提出了一种结合U-Net像素空间残差校正与保证自编码器（GAE）的后处理流水线，在保证误差界限的前提下显著提升基于RVQ的科学数据压缩重建质量。

arXiv:2609.23185v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：科学仿真数据的有损压缩越来越依赖于学习型潜在空间架构，例如残差向量量化（RVQ），它通过迭代量化基础表示及其残差来逐步降低重建误差。尽管有效，RVQ完全在潜在空间中进行残差建模，使得重建结果的像素空间误差结构在很大程度上未被处理。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个后处理流水线，通过一个训练用于预测并校正原始体数据与其RVQ重建结果之间像素空间残差的U-Net，来增强基于RVQ的压缩器。我们证明这些残差在空间上是有结构的，而非由局部强度或梯度特征所驱动，这说明了需要深度空间模型而非简单统计校正的必要性。经U-Net校正后的重建结果随后通过一个保证自编码器（GAE）阶段，该阶段将……

arXiv:2609.23185v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lossy compression of scientific simulation data increasingly relies on learned, latent-space architectures such as Residual Vector Quantization (RVQ), which iteratively quantize a base representation and its residuals to progressively reduce reconstruction error. While effective, RVQ performs this residual modeling entirely in latent space, leaving the pixel-space error structure of the reconstruction largely unaddressed. In this work, we propose a post-processing pipeline that augments an RVQ-based compressor with a U-Net trained to predict and correct pixel-space residuals between the original volume and its RVQ reconstruction. We show that these residuals are spatially structured rather than driven by local intensity or gradient features, motivating the need for a deep spatial model rather than simple statistical correction. item.title: K-TRAIL提出了一种仿真器引导的生成式设计框架，将扩散模型版图生成与无导数集合卡尔曼引导相结合，利用黑盒电磁仿真器的反馈实现无需可微分模型的电磁/射频电路自动化逆向设计。
item.description:
K-TRAIL：仿真器引导的电磁/射频电路生成式设计

K-TRAIL: Simulator-Guided Generative Design of EM/RF Circuits

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23183

K-TRAIL提出了一种仿真器引导的生成式设计框架，将扩散模型版图生成与无导数集合卡尔曼引导相结合，利用黑盒电磁仿真器的反馈实现无需可微分模型的电磁/射频电路自动化逆向设计。

射频（RF）与电磁（EM）电路的逆向设计极具挑战性，因为电路版图与电气响应之间的关系是非唯一的，且全波仿真的计算成本高昂。本文提出了K-TRAIL，一个用于自动化电磁/射频电路综合的仿真器引导生成式框架。K-TRAIL将基于扩散模型的版图生成与无导数集合卡尔曼引导相结合，使得黑盒电磁仿真器的反馈能够在生成过程中对候选版图进行精炼，而无需伴随灵敏度或可微分求解器模型。该框架既支持从预设的S参数响应进行综合，也支持直接从射频性能约束进行综合。在多层射频集成电路（RFIC）结构上的实验表明，仿真器引导的生成方法提高了与目标响应的一致性，并能识别出满足电路级设计要求的结构上各异的版图。

arXiv:2609.23183v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Inverse design of RF and electromagnetic (EM) circuits is challenging because the relationship between circuit layout and electrical response is non-unique, and full-wave simulation is computationally expensive. This paper presents K-TRAIL, a simulator-guided generative framework for automated EM/RF circuit synthesis. K-TRAIL combines diffusion-based layout generation with derivative-free ensemble Kalman guidance, allowing feedback from a black-box EM simulator to refine candidate layouts during generation without requiring adjoint sensitivities or differentiable solver models. The framework supports both synthesis from prescribed S-parameter responses and synthesis directly from RF performance constraints. Experiments on multi-layer RFIC structures show that simulator-guided generation improves agreement with target responses and can identify structurally distinct layouts that satisfy circuit-level design requirements. item.title: 该论文提出以保形分数为基本单元的分数校准鲁棒性框架，通过无分布保形校准将黑箱点预测器转化为决策相关的不确定性表示，统一支撑基于可靠性的鲁棒优化与保形鲁棒满意化，并引入保形脆弱性度量来量化性能随实际参数偏离预测而恶化的速度。
item.description:
预测驱动决策中的保形鲁棒性

Conformal Robustness in Prediction-Driven Decision-Making

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23170

该论文提出以保形分数为基本单元的分数校准鲁棒性框架，通过无分布保形校准将黑箱点预测器转化为决策相关的不确定性表示，统一支撑基于可靠性的鲁棒优化与保形鲁棒满意化，并引入保形脆弱性度量来量化性能随实际参数偏离预测而恶化的速度。

现代预测驱动的决策系统通常依赖黑箱预测器，但仅凭点预测无法提供鲁棒下游决策所需的不确定性尺度。我们构建了一个分数校准的鲁棒性框架，通过无分布假设的保形校准，将任意固定的点预测器转化为与决策相关的不确定性表示。我们以保形分数（而非特定不确定性集合）作为鲁棒性的基本单元。同一分数既可确定基于可靠性鲁棒优化中覆盖率校准的不确定性集合，又可在面向目标的公式化方法——保形鲁棒满意化中归一化目标违反程度。该公式化诱导出一种保形脆弱性度量，用以量化当实际参数在保形分数尺度上偏离预测时性能恶化的速度。对于满足标准凸性与对偶条件的客观不确定性问题……

arXiv:2609.23170v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Modern prediction-driven decision systems often rely on black-box predictors, but a point forecast alone does not provide the uncertainty scale required for robust downstream decision-making. We build a score-calibrated robustness framework that converts any fixed point predictor into a decision-relevant uncertainty representation through distribution-free conformal calibration. We use the conformal score, rather than a particular uncertainty set, as the primitive unit of robustness. The same score determines coverage-calibrated uncertainty sets for reliability-based robust optimization and normalizes target violations in a target-oriented formulation, Conformal Robust Satisficing. This formulation induces a conformal fragility measure that quantifies how rapidly performance deteriorates as the realized parameter departs from the forecast on the conformal score scale. item.title: 提出一种轻量级两阶段检测器，通过信号感知专家产生互补缺陷证据，并结合分层决策、混合状态门控和验证集选择的转移惩罚的时间后端来检测黑胶唱片缺陷状态，在合成基准上五分类宏F1达到0.730，显著优于帧级路由器。
item.description:
面向黑胶唱片缺陷状态检测的信号感知时间路由

Signal-Informed Temporal Routing for Vinyl Defect Regime Detection

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23164

提出一种轻量级两阶段检测器，通过信号感知专家产生互补缺陷证据，并结合分层决策、混合状态门控和验证集选择的转移惩罚的时间后端来检测黑胶唱片缺陷状态，在合成基准上五分类宏F1达到0.730，显著优于帧级路由器。

黑胶唱片修复系统在选择修复操作之前，必须区分孤立的咔哒声、短促的爆音、密集的裂纹噪声以及重叠损伤。我们提出了一种轻量级两阶段检测器，其中信号感知的稀疏、爆音和密集专家产生互补的缺陷证据，时间后端将这些证据转换为稳定的修复状态。该后端对五分类决策进行分层分解，应用仅在验证集上使用的混合状态门控，并采用验证集选择的转移惩罚进行解码，在相同的发射概率下，其性能优于最大似然转移矩阵。在一个由来自21个录音的597个不重叠15秒片段组成的源分离合成基准上，留出测试系统达到0.730的合并五分类宏F1（95%置信区间0.694-0.761），相比平坦的帧级路由器提升了0.043（配对自助法p=0.001）。干净帧和密集帧的检测高度可靠，而稀疏、爆音和混合状态（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.23164v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vinyl restoration systems must distinguish isolated clicks, short bursts, dense crackle, and overlapping damage before selecting a repair operation. We present a lightweight two-stage detector in which signal-informed sparse, burst, and dense experts produce complementary defect evidence, and a temporal backend converts that evidence into stable repair regimes. The backend factors the five-way decision hierarchically, applies a validation-only mixed regime gate, and decodes with validation-selected transition penalties that outperform a maximum-likelihood transition matrix on the same emissions. On a source-separated synthetic benchmark of 597 non-overlapping 15 s excerpts drawn from 21 recordings, the held-out system reaches 0.730 pooled five-class macro F1 (95% CI 0.694-0.761), an improvement of 0.043 over a flat frame-level router (paired bootstrap p=0.001). item.title: 该论文将Toscani-Fourier距离 $\mathrm T_{s,p}$ 确立为Wasserstein距离的低计算成本替代方案，精确刻画了其在 $\mathcal P_p(\mathbb R^d)$ 上的有限性窗口与完备度量结构，并证明其对Wasserstein距离的控制能力、在模型类上的拓扑等价性以及作为积分概率度量的对偶表示。
item.description:
概率测度上的Toscani-Fourier距离：Wasserstein控制、模型类上的拓扑等价性与对偶性

Toscani-Fourier Distance on Probability Measures: Wasserstein Control, Topological Equivalence on Model Classes, and Duality

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23163

该论文将Toscani-Fourier距离 $\mathrm T_{s,p}$ 确立为Wasserstein距离的低计算成本替代方案，精确刻画了其在 $\mathcal P_p(\mathbb R^d)$ 上的有限性窗口与完备度量结构，并证明其对Wasserstein距离的控制能力、在模型类上的拓扑等价性以及作为积分概率度量的对偶表示。

在机器学习中比较概率测度时，需要在传输几何与计算成本之间进行权衡：Wasserstein距离编码了 $\mathbb R^d$ 的几何结构，但需要求解一个传输问题；而核差异（kernel discrepancy）计算代价低廉，却对其测试函数类有着微妙的依赖。我们研究Toscani--Fourier距离族 $\mathrm T_{s,p}$，即两个特征函数之差的加权 $L^p$ 范数，将其作为 $\mathbb R^d$ 上一种连续的“傅里叶侧”差异度量。对于 $1\le p<\infty$，我们证明 $d/p<1+d/p$ 恰好是使 $\mathrm T_{s,p}$ 在 $\mathcal P_p(\mathbb R^d)$ 上有限的参数窗口，且在两个端点处即使对于一对Dirac测度该性质也已失效；我们建立了所得空间的度量、嵌入与紧性结构，并证明该空间是完备的。对偶性将 $\mathrm T_{s,p}$ 刻画为齐次傅里叶--Lebesgue球上的积分概率度量，并给出了显式的极值函数……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.23163v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Comparing probability measures in machine learning trades transport geometry against computational cost: Wasserstein distances encode the geometry of $\mathbb R^d$ but require solving a transport problem, while kernel discrepancies are cheap to evaluate yet depend delicately on their test class. We study the Toscani--Fourier family $\mathrm T_{s,p}$, the weighted $L^p$ norm of the difference of two characteristic functions, as a continuous Fourier-side discrepancy on $\mathbb R^d$. For $1\le p<\infty$ we show that $d/p<1+d/p$ is exactly the window in which $\mathrm T_{s,p}$ is finite on $\mathcal P_p(\mathbb R^d)$, both endpoints already failing for a pair of Dirac measures, and we establish the metric, embedding, and compactness structure of the resulting space, which we prove to be complete. Duality identifies $\mathrm T_{s,p}$ as an integral probability metric over a homogeneous Fourier--Lebesgue ball, with an explicit extremizer wh

item.title: 提出了首个面向非侵入式负荷监测的提示可编程基础模型FM4NILM，仅凭一个冻结模型即可通过自然语言提示和激活示例估计任意请求电器的功率轨迹，大幅降低了扩展电器覆盖范围的成本。
item.description:
询问任意电器：一个用于非侵入式负荷监测的提示可编程基础模型

Ask for Any Appliance: A Prompt-Programmable Foundation Model for Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23146

提出了首个面向非侵入式负荷监测的提示可编程基础模型FM4NILM，仅凭一个冻结模型即可通过自然语言提示和激活示例估计任意请求电器的功率轨迹，大幅降低了扩展电器覆盖范围的成本。

非侵入式负荷监测（NILM）从全屋电表数据估计电器级别的用电量，但针对特定电器的模型和固定的输出清单使得扩展覆盖范围成本高昂。我们提出了FM4NILM（NILM基础模型），这是一个单一的提示可编程模型，能够根据总用电测量数据、自然语言描述以及可选的电器激活示例，估计所请求电器的功率轨迹。一个轻量级的节奏感知Transformer在来自七个公共语料库、涵盖1-60秒采样间隔的64.5万个序列上通过掩码重建进行预训练，然后使用观察掩码损失在部分标注的家庭数据上与电器请求进行对齐。伯努利-对数正态解码器将活动检测与条件功率估计分离。在REDD、UK-DALE和REFIT的留出家庭和时间段上，一个冻结的文本提示模型即可服务于十二个电器-语料库请求，实现了0.556的事件F1……

arXiv:2609.23146v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM) estimates appliance-level consumption from a whole-home meter, but appliance-specific models and fixed output inventories make coverage costly to extend. We present FM4NILM (Foundation Model for NILM), a single prompt-programmable model that estimates a requested appliance's power trajectory from aggregate measurements, a natural-language description, and optional activation exemplars. A lightweight cadence-aware transformer is pretrained by masked reconstruction on 645k sequences from seven public corpora spanning 1-60 s sampling intervals, then aligned with appliance requests using observation-masked losses for partially labeled households. A Bernoulli-lognormal decoder separates activity detection from conditional power estimation. On held-out households and time periods from REDD, UK-DALE, and REFIT, one frozen text-prompted model serves twelve appliance-corpus requests, achieving 0.556 event F1,

item.title: 该研究提出一种端到端工作流程，通过QKeras量化感知训练与hls4ml综合将循环概率神经网络部署到FPGA上，实现了确定性的亚10微秒单步延迟，满足托卡马克等离子体实时控制需求。
item.description:
基于FPGA加速的量化循环概率神经网络的等离子体状态实时预测

Real-Time Plasma State Prediction via FPGA-Accelerated Quantized Recurrent Probabilistic Neural Networks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23141

该研究提出一种端到端工作流程，通过QKeras量化感知训练与hls4ml综合将循环概率神经网络部署到FPGA上，实现了确定性的亚10微秒单步延迟，满足托卡马克等离子体实时控制需求。

由于等离子体控制系统（PCS）对延迟的严格要求，面向托卡马克装置控制的等离子体状态实时估计极具挑战性。我们提出了一种将循环概率神经网络（RPNN）部署到FPGA硬件上的端到端工作流程。该方法将网络架构尺寸缩减与基于QKeras的量化感知训练相结合，随后使用hls4ml对模型进行综合，目标硬件为Xilinx Alveo U50设备。我们报告的设计在全部四项资源预算（DSP、LUT、FF、BRAM）内均留有充足余量，同时实现了确定性的低于10微秒的单步延迟，满足了模型预测控制式等离子体控制回路中实时推理的要求。

arXiv:2609.23141v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Real time plasma state estimation for control of Tokamak devices are challenging due to the stringent latency requirements of the plasma control system (PCS). We present an end-to-end workflow for deploying a recurrent probabilistic neural network (RPNN) on FPGA hardware. We combine architecture size reduction with quantization-aware training via QKeras. The model is then synthesized using hls4ml, targeting a Xilinx Alveo U50 device. We report a design that fits comfortably within all four resource budgets (DSP, LUT, FF, BRAM) at deterministic sub-10~$\mu$s single-timestep latency, meeting the requirements for real-time inference inside a model-predictive-control-style plasma control loop.

item.title: 该论文首次研究了决策时刻由齐次泊松过程控制的连续时间情节式MDP，在时间Lipschitz平滑性假设下通过离散化将UCRL和Q-learning扩展到该设置，证明了 $\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ 的遗憾界并给出匹配的极小极大下界，表明该速率在对数因子内最优。
item.description:
具有泊松决策时刻的连续时间情节式MDP中可证明高效的强化学习

Provably Efficient Reinforcement Learning in Continuous-Time Episodic MDPs with Poisson Decision Epochs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23127

该论文首次研究了决策时刻由齐次泊松过程控制的连续时间情节式MDP，在时间Lipschitz平滑性假设下通过离散化将UCRL和Q-learning扩展到该设置，证明了 $\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ 的遗憾界并给出匹配的极小极大下界，表明该速率在对数因子内最优。

许多现实世界的强化学习（RL）问题在连续时间中演化，其中决策发生在不规则的、事件驱动的时刻，而非固定的离散步骤。我们研究了情节式连续时间马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），其中决策时刻由齐次泊松过程控制，且奖励和转移动力学随时间平滑变化。我们考虑了每回合固定跳变次数以及固定时间预算（对应随机数量的泊松决策时刻）两种情形。在时间维度上Lipschitz连续性的假设下，我们通过离散化利用局部平滑性，将UCRL（Auer and Ortner 2006）和Q-learning（Jin et al. 2018）扩展到该设置，对基于模型和无模型的算法均证明了 $\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ 的遗憾界。最后，我们建立了与之匹配的 $\widetilde{\Omega}(T^{2/3})$ 极小极大下界，表明该速率在对数因子意义下是最优的。

arXiv:2609.23127v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many real-world reinforcement learning (RL) problems evolve in continuous time, where decisions occur at irregular, event-driven intervals rather than at fixed discrete steps. We study episodic continuous-time Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) in which decision epochs are governed by a homogeneous Poisson process and the reward and transition dynamics vary smoothly over time. We consider both a fixed number of jumps per episode and a fixed time budget with a random number of Poisson decision epochs. Under a Lipschitz continuity assumption in time, we exploit local smoothness through discretization and extend both UCRL (Auer and Ortner 2006) and Q-learning (Jin et al. 2018) to this setting, proving $\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ regret bounds for both model-based and model-free algorithms. Finally, we establish matching $\widetilde{\Omega}(T^{2/3})$ minimax lower bounds, showing that the rate is optimal up to logarithmic factors. These results p

item.title: 该论文发现困惑度作为聚合指标会低估激活量化的真实损害——即使困惑度仅上升1.2至1.5倍，归纳能力几乎无损（保持0.959）而检索能力已骤降至0.554，且这种结构性差距并非仅由量化误差幅度造成。
item.description:
困惑度代价低估了激活量化所破坏的东西

Perplexity Cost Understates What Activation Quantisation Breaks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23125

该论文发现困惑度作为聚合指标会低估激活量化的真实损害——即使困惑度仅上升1.2至1.5倍，归纳能力几乎无损（保持0.959）而检索能力已骤降至0.554，且这种结构性差距并非仅由量化误差幅度造成。

激活量化通常用一个聚合指标——困惑度来评估，该指标是对模型预测的每个token取平均。我们追问这个平均值是否能识别量化器损害了哪些计算。事实证明，困惑度是一个可靠的聚合信号：在来自四个系列的12个模型和780次模型内比较中，困惑度更偏好的方案在除2.1%和4.0%的情况外，都保留了更多的归纳能力和更多的检索能力。但是，当困惑度仅上升1.2到1.5倍时，归纳能力仍保持其完好精度的0.959，而检索能力已降至0.554，这一差距是聚合数字所无法揭示的。这个差距具有结构性，而不仅仅是大小：相同每通道幅度的匹配高斯噪声对照在很大程度上保持完好，而仅随机化量化误差的符号（所有幅度保持固定）也几乎无害，因此仅凭幅度无法解释这种损害。

arXiv:2609.23125v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Activation quantisation is usually evaluated with an aggregate metric, perplexity, averaged over every token a model predicts. We ask whether that average identifies which computations a quantiser damages. Perplexity turns out to be a reliable aggregate signal: across 12 models from four families and 780 within-model comparisons, the arm perplexity prefers also retains more induction and more retrieval in all but 2.1 and 4.0 percent of cases respectively. But where perplexity has risen by only a factor of 1.2 to 1.5, induction still keeps 0.959 of its intact accuracy while retrieval has already fallen to 0.554, a gap the aggregate number does not surface. This gap has structure, not just size: a matched Gaussian-noise control of the same per-channel magnitude leaves it largely intact, and randomising only the sign of the quantisation error, every magnitude held fixed, is nearly as harmless, so magnitude alone does not explain the damage.

item.title: 该论文揭示了白化嵌入范数并非高斯性的证据——白化会反转编码器的谱层级，使范数主要由近乎退化的维度贡献，因此其平方范数作为免训练似然代理的理论依据并不成立。
item.description:
白化反转了层级结构：白化嵌入的范数究竟度量了什么

Whitening Inverts the Hierarchy: What the Norm of a Whitened Embedding Measures

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23117

该论文揭示了白化嵌入范数并非高斯性的证据——白化会反转编码器的谱层级，使范数主要由近乎退化的维度贡献，因此其平方范数作为免训练似然代理的理论依据并不成立。

对基础模型嵌入进行白化，并将其平方范数用作免训练的似然代理，其动机在于观察到白化后的坐标通常近似呈现标准正态分布。我们证明这一观察源于投影中心极限定理，因此并不意味着联合分布服从高斯分布。在多个编码器和三种训练目标下，我们发现白化半径相对于高斯参考存在系统性的过度离散，即使与具有相同均值和协方差的分布克隆相比也是如此。我们进一步表明，通常报告的经验范数统计量与理论范数统计量之间的一致性，是样本内白化的代数结果，并不构成高斯性的证据。我们识别出这一行为背后的机制：白化反转了编码器的谱层级结构，使对平方范数的贡献转向近乎退化的维度（原文在此处截断）。

arXiv:2609.23117v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Whitening a foundation-model embedding and using its squared norm as a training-free likelihood surrogate is motivated by the observation that whitened coordinates often appear approximately standard normal. We show that this observation follows from the projection central limit theorem and therefore does not imply a Gaussian joint distribution. Across multiple encoders and three training objectives, we find systematic over-dispersion of the whitened radius relative to the Gaussian reference, including against distributional clones with identical mean and covariance. We further show that the commonly reported agreement between empirical and theoretical norm statistics is an algebraic consequence of in-sample whitening and does not constitute evidence for Gaussianity. We identify the mechanism behind this behavior: whitening reverses the encoder's spectral hierarchy, shifting the contribution to the squared norm toward near-degenerate d

item.title: 本文将具备可证明收敛性的现代稳定GAN（R3GAN）通过由粗到精精炼框架和频域判别器适配到时间序列插补任务，但实验报告了一个负面结果——对抗精炼在大多数配置下并未带来改进，从而留下一个开放问题。
item.description:
对抗精炼何时有效？将R3GAN应用于时间序列插补的负面结果与开放问题

When Does Adversarial Refinement Help? A Negative Result and Open Problem in Adapting R3GAN to Time Series Imputation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23102

本文将具备可证明收敛性的现代稳定GAN（R3GAN）通过由粗到精精炼框架和频域判别器适配到时间序列插补任务，但实验报告了一个负面结果——对抗精炼在大多数配置下并未带来改进，从而留下一个开放问题。

扩散模型和Transformer已在多变量时间序列插补任务中取代了GAN，其主要原因在于GAN训练的不稳定性。R3GAN（NeurIPS 2024）通过具有可证明收敛性的正则化相对论损失消除了这种不稳定性，由此引出一个自然的问题：稳定的现代GAN能否复兴对抗式插补方法？我们将R3GAN适配到一维时间数据上，采用了由粗到精的精炼框架和频域判别器，并对3个数据集上的14个已保存配置进行了审计。由于这些是异质的单次运行结果，相关证据是描述性的，而非匹配的因果消融实验。我们报告了一个负面结果：所有五个已保存的均值/零起点配置提升了48.4%至70.2%；而在八个符合条件的非遗留线性起点配置中，平均变化为-0.7%（范围从-3.0%到+1.1%）；一个单独的-21.9%遗留日志异常因来源追溯目的被保留，但已从该汇总统计中排除。在一个已保存的Weather比较……

arXiv:2609.23102v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Diffusion models and transformers have supplanted GANs for multivariate time series imputation, largely on grounds of GAN training instability. R3GAN (NeurIPS 2024) removes that instability via regularized relativistic losses with provable convergence, raising a natural question: do stable, modern GANs revive adversarial imputation? We adapt R3GAN to 1D temporal data with a coarse-to-fine refinement framework and a frequency-domain discriminator, and audit 14 saved configurations across 3 datasets. Because these are heterogeneous single runs, the evidence is descriptive rather than a matched causal ablation. We report a negative result. All five saved mean/zero-start configurations improve by 48.4-70.2%. Among eight eligible non-legacy linear-start configurations, the mean change is -0.7% (range -3.0% to +1.1%); a separate -21.9% legacy logging anomaly is retained for provenance but excluded from that aggregate. item.title: 本文提出一种由大语言模型辅助的自动化机器学习框架，旨在降低物联网网络入侵检测模型开发中的人工成本与优化时间开销。
item.description:
一种用于物联网网络入侵检测的大语言模型辅助自动化机器学习框架

An LLM-Assisted AutoML Framework for Intrusion Detection in IoT Networks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23097

本文提出一种由大语言模型辅助的自动化机器学习框架，旨在降低物联网网络入侵检测模型开发中的人工成本与优化时间开销。

物联网系统正日益广泛地部署于智能家居、交通、能源系统和关键基础设施中。这种广泛的连接性提升了服务的智能化水平，但同时也扩大了物联网网络的攻击面。基于机器学习的入侵检测系统被广泛用于识别恶意网络威胁并保护物联网系统，然而开发有效的基于机器学习的入侵检测模型通常需要人类专业知识，并在数据预处理、特征选择、模型选择和超参数调优等诸多流程中反复进行人工决策。自动化机器学习通过利用优化技术将机器学习流程中的步骤自动化，从而减轻了这一负担，但传统的自动化机器学习方法由于需要探索广泛的候选模型家族和庞大的超参数空间，可能会消耗大量的优化时间。本文提出了一种大语言模型辅助的……

arXiv:2609.23097v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) systems are increasingly deployed in smart homes, transportation, energy systems, and critical infrastructure. This broad connectivity improves service intelligence, but also enlarges the attack surface of IoT networks. Machine Learning (ML)-based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDSs) are widely used to identify malicious network threats and protect IoT systems, but developing effective ML-based IDS models often requires human expertise and repeated manual decisions on many procedures, including data pre-processing, feature selection, model selection, and hyperparameter tuning. Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) reduces this burden by automating steps of the ML pipeline using optimization techniques, but conventional AutoML methods can consume substantial optimization time because they explore broad candidate model families and large hyperparameter spaces. item.title: 本文研究了用最近邻分类表示布尔函数所需的原型数量：对任意原型情形加强了几乎所有布尔函数的下界并证明VC维界在维数≥4时是紧的，同时借助覆盖设计理论精确刻画了对称阈值函数在每个阈值水平下的最小原型数。
item.description:
布尔函数最近邻表示中的计数与覆盖

Counting and Covering in Nearest-Neighbour Representations of Boolean Functions

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23094

本文研究了用最近邻分类表示布尔函数所需的原型数量：对任意原型情形加强了几乎所有布尔函数的下界并证明VC维界在维数≥4时是紧的，同时借助覆盖设计理论精确刻画了对称阈值函数在每个阈值水平下的最小原型数。

我们研究了用最近邻分类来表示布尔函数所需的原型数量。这里存在两种不同的设定：原型可以是欧几里得空间中的任意点，或者原型本身被要求必须位于布尔立方体中。对于无限制的原型，我们加强了针对几乎所有布尔函数的一个已知下界。该下界同时适用于具有任意数量投票邻居的最近邻投票规则，并大幅缩小了与已知一般上界之间的差距。我们为原型数量有界的函数类获得了VC维上界，并证明该界在维数至少为4时在数量级上是紧的。随后我们研究布尔原型情形，从对称阈值函数入手。通过与覆盖设计的联系，我们精确地用覆盖数刻画了每个阈值水平下的最小原型数量，并由此得到了相关函数类的进一步精确结果。

arXiv:2609.23094v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the number of prototypes needed to represent Boolean functions by nearest-neighbour classification. There are two distinct settings: the prototypes may be arbitrary points of Euclidean space, or they may themselves be required to lie in the Boolean cube. For unrestricted prototypes, we strengthen a known lower bound for almost all Boolean functions. The bound applies simultaneously to nearest-neighbour voting rules with any number of voting neighbours, and substantially narrows the gap with the known general upper bound. We obtain a VC-dimension bound for classes with a bounded number of prototypes, and show that it is sharp in order in dimensions at least four. We then study Boolean prototypes, beginning with symmetric threshold functions. A connection with covering designs expresses the minimum number of prototypes at every threshold level exactly in terms of a covering number, and leads to further exact results for related

item.title: 本文证明了在对抗性多目标老虎机中，当算法不知道哪个坐标更容易时，坐标累积损失的大小无法改善最坏情况下帕累托后悔的阶数。
item.description:
对抗性多目标老虎机中坐标在帕累托后悔中的作用

The Role of Coordinates in Pareto Regret for Adversarial Multi-Objective Bandits

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23092

本文证明了在对抗性多目标老虎机中，当算法不知道哪个坐标更容易时，坐标累积损失的大小无法改善最坏情况下帕累托后悔的阶数。

对抗性多目标老虎机有潜力帮助我们优化那些奖励是由对手选定的多维向量、且性能以帕累托后悔来衡量的选择（臂）。我们将损失定义为一减去奖励，并通过各臂在某一坐标上的最小累积损失来衡量该坐标的容易程度，当该量越小时，我们称该坐标越容易。现有工作表明，在理论上一个更容易的坐标可能会降低帕累托后悔。然而在实践中，人们可能并不知道哪个坐标更容易。从负面结果来看，我们证明这种信息的缺失消除了这一可能性：较小的累积损失并不能改善帕累托后悔的最坏情况阶数。准确地说，设 \(L_d\) 为坐标 \(d\) 在 \(T\) 轮中的最小累积损失。对于 \(K\ge4\) 个臂、\(T\ge6\) 轮以及至少 2 个坐标，我们证明了极小极大期望帕累托后悔为 \(\Omega(\min\{T-L_0,\ldots\}\)。

arXiv:2609.23092v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Adversarial multi-objective bandits hold the potential to help us optimize choices (arms) whose reward is a multidimensional vector chosen by an adversary and whose performance is measured by Pareto regret. We define loss as one minus reward and measure the easiness of a coordinate by the smallest cumulative loss of the arms on it, and call the coordinate easier when this quantity is smaller. Existing work suggests that in theory an easier coordinate may reduce Pareto regret. However, in practice, one may not know which coordinate is easier. On the negative side, we show that this lack of information eliminates the possibility: a smaller cumulative loss does not improve the worst-case order of Pareto regret. Precisely, let \(L_d\) be the smallest cumulative loss along coordinate $d$ over $T$ rounds. item.title: 提出基于权重矩阵奇异值谱的闭式指标NSC，可仅凭架构规格（无需实例化模型、数据或梯度）衡量网络容量，并通过精确动态规划求解器NSC-DP在CPU上数秒内找到资源约束下全局最优的架构设计。
item.description:
神经谱容量：仅凭网络规格即可测量与设计架构

Neural Spectral Capacity: Measuring and Designing Architectures from Network Specification Alone

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23087

提出基于权重矩阵奇异值谱的闭式指标NSC，可仅凭架构规格（无需实例化模型、数据或梯度）衡量网络容量，并通过精确动态规划求解器NSC-DP在CPU上数秒内找到资源约束下全局最优的架构设计。

现代Transformer设计与压缩都可归结为在预算约束下分配容量。这些决策的标准度量指标——参数量（#Params）和浮点运算量（#FLOPs）——仅能刻画规模和计算量，却无法反映架构结构：两个参数预算相同但深度-宽度、注意力头或FFN分配不同的架构会得到相同的评分，然而实际行为却各不相同。我们提出神经谱容量（Neural Spectral Capacity, NSC），这是一个基于每个权重矩阵奇异值谱的闭式标量。在标准随机初始化下，Marchenko-Pastur定律使得NSC可以仅从架构规格计算得出，无需模型实例化、数据或梯度。其逐层可加的结构催生了NSC-DP——一个精确的动态规划求解器，能在CPU上于数秒内返回在资源约束下全局最大化NSC的架构——这是对现有免训练代理指标进行黑盒搜索所无法提供的保证。实证（原文此处被截断）

arXiv:2609.23087v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern Transformer design and compression both reduce to allocating capacity under a budget. The standard scalars for these decisions, #Params and #FLOPs, capture size and compute but not architectural structure: two architectures with identical parameter budgets but different depth-width, head, or FFN allocations receive identical scores yet behave differently. We propose Neural Spectral Capacity (NSC), a closed-form scalar grounded in the singular-value spectrum of each weight matrix. Under standard random initialization, the Marchenko-Pastur law renders NSC computable from the architectural specification alone, with no model instantiation, data, or gradients. Its layer-wise additive structure admits NSC-DP, an exact dynamic-programming solver returning the architecture globally maximizing NSC under resource constraints in seconds on a CPU -- a guarantee that black-box search over existing training-free proxies cannot provide. item.title: 该论文提出一种基于实测能耗数据的LLM路由器，通过离线锦标赛测量候选模型的正确率、延迟、功耗与GPU能耗，并采用监督微调结合群组相对策略优化进行训练，从而在异构模型池间自适应选择模型，在不显著牺牲任务性能的情况下有效降低大语言模型推理的能耗。
item.description:
实测焦耳，习得路由：面向高能效大语言模型服务的路由学习

Measured Joules, Learned Routes: Learning to Route for Energy-Efficient LLM Serving

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23085

该论文提出一种基于实测能耗数据的LLM路由器，通过离线锦标赛测量候选模型的正确率、延迟、功耗与GPU能耗，并采用监督微调结合群组相对策略优化进行训练，从而在异构模型池间自适应选择模型，在不显著牺牲任务性能的情况下有效降低大语言模型推理的能耗。

随着模型规模不断增长和推理轨迹不断延长，大语言模型（LLM）与智能体AI系统正带来快速增长的推理能耗需求。然而在实践中，许多查询并不需要最大可用模型所具备的能力，而将此类查询常规地导向高能力模型会引入不必要的大量计算与能量消耗。本文研究了在异构LLM池中进行自适应路由是否能够在不明显损害任务性能的前提下降低这一能量负担。我们设计了一个基于语言模型的路由器，它读取每个查询并从固定的候选模型池中选择一个回答模型。候选模型首先通过离线锦标赛进行性能剖析，记录其针对每个查询的正确率、延迟、功耗和GPU能耗。利用这些实测数据，路由器先通过监督微调进行训练，随后再采用群组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行训练。

arXiv:2609.23085v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) and agentic AI systems are creating rapidly growing inference energy demands as model sizes grow and reasoning trajectories extend. While in practice, many queries do not require the capabilities of the largest available model, and routinely directing such queries to a high-capability model can introduce unnecessary, considerable computation and energy consumption. In this paper, we investigate whether adaptive routing across a heterogeneous pool of LLMs can reduce this energy burden without substantially compromising task performance. We design a language-model-based router that reads in each query and selects an answer model from a fixed candidate pool. The candidate models are first profiled through an offline tournament that records their correctness, latency, power, and GPU energy for each query. item.title: 提出AirGC-CD方案，通过在削波前用部分高斯循环矩阵对本地更新进行预编码，在空中联邦学习中实现可精确去偏的PAPR降低，同时兼顾压缩传输与SNR性能。
item.description:
AirGC-CD：用于空中联邦学习中可精确去偏PAPR降低的高斯-循环预编码

AirGC-CD: Gaussian-Circulant Precoding for Exactly Debiasable PAPR Reduction in Over-the-Air Federated Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23084

提出AirGC-CD方案，通过在削波前用部分高斯循环矩阵对本地更新进行预编码，在空中联邦学习中实现可精确去偏的PAPR降低，同时兼顾压缩传输与SNR性能。

空中联邦学习让边缘设备能够同时传输各自的本地更新，从而降低通信开销。然而，由此产生的波形具有随模型维度增长的峰均功率比（PAPR），而要将放大器保持在其线性范围内只有两种补救手段：削峰或回退发射功率。但这两种方法都并非没有代价：i) 削波失真在接收端表现为无法消除的偏差；ii) 功率回退虽能保持信号完整，却会降低平均信噪比（SNR）。与这一权衡无关的是，传输本身仍是无压缩的，每个模型参数都要消耗一次信道使用，这使得大模型训练难以实现。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了AirGC-CD，这是一种空中传输方案，它在削波之前用部分高斯循环矩阵对每个本地更新进行预编码。在AirGC-CD中，预编码器的输出恰好是高斯……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.23084v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Over-the-air federated learning lets edge devices transmit their local updates simultaneously, reducing the communication overhead. The resulting waveform, however, has a peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) that grows with the model dimension, and keeping the amplifier in its linear range leaves two remedies: clipping the peaks or backing off the transmit power. Neither remedy is without cost: i) the clipping distortion appears at the receiver as a bias that cannot be removed, and ii) back-off keeps the signal intact but degrades the average signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Independent of this trade-off, the transmission remains uncompressed, spending one channel use per model parameter, which keeps large-model training out of reach. To address these challenges, we propose AirGC-CD, an over-the-air scheme that precodes each local update with a partial Gaussian circulant matrix before clipping. item.title: 提出了一种无需训练、模型无关的事件特征迁移算子（EST），能将已完成的历史事件转化为显式预测场景并叠加到任意分位数预测器的预测上，在多个主流预测模型的真实事件情景中将 WQL 最多降低 90%。
item.description:
事件特征迁移：基于历史事件的模型无关预测场景构建

Event Signature Transfer: Model-Agnostic Forecast Scenario Construction from Historical Events

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23074

提出了一种无需训练、模型无关的事件特征迁移算子（EST），能将已完成的历史事件转化为显式预测场景并叠加到任意分位数预测器的预测上，在多个主流预测模型的真实事件情景中将 WQL 最多降低 90%。

预测者往往知道某个事件即将发生，但不知道其影响的形态、规模或时机。我们提出了事件特征迁移（Event Signature Transfer, EST），这是一个无需训练、模型无关的算子，能够将一个已完成的历史事件转化为显式的预测场景。EST 首先去除源事件自身的趋势和季节性成分，然后对剩余的事件特征进行缩放和重新定时，将其叠加到原生预测之上，同时保留预测的关联结构，并在强度为零时精确退化为原预测。由于它只读取输出分位数，EST 可应用于任何分位数预测器，在迁移时无需训练、无需访问模型内部。在 Chronos-2、TimesFM-2.5 和 Toto-2.0 上的十二个真实事件情景和十个合成场景中，手动配置的 EST 在样本内将真实事件情景的 WQL 降低了 21.7%–90%。在 Chronos-2 上，它在十二组对比实验中有十一组优于协变量条件化、激活编辑和原始重放方法。该算子构建的是一个预测场景，而不是……

arXiv:2609.23074v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Forecasters often know an event is imminent but not the shape, size, or timing of its effect. We introduce Event Signature Transfer (EST), a training-free, model-agnostic operator that turns a completed past event into an explicit forecast scenario. EST removes a source event's own trend and seasonality, then scales and retimes the remaining event signature onto a native forecast, preserving the forecast's linked structure and reducing to it exactly at zero strength. Because it reads only output quantiles, EST applies to any quantile forecaster, with no training, no model internals, at transfer time. Across twelve real episodes and ten synthetic scenarios on Chronos-2, TimesFM-2.5 and Toto-2.0, manually configured EST reduces real-episode WQL by 21.7-90\% in-sample. item.title: 提出了包含18.1万取代基级样本的取代基贡献数据集MolSC，以及与训练数据在骨架、取代基和分子层面均不重叠的评估基准MolSC-Bench，以增强大语言模型对分子细粒度结构-性质关系的理解。
item.description:
MolSC：利用取代基贡献增强大语言模型的细粒度分子理解

MolSC: Leveraging Substituent Contributions to Enhance Fine-grained Molecular Understanding in LLMs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23073

提出了包含18.1万取代基级样本的取代基贡献数据集MolSC，以及与训练数据在骨架、取代基和分子层面均不重叠的评估基准MolSC-Bench，以增强大语言模型对分子细粒度结构-性质关系的理解。

自然语言处理的最新进展催生了在多种化学任务中表现优异的分子大语言模型（LLMs）。然而，这些模型仍难以捕捉细粒度的结构-性质关系，尤其是微小的局部修饰如何改变分子的行为。为解决这一局限，我们提出了MolSC，一个取代基贡献数据集，其定义为将特定取代基连接到分子骨架上所引起的性质变化。MolSC从人工标注的生物活性记录中整理而来，涵盖结构性警示风险、靶点特异性生物活性以及理化描述符，包含181K个取代基级别的训练样本。我们进一步提出了MolSC-Bench，一个包含1,541个样本的留出评估基准，其在骨架、取代基和分子三个层面均与MolSC不重叠。我们的实验表明，现有的分子大语言模型和强大的专有模型……（原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2609.23073v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent advances in natural language processing have led to molecular Large Language Models (LLMs) with strong performance across diverse chemistry tasks. However, they still struggle to capture fine-grained structure-property relationships, particularly how small, localized modifications alter a molecule's behavior. item.title: 该论文将CoT忠实性重新定义为“内部概念锚定”问题，利用共享稀疏自编码器直接比较预测过程与CoT过程的内部概念，并首次引入三个相关性对齐指标和一个因果消融指标Δp，以检验共享概念是否因果性地驱动模型答案。

从概念对齐到因果锚定：思维链忠实性的干预测试

From Concept Alignment to Causal Grounding: An Intervention Test of Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23065

该论文将CoT忠实性重新定义为“内部概念锚定”问题，利用共享稀疏自编码器直接比较预测过程与CoT过程的内部概念，并首次引入三个相关性对齐指标和一个因果消融指标Δp，以检验共享概念是否因果性地驱动模型答案。

arXiv:2609.23065v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) can sound plausible yet be unfaithful to the model's underlying reasoning. Most prior work probes CoT faithfulness through input--output behavior or input attributions, leaving internal computation largely underexplored. We instead cast faithfulness as internal concept grounding: Does a large language model's (LLM) CoT reasoning engage the same internal concepts that support the LLM's direct prediction, and do the shared concepts causally drive its answer? Encoding a prediction pass and a CoT pass with a single shared sparse autoencoder (SAE), a reliable approximator of the latent concepts LLMs use, makes their internal concepts directly comparable. We introduce three correlational metrics of concept-level alignment and a causal metric, $\Delta p$, which ablates the shared concepts and measures the drop in answer probability. item.description:
扩散模型的优化器：一项受控基准测试

Optimizers for Diffusion Models: A Controlled Benchmark

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23055

该论文提出了首个针对离散扩散模型的受控优化器基准测试，在四种扩散形式上以统一协议系统比较了七种优化器，发现AdamW是强大的默认选择但并非在所有场景下都最优。

离散扩散模型如今在多个基准测试上已能与自回归语言模型相媲美，但如何最优地训练它们这一问题却鲜受关注：优化器从一篇论文沿用到下一篇论文，从未被比较过。与此同时，新优化器几乎只在自回归预训练上进行验证，而那是不同损失曲面上的不同目标。我们提出了一项涵盖四种扩散形式的受控优化器基准测试，据我们所知这是首个针对离散扩散的基准：在掩码扩散（text8）、均匀扩散（QM9，以及通过高斯对偶性的LM1B）和图像上的高斯扩散（CelebA-64）上测试了七种优化器（AdamW、Lion、Muon、SOAP、MARS、MARS-M、Schedule-Free），每项任务都有已发表的参考值。每个优化器都采用相同的搜索协议，每个获胜者都以完整预算、使用三个随机种子重新训练。AdamW是一个强大的默认选择，但并不总是正确的选择：……

本文对一个压缩VLA策略的闭环失败进行了因果解剖，发现该模型虽通过所有离线评估指标，却因z轴负向后期残差导致向目标运输阶段完全失败，揭示了离线评估无法预测闭环执行崩溃的结构化失败机制。

压缩的操作策略可以通过离线评估，却在闭环执行中失败；这种分离现象在先前的工作中已被确立，并非我们的主张。我们的贡献是对一个自然发生案例的因果解剖。Octo-Base的8层蒸馏版本保留了86%的参数，通过了我们应用的所有离线检查（在该系列自身的验证指标上达到0.996和1.000的教师比率），但在闭环中崩溃：在模拟的WidowX抓取放置任务上，学生模型为0/72，而教师模型为40/72。这种崩溃是结构化的，而非弥散的：早期任务阶段逐渐退化（学生模型以教师模型90%的速率移动物体，抓取成功率为55%），而向目标运输则完全失败，在所有训练变体中均为0%。配对动作轨迹取证分离出了这一失败特征：一个负向的、后期加重的z轴残差，约为修复后幅度的10倍，并且在基础蒸馏和两个延续分支中都持续存在。

arXiv:2609.23048v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Compressed manipulation policies can pass offline evaluation while failing in closed-loop execution; this dissociation is established in prior work and is not our claim. We contribute a causal anatomy of one naturally occurring case. An 8-layer distillation of Octo-Base retains 86% of parameters, passes every offline check we applied (0.996 and 1.000 teacher-ratios on the family's own validation metrics), and collapses in closed loop: 0/72 vs. the teacher's 40/72 on a simulated WidowX pick-and-place task. The collapse is structured, not diffuse: early task stages degrade gradually (the student moves the object at 90% of the teacher's rate and grasps at 55%), while transport-to-target fails categorically, at 0% in every training variant.
