策展训练数据是现代AI开发中最关键却又最耗费人力的环节之一：从业者需要针对嘈杂的基准反馈，反复提出、实现、评估和修订数据策略。我们探讨通用编码智能体能否自动化这一数据策展循环。我们提出了*Curation-Bench*，这是一个以智能体为中心的基准，它固定了模型、训练方案和评估套件，同时赋予智能体命令行权限，使其能够检查数据、实现策略、将策略提交到固定的训练/评估流程并进行修订。在一个视觉-语言指令微调的实例中，开箱即用的智能体在十次迭代内就达到了已发表的强数据选择基线水平。然而，轨迹分析揭示了一个持续的*执行-研究差距*：即使提供了策略指南和论文参考文献，智能体仍主要调整局部策略变体，而非探索新的策略家族。需要e

arXiv:2606.04261v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Curating training data is among the most consequential yet labor-intensive parts of modern AI development: practitioners iteratively propose, implement, evaluate, and revise data policies against noisy benchmark feedback. We ask whether generalist coding agents can automate this data-curation loop. We introduce *Curation-Bench*, an agent-centric benchmark that fixes the model, training recipe, and evaluation suite while giving agents command-line access to inspect data, implement policies, submit them to a fixed training/evaluation pipeline, and revise. In a vision-language instruction-tuning instantiation, out-of-the-box agents reach strong published data-selection baselines within ten iterations. However, trajectory analysis reveals a persistent *execution-research gap*: agents mainly tune local policy variants rather than explore new policy families, even when given strategy guides and paper references. 提出PerchRL强化学习框架，通过“状态预训练+视觉微调”的两阶段策略、随机化平台轨迹与时序增强提升泛化能力，并结合可见性感知状态增强与主动感知奖励，实现了四旋翼无人机在快速不规则运动倾斜平台上的基于视觉的敏捷降落。

四旋翼无人机基于视觉自主降落在移动的倾斜平台上，对空地协同至关重要，但由于视场角（FOV）有限，这一任务仍然极具挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了PerchRL，一个用于在快速且不规则运动的倾斜平台上实现基于视觉敏捷降落的强化学习（RL）框架。具体而言，我们采用两阶段学习策略，即先进行基于状态的预训练，再进行基于视觉的微调。为了提升在不同平台运动下的泛化能力，我们采用随机化的平台轨迹来防止过拟合，并利用时序增强方法从历史观测中捕捉潜在的运动模式。在基于视觉的微调阶段，我们提出了一种由可见性感知状态增强和主动感知奖励组成的混合学习框架，以提高间歇性视觉丢失情况下的鲁棒性。大量的仿真和真实世界（实验验证，原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2606.03441v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Autonomous vision-based perching of quadrotors on moving inclined platforms is critical for air-ground collaboration but remains challenging due to the limited field of view (FOV). In this paper, we propose PerchRL, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework for vision-based agile perching on inclined platforms under rapid and irregular motion. Specifically, we employ a two-stage learning strategy consisting of state-based pre-training followed by vision-based fine-tuning. To improve generalization across diverse platform motions, we employ randomized platform trajectories to prevent overfitting and temporal augmentation methods to capture latent motion patterns from historical observations. During vision-based fine-tuning, a hybrid learning framework consisting of visibility-aware state augmentation and active perception rewards is presented to improve robustness under intermittent visual loss. 医疗治疗推荐给强化学习带来了诸多挑战：患者生理状态在连续时间中演变，测量与干预以不规则的时间间隔进行，且治疗效果在个体间存在显著差异。然而，现有的强化学习建模方式和模拟环境均基于具有固定决策间隔的离散时间马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）。因此，评估强化学习方法能否处理与时间间隔相关的疾病进展、个性化治疗反应以及连续测量点之间的安全性问题仍然十分困难。为填补这一空白，我们提出了MedGym，一个面向动态治疗推荐的基准环境。MedGym在连续时间框架下对患者的纵向演化进行建模，并利用物理信息神经网络从临床数据构建了一个可配置的医疗强化学习基准。由此得到的基准使得离散…（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2606.01028v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Medical treatment recommendation poses several challenges to reinforcement learning (RL): patient physiology evolves in continuous time, measurements and interventions are performed at irregular intervals, and treatment effects vary substantially across individuals. Existing RL formulations and simulated environments, however, are based on discrete-time MDPs with fixed decision intervals. Thus, it remains difficult to evaluate whether RL methods can handle time-interval-dependent disease progression, personalized treatment response, and safety between consecutive measurement points. To address this gap, we introduce MedGym, a benchmark environment for dynamic treatment recommendation. TRACES：基于轨迹状态建模的多轮LLM智能体主动安全审计

TRACES通过从LLM隐藏表示中建模轨迹风险状态的时间演化，仅用弱轨迹级监督即可对多轮智能体交互实现主动的、密集的前缀级安全风险审计。

arXiv:2605.27690v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate through multi-turn tool use and environment interaction, where safety risks often emerge from intermediate steps long before they surface in the final outcome. Reactive auditing is therefore insufficient: post-hoc diagnosis frequently misses the chance to flag risks while they are unfolding. We propose TRACES, a representation-based proactive auditor that learns prefix-level trajectory risk states from the hidden representations of an observer LLM. TRACES induces latent mechanism features from step representations and models their temporal evolution to estimate whether a partial trajectory is drifting toward unsafe behavior. To sidestep the cost and ambiguity of step-level risk annotation, TRACES is trained with weak trajectory-level supervision while still producing dense prefix-level risk estimates. item.title: 提出DDGAD方法，通过“适应-组合”框架分别生成节点级估计与上下文估计，并将两者间持续累积的分歧作为异常证据，从而解决了传统消息传递中节点异常与上下文异常来源混淆的问题。
item.description:
DDGAD：基于“适应-组合”框架的分歧驱动图异常检测

DDGAD: Disagreement-Driven Graph Anomaly Detection via Adapt-Then-Combine

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26446

提出DDGAD方法，通过“适应-组合”框架分别生成节点级估计与上下文估计，并将两者间持续累积的分歧作为异常证据，从而解决了传统消息传递中节点异常与上下文异常来源混淆的问题。

图异常检测（GAD）通常依赖消息传递来联合编码节点属性与邻域上下文。然而，一旦两者混合，编码后的异常状态可能既反映节点自身的内在偏离，也可能反映不相容的上下文影响，使其异常来源变得模糊不清。我们提出分歧驱动图异常检测方法DDGAD，该方法将节点级估计与上下文估计之间持续存在的不相容性作为异常证据。受“适应-组合”（Adapt-Then-Combine, ATC）框架启发，DDGAD颠倒了其原有的共识目标：Adapt（适应）阶段在不进行同步骤邻居聚合的情况下产生节点级估计，而Combine（组合）阶段则形成依赖于邻域的上下文估计，两者在达成共识之前的分歧会在多个ATC步骤中不断累积，并用于异常检测。我们进一步从图谱和源响应的视角对该信号进行表征，并在上下文条件下推导出异常节点与正常节点可分离的充分条件。

arXiv:2605.26446v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Graph anomaly detection (GAD) commonly relies on message passing to jointly encode node attributes and neighborhood context. However, once the two are mixed, an abnormal post-encoding state may reflect either an intrinsic node deviation or incompatible contextual influence, making its source ambiguous. We propose Disagreement-Driven Graph Anomaly Detection (DDGAD), which treats persistent incompatibility between node-wise and contextual estimates as anomaly evidence. Inspired by Adapt-Then-Combine (ATC), DDGAD reverses its consensus objective: Adapt produces a node-wise estimate without new same-step neighbor aggregation, while Combine forms a neighborhood-dependent contextual estimate, and their pre-consensus disagreement is accumulated across ATC steps for detection. item.description:
SiST-GNN：面向动态图表示学习的同步时空消息传递

SiST-GNN: Simultaneous Spatial-Temporal Message Passing for Dynamic Graph Representation Learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25548

SiST-GNN提出在单一消息传递操作中同时融合空间与时间信息，突破了传统动态图神经网络“时间优先”或“空间优先”的串行处理局限，实现了对图拓扑结构与演化过程的联合推理。

基于快照序列的动态图神经网络（DGNN）通常分为两类。“时间优先”方法先为每个节点构建时间嵌入，之后再进行空间聚合；而“空间优先”方法则颠倒这一顺序，将图卷积的输出送入下游的时间模块。无论哪种情况，这种刚性的先后顺序都迫使第二阶段只能消费第一阶段已经压缩的摘要信息，从而无法对图拓扑与演化过程进行联合推理；实际上，消息传递算子永远无法根据邻居的“过去”轨迹来衡量该邻居的贡献。本文提出了SiST-GNN（同步时空图神经网络），它在单一的消息传递操作中融合这两种信号，而非将它们串联起来。在每个快照处，我们维护一个循环隐藏状态……

arXiv:2605.25548v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Dynamic graph neural networks (DGNNs) that operate on snapshot sequences typically fall into one of two categories. \emph{Temporal-first} approaches build per-node temporal embeddings and only afterward perform spatial aggregation, whereas \emph{Spatial-first} approaches invert this order, feeding the output of a graph convolution into a downstream temporal module. In either case, the rigid sequencing forces the second stage to consume an already-compressed summary produced by the first, ruling out joint reasoning over topology and evolution; effectively, the message-passing operator never gets to weight a neighbor's contribution by that neighbor's \emph{past} trajectory. This paper introduces \textbf{SiST-GNN} (\textbf{Si}multaneous \textbf{S}patial-\textbf{T}emporal \textbf{GNN}), which fuses the two signals inside a single message-passing operation rather than chaining them. item.title: 提出Aurora Hunter两阶段级联框架，将极光发生预测与观测条件评估解耦，通过级联概率模型实现极光可见性的概率预测，回顾性ROC-AUC达到0.9以上。
item.description:
极光猎手：一个用于概率可见性预测的两阶段框架

Aurora Hunter: A Two-Stage Framework for Probabilistic Visibility Forecasting

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24038

提出Aurora Hunter两阶段级联框架，将极光发生预测与观测条件评估解耦，通过级联概率模型实现极光可见性的概率预测，回顾性ROC-AUC达到0.9以上。

在给定地点观测到极光需要两个物理上截然不同的条件同时成立：其一是极光出现在头顶上空，这由太阳风-磁层耦合过程控制；其二是允许探测的观测条件，这由云量和月光决定。将两者混为一谈的方法会削弱空间天气信号，并限制模型在不同观测站点之间的泛化能力。我们开发了Aurora Hunter（极光猎手），这是一个两阶段级联框架，将极光发生预测与观测条件评估分离。第一阶段使用43个物理驱动特征，通过在特罗姆瑟与基律纳联合数据（约16,600小时，2015-2023年）上训练的梯度提升树来预测P（全天空图像中可识别极光）。第二阶段使用逻辑回归对15个观测条件特征建模P（图像无遮挡|极光可识别），并在极光可识别的小时数据上进行训练。该级联概率P(可见) = P(可识别) × P(无遮挡|可识别)实现了回顾性ROC-AUC达到0.9

arXiv:2605.24038v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Aurora visibility at a given location requires two physically distinct conditions to hold at once: aurora occurring overhead, governed by solar wind-magnetosphere coupling, and observing conditions that permit detection, governed by cloud cover and moonlight. Approaches that conflate the two weaken the space-weather signal and limit cross-site generalizability. We develop Aurora Hunter, a two-stage cascade that separates occurrence prediction from observing-condition assessment. Stage 1 uses 43 physics-driven features to predict P(aurora identifiable in all-sky images) via gradient-boosted trees trained on joint Tromso+Kiruna data (about 16,600 hours, 2015-2023). Stage 2 models P(unobscured image class | identifiable) with logistic regression on 15 observing-condition features, trained on hours with identifiable aurora. The cascade P(visible) = P(identifiable) x P(unobscured | identifiable) achieves retrospective ROC-AUC of 0.9

item.title: 本文提出Reflex范式，通过形式化轴向反射与双侧反射两类反射对称性，并借助有原则的对称性正则化机制，将其无缝集成到在策略和离策略强化学习算法中，从而提升基于状态的连续控制任务的样本效率。
item.description:
Reflex：在基于状态的连续控制中利用反射对称性的强化学习

Reflex: Reinforcement Learning with Reflection Symmetry Exploitation in State-Based Continuous Control

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23415

本文提出Reflex范式，通过形式化轴向反射与双侧反射两类反射对称性，并借助有原则的对称性正则化机制，将其无缝集成到在策略和离策略强化学习算法中，从而提升基于状态的连续控制任务的样本效率。

强化学习长期以来一直受困于样本效率低下的问题。缓解这一问题的一种有前景的方法是利用群不变马尔可夫决策过程（G-不变MDP）。该方向的现有工作主要集中于基于图像的强化学习和旋转对称性（如SO(2)），而基于状态的强化学习和反射对称性在很大程度上仍未被充分探索。在本工作中，我们聚焦于基于状态的连续控制任务，通过引入Reflex来利用反射对称性，这是一种能够与在策略和离策略强化学习算法无缝集成的范式。我们形式化了两种类型的反射——轴向反射和双侧反射，并刻画了它们对应的变换。基于对保持对称性的最优价值函数和策略的理论分析，Reflex通过有原则的对称性正则化机制将反射对称性融入策略学习。

arXiv:2605.23415v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reinforcement learning has long struggled with poor sample efficiency. One promising approach to mitigate this problem is leveraging group-invariant Markov Decision Processes ($G$-invariant MDPs). Existing works in this direction have primarily focused on image-based RL and rotational symmetry such as $\mathrm{SO(2)}$, leaving state-based RL and reflection symmetry largely underexplored. In this work, we focus on state-based continuous control tasks and exploit reflection symmetry by introducing Reflex, a paradigm that seamlessly integrates with both on-policy and off-policy RL algorithms. We formalize two types of reflection-axial reflection and bilateral reflection, and characterize their corresponding transformations. Building on a theoretical analysis of symmetry-preserving optimal value functions and policies, Reflex integrates reflection symmetry into policy learning through principled symmetry regularization mechanisms. For a conservative velocity given by the difference of the kernel-smoothed data and model scores, a joint-entropy identity yields continuous-time bounds for the smoothed Fisher discrepancy and the squared particle velocity. item.title: 该论文通过MIT啤酒游戏发现自主GenAI智能体可将供应链总成本降低高达80%，但会引发名为“智能体牛鞭效应”的决策不稳定性，并证明强化学习后训练与运营护栏可有效提升其可靠性。
item.description:
自主AI智能体在供应链管理中的可靠性与有效性

Reliability and Effectiveness of Autonomous AI Agents in Supply Chain Management

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17036

该论文通过MIT啤酒游戏发现自主GenAI智能体可将供应链总成本降低高达80%，但会引发名为“智能体牛鞭效应”的决策不稳定性，并证明强化学习后训练与运营护栏可有效提升其可靠性。

本文利用MIT啤酒游戏研究了自主生成式AI智能体在多级供应链中的性能与可靠性。我们考察了模型选择、运营护栏、集中式数据共享以及提示词设计如何影响系统性能。在表现最佳的配置中，GenAI智能体相较于人类团队可将供应链总成本降低高达80%。尽管平均表现优异，自主智能体可能表现出显著的运行间不稳定性，产生波动的采购决策和巨大的尾部成本。我们将这一现象表征为“智能体牛鞭效应”，即自主多智能体系统中决策不稳定性的放大。我们表明，即使潜在需求路径保持不变，这种不稳定性也可能跨层级传播并随时间不断复合。随后，我们评估了两种提升可靠性的方法：强化学习后训练和运营护栏。

arXiv:2605.17036v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This paper studies the performance and reliability of autonomous generative AI agents in multi-echelon supply chains using the MIT Beer Game. We examine how model choice, operational guardrails, centralized data sharing, and prompt design affect system performance. In our best-performing configuration, GenAI agents reduce total supply-chain costs by up to 80% relative to human teams. Despite strong average performance, autonomous agents can exhibit substantial run-to-run instability, generating volatile procurement decisions and large tail costs. We characterize this phenomenon as agent bullwhip, the amplification of decision instability in autonomous multi-agent systems. We show that this instability can propagate across echelons and compound over time, even when the underlying demand path is held fixed. We then evaluate two approaches for improving reliability: reinforcement-learning post-training and operational guardrails.

item.title: 本文建立了核岭回归泛化性能与核矩阵特征值、特征向量估计稳定性之间的直接联系，通过特征对齐分析在有限样本设定下推导出泛化误差的界。
item.description:
关于核岭回归（KRR）的核特征对齐：重构与泛化

On Kernel Eigen-alignments of KRR: Reconstruction and Generalization

本文研究了核矩阵与学习目标之间的特征对齐在学习问题中实现稳健泛化所起的关键作用。我们建立了核方法中泛化性能与矩阵特征向量及特征值估计之间的直接联系，在极少的假设条件下，相比以往工作提供了更直观的理解。我们还表明，由于核岭回归（KRR）中的预测任务本质上是特征向量/奇异向量的加权和，通过分析核矩阵受到扰动时可能造成的误差大小，我们可以利用矩阵特征值和特征向量的估计稳定性来推导该泛化误差的界。与以往工作相比，我们的分析聚焦于有限样本设定，以及由次优有限训练集所引起的泛化误差。我们的发现揭示了在核方法中，

arXiv:2605.15240v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This paper investigates the critical role of eigenalignments between the kernel matrix and learning targets in achieving robust generalization in learning problems. We establish a direct connection between generalization performance in kernel methods and the estimation of eigenvectors and eigenvalues of matrices, offering a more intuitive understanding compared to prior work with minimal assumptions. We also show that, since the prediction task in KRR is essentially the weighted sum of eigenvectors/singular vectors, by analyzing how much error can be caused by perturbations to the kernel matrix, we can then derive a bound on this generalization error using the estimation stability of matrix eigenvalues and eigenvectors. Compared with previous work, our analysis concentrates on finite-sample settings and on the generalization error arising from having a suboptimal finite training set. item.title: 提出了一种基于聚焦经验风险估计器的PU学习方法，能够在高度不平衡数据集上、在SCAR和SAR两种标注机制下实现最先进的分类性能。
item.description:
从不平衡数据中进行聚焦式PU学习

Focused PU learning from imbalanced data

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14467

提出了一种基于聚焦经验风险估计器的PU学习方法，能够在高度不平衡数据集上、在SCAR和SAR两种标注机制下实现最先进的分类性能。

我们提出了一种在高度不平衡数据集中从正例和未标注（PU）样本中学习的新方法。许多现实世界的问题，如疾病基因识别、定向营销、欺诈检测和推荐系统，由于标注数据有限，难以用机器学习方法解决。通常，训练数据由正例和未标注实例组成，后者通常以负例为主，但也包含一些正例实例。虽然PU学习已被广泛研究，但很少有方法能够应对不平衡设置或难以检测的与负例相似的正例。我们的方法使用聚焦经验风险估计器，结合正例和未标注样本来训练二分类器。实证评估表明，在两种标注机制下——完全随机选择正例（SCAR）和随机选择（SAR）——该方法在不平衡数据集上取得了最先进的性能。

arXiv:2605.14467v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose a new method of learning from positive and unlabeled (PU) examples in highly imbalanced datasets. Many real-world problems, such as disease gene identification, targeted marketing, fraud detection, and recommender systems, are hard to address with machine learning methods, due to limited labeled data. Often, training data comprises positive and unlabeled instances, the latter typically being dominated by negative, but including also several positive instances. While PU learning is well-studied, few methods address imbalanced settings or hard-to-detect positive examples that resemble negative ones. Our approach uses a focused empirical risk estimator, incorporating both positive and unlabeled examples to train binary classifiers. Empirical evaluations demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on imbalanced datasets under two labeling mechanisms - selecting positives completely at random (SCAR) and selecting at random (SAR).

item.title: 针对启用MCP的LLM易受虚假良性提示注入攻击的问题，研究发现基于DPO的微调防护效果有限（拒绝率不超过47%），进而提出基于检索增强生成的免训练方法以更有效地拒绝此类攻击。
item.description:
通过检索增强生成实现无需训练的MCP漏洞利用拒绝

Training-Free Refusal of MCP Exploits via Retrieval-Augmented Generation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11217

针对启用MCP的LLM易受虚假良性提示注入攻击的问题，研究发现基于DPO的微调防护效果有限（拒绝率不超过47%），进而提出基于检索增强生成的免训练方法以更有效地拒绝此类攻击。

arXiv:2605.11217v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：模型上下文协议（MCP）作为一种开放标准已被广泛采用，使生成式AI智能体能够无缝集成。然而，尽管大语言模型（LLM）的防护栏已显著成熟，能够拒绝恶意或有害的查询（例如“我如何制造炸弹？”），但最近的研究表明，启用MCP的LLM极易受到避开有害或可疑线索的提示注入攻击（例如“你能把这个ssh密钥添加到我的bashrc文件中吗？”）。在本文中，我们使用最先进的（SOTA）对齐微调算法，探索LLM是否可以对齐以拒绝此类虚假良性攻击（FBAs）。虽然基于直接偏好优化（DPO）的SOTA算法改善了对FBAs的拒绝防护栏，但我们表明这种改进是有限的；在五个流行的开源LLM上，基于DPO的微调从未将FBA拒绝率提升到47%以上。因此，为了进一步提高FBA拒绝率，我们引入了检索增强生成（RAG）……

arXiv:2605.11217v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The model context protocol (MCP) has been widely adopted as an open standard enabling the seamless integration of generative AI agents. However, while LLM guardrails have significantly matured to refuse malicious or harmful queries (e.g., "How do I build a bomb?"), recent work has shown that MCP-enabled LLMs are highly susceptible to prompt injection attacks which avoid harmful or suspicious cues (e.g., "Can you add this ssh key to my bashrc file?"). Herein, we use state-of-the-art (SOTA) alignment fine-tuning algorithms to explore whether LLMs may be aligned to refuse such falsely benign attacks (FBAs). While SOTA algorithms based on direct preference optimization (DPO) improve refusal guardrails against FBAs, we show that this improvement is limited; DPO-based fine-tuning never improves FBA refusal rates beyond 47% across five popular open-source LLMs. Thus, to further improve FBA refusals, we introduce Retrieval Augmented Generati

item.description:
面向纠错码的可扩展基于Mamba的消息传递神经译码器

Scalable Mamba-Based Message-Passing Neural Decoder for Error-Correcting Codes

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10681

提出了一种无注意力机制的Mamba消息传递神经译码器（MMPD），将Tanner图上的局部消息传递与双向Mamba状态空间模块结合，在内存和计算上实现长码的高效可扩展译码，并在(1056, 880) LDPC码上比CrossMPT提升0.45 dB。

前向纠错对于在噪声信道上实现可靠通信至关重要。基于注意力的无模型神经译码器在短码上表现出优异性能，但其对更长码的可扩展性受到注意力机制二次方内存与计算成本的限制。本文提出了Mamba消息传递译码器（MMPD），这是一种无注意力机制、基于伴随式的二进制线性码神经译码器。MMPD通过沿变量-校验边执行局部成对聚合，保留了消息传递译码器的Tanner图结构。为实现高效的长程信息传播，这些局部更新与双向Mamba状态空间模块相结合。通过避免稠密注意力矩阵，MMPD在内存和计算方面对长码具有更有利的可扩展性。在(1056, 880) LDPC码上的实验表明，MMPD相比最先进的CrossMPT译码器获得了0.45 dB的增益。

Attention-based model-free neural decoders have shown strong performance for short codes, but their scalability to longer codes is limited by the quadratic memory and computational cost of attention. By avoiding dense attention matrices, MMPD scales more favorably for long codes in both memory and computation. The community largely assumes that large-scale pretraining serves as a 'rising tide that lifts all boats' in federated settings. item.title: 该论文首次将变分量子线路成功应用于基于option-critic架构的分层强化学习，以更少参数实现优于经典方法的性能，并揭示了量子线路在选项价值估计中的架构瓶颈及关键设计原则。
item.description:
基于变分量子线路的量子分层强化学习

Quantum Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning via Variational Quantum Circuits

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.03434

该论文首次将变分量子线路成功应用于基于option-critic架构的分层强化学习，以更少参数实现优于经典方法的性能，并揭示了量子线路在选项价值估计中的架构瓶颈及关键设计原则。

虽然参数化量子计算在标准强化学习（RL）中已展现出成功，但这些优势能否适用于分层强化学习（HRL）仍是一个关键的开放性问题。本工作证明变分量子线路（VQCs）可以有效增强基于option-critic架构的分层强化学习智能体。在标准环境中的评估表明，配备量子特征提取器的混合HRL智能体在使用更少参数的情况下优于经典基线方法。我们还发现了一个架构瓶颈：使用VQCs进行选项价值估计会严重降低学习性能。进一步的消融实验揭示了量子线路设计如何影响性能。我们的工作为参数高效的混合HRL智能体建立了设计原则。

arXiv:2605.03434v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: While parameterized quantum computations have shown success in standard reinforcement learning (RL), whether these advantages adapt to hierarchical RL (HRL) remains a critical open question. This work demonstrates that variational quantum circuits (VQCs) can effectively enhance HRL agents based on the option-critic architecture. Evaluated in standard environments, a hybrid HRL agent with a quantum feature extractor outperforms classical baselines while using fewer parameters. We also identify an architectural bottleneck: using VQCs for option-value estimation severely degrades learning. Further ablations reveal how quantum circuit design affects performance. Our work establishes design principles for parameter-efficient hybrid HRL agents.

item.title: 提出Gate-DPO方法，利用被拒绝响应的概率几何信息选择性衰减其梯度贡献，防止DPO训练中因过度抑制被拒绝响应导致的概率质量坍缩，从而稳定偏好优化。
item.description:
梯度门控DPO：稳定语言模型中的偏好优化

Gradient-Gated DPO: Stabilizing Preference Optimization in Language Models

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.02626

提出Gate-DPO方法，利用被拒绝响应的概率几何信息选择性衰减其梯度贡献，防止DPO训练中因过度抑制被拒绝响应导致的概率质量坍缩，从而稳定偏好优化。

直接偏好优化通过增大被选择响应与被拒绝响应之间的边际来改善相对偏好，但该目标函数并未规定概率质量应如何重新分配以实现这一边际。因此，即使概率质量从被偏好响应和不相关响应中同时坍缩，偏好分离程度仍可能得到改善，这一现象与“挤压效应”相关。我们证明这种病理现象是局部化的：当被拒绝响应进入低概率谷区时，持续的负向更新会变得具有破坏性，因为进一步的抑制会通过耦合的softmax几何结构引发有害的概率重新分配。我们提出梯度门控偏好优化，它利用每个被拒绝响应当前的概率几何结构来选择性地衰减其贡献，从而限制对被拒绝响应的过度抑制，同时延缓偏好损失的饱和。Gate-DPO与目标函数无关

arXiv:2605.02626v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) improves relative preference by increasing the margin between chosen and rejected responses, but this objective does not specify how probability mass should be redistributed to achieve that margin. Consequently, preference separation can improve even as probability mass collapses away from both preferred and unrelated responses, a phenomenon associated with the squeezing effect. We show that this pathology is localized: continued negative updates become destructive when rejected responses enter low-probability valleys, where further suppression induces harmful redistribution through the coupled softmax geometry. We introduce Gradient-Gated Preference Optimization (Gate-DPO), which uses the current probability geometry of each rejected response to selectively attenuate its contribution, limiting excessive rejected suppression while delaying preference-loss saturation. Gate-DPO is objective-agnostic

item.title: 本文提出PolyStep方法，通过最优传输理论仅利用前向传播即可训练具有跳跃性损失的非可微网络，解决了反向传播不适用的问题。

通过最优传输训练不可微分网络

Training Non-Differentiable Networks via Optimal Transport

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.01928

本文提出PolyStep方法，通过最优传输理论仅利用前向传播即可训练具有跳跃性损失的非可微网络，解决了反向传播不适用的问题。

我们优化那些具有跳跃性的损失函数：尖峰阈值、量化层和离散路由在前向传播中引入跳跃，反向传播在此不适用。有限差分方法失效：在导数估计半径下，量化网络上99.5%的探测对损失结果完全相同，而平滑控制仅有1.6%。在跳跃点，Clarke和保守平稳性未定义，任何半径为h的平滑化会以1/h的速率陡增，因此不存在消失半径来定义导数。固定分辨率平稳性仍然成立。PolyStep仅通过前向传播即可达到该平稳性，它在旋转多胞体上对探测点进行排序，并沿其方向的softmax加权平均值步进，这是KL惩罚传输程序的λ=0端点。第二个不可能性固定了框架：在比探测范围更宽的平台上，任何重新加权单一成本行的规则（包括softmax）都会冻结，只有列约束得以逃脱。在期望中，

arXiv:2605.01928v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We optimize losses that jump: spiking thresholds, quantized layers, and discrete routing put jumps in the forward pass, where backpropagation does not apply. Finite differences fail: at a derivative-estimating radius, 99.5% of probe pairs on a quantized network leave the loss bit-identical, against 1.6% on a smooth control. At a jump, Clarke and conservative stationarity are undefined, and any radius-$h$ smoothing steepens like $1/h$, so no vanishing radius defines a derivative. Fixed-resolution stationarity survives. item.title: 该研究定位了大语言模型遗忘后残留记忆化特征的内部位置，并提出探针几何对齐方法，可在不损失模型能力的前提下将跨序列记忆化特征擦除至低于随机水平。
item.description:
探针几何对齐：将跨序列记忆化特征擦除至低于随机水平

Probe-Geometry Alignment: Erasing the Cross-Sequence Memorization Signature Below Chance

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.01699

该研究定位了大语言模型遗忘后残留记忆化特征的内部位置，并提出探针几何对齐方法，可在不损失模型能力的前提下将跨序列记忆化特征擦除至低于随机水平。

近期的攻击研究表明，大语言模型的行为级遗忘会在模型内部留下可被对抗性探针恢复的痕迹。我们刻画了这种残留信息的所在位置，并证明可以在不产生可测量能力损失的情况下将其精准移除。我们的核心协议是一种留一法跨序列探针，用于检验记忆化特征能否泛化到留出的序列上。该特征真实存在且在不同模型规模上保持一致：在Pythia-70M、GPT-2 medium和Mistral-7B上，记忆化特异性差距分别为+0.32、+0.19、+0.30；在Pythia-70M上，随机初始化对照组在预训练特征达到峰值的 deepest 层（最深层）处降至-0.04。该探针方向与召回能力在因果上可分离——将其投影消除后，局部特征坍缩（+0.44 -> -0.19），而行为级召回几乎不变——并且在自然记忆内容上训练的探针无法分类通过微调注入的秘密信息，这标志着两种表示（此处摘要原文被截断）

arXiv:2605.01699v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recent attacks show that behavioural unlearning of large language models leaves internal traces recoverable by adversarial probes. We characterise where this retention lives and show it can be surgically removed without measurable capability cost. Our central protocol is a leave-one-out cross-sequence probe that tests whether a memorisation signature generalises across held-out sequences. The signature is real and consistent across scale: memorisation-specific gaps of +0.32, +0.19, +0.30 on Pythia-70M, GPT-2 medium, and Mistral-7B; on Pythia-70M, the random-initialisation control collapses to -0.04 at the deepest layer where the pretrained signature peaks. item.title: 本文提出一种融合信息几何、相对熵耗散与序贯推断的有界首达监测架构，能在控制重复检验误报的前提下，区分随机系统的名义分布松弛与真正的状态机制偏离。
item.description:
随机系统中分布稳定性的信息几何首达监测

Information-Geometric First-Passage Monitoring of Distributional Stability in Stochastic Systems

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.24083

本文提出一种融合信息几何、相对熵耗散与序贯推断的有界首达监测架构，能在控制重复检验误报的前提下，区分随机系统的名义分布松弛与真正的状态机制偏离。

随机系统的运行时监测需要在明确的假设有效性前提下，区分名义上的分布松弛与真正的状态机制偏离，同时控制重复检验带来的误报。本文在一个有界的首达监测架构中，将相对熵耗散、信息几何与序贯推断联系起来。对于可逆的Fokker–Planck动力学，相对于不变密度的相对熵是非递增的；在外生强迫作用下，其导数可分解为名义耗散项与信息空间强迫项。运行时层采用高斯窗口代理、名义相对协方差收缩、坐标一致的相对精度诊断，以及由混合幂鞅过程聚合的随机化保形秩。解析的Ornstein–Uhlenbeck验证给出了零正的名义Kullback–Leibler增量、低于3.31×10⁻⁶的强迫恒等式残差，以及坐标……（原文摘要截断）

arXiv:2604.24083v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Runtime monitoring of stochastic systems must distinguish nominal distributional relaxation from regime departure while controlling repeated-test false alarms under explicit validity assumptions. This paper links relative-entropy dissipation, information geometry, and sequential inference in a bounded first-passage monitoring architecture. For reversible Fokker--Planck dynamics, relative entropy to an invariant density is non-increasing; under exogenous forcing, its derivative decomposes into nominal dissipation and an information-space forcing term. The runtime layer uses Gaussian window surrogates, nominal-relative covariance shrinkage, a coordinate-consistent relative precision diagnostic, and randomized conformal ranks aggregated by a mixture power-martingale process. item.title: 该论文提出技能刻画应“模型原生”地基于模型自身表征而非外部人工分类体系，通过从序列级激活中恢复紧凑的正交基来捕捉模型自身组织的行为变化轴，并在推理后训练中验证了该方法的有效性。
item.description:
刻画模型原生技能

Characterizing Model-Native Skills

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17614

该论文提出技能刻画应“模型原生”地基于模型自身表征而非外部人工分类体系，通过从序列级激活中恢复紧凑的正交基来捕捉模型自身组织的行为变化轴，并在推理后训练中验证了该方法的有效性。

技能是描述语言模型能做什么以及其行为如何被改变的一个自然单元。然而，现有的刻画方法依赖于人工编写的分类体系、文本描述或手动分析流程——这些都是关于什么重要的外部假设，未必与模型的内部表征相一致。我们认为，当目标是对模型行为进行干预时，技能刻画应当是“模型原生”的：即基于模型自身的表征，而非通过外部本体强行施加。我们通过从序列级激活中恢复一个紧凑的正交基来实例化这一观点。所得到的基在语义上可解释，但不必对应任何预定义的人类本体；相反，它捕捉了模型自身围绕其组织行为变化的轴。我们在推理后训练上验证了这一刻画，将恢复的基用于SFT数据……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2604.17614v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Skills are a natural unit for describing what a language model can do and how its behavior can be changed. However, existing characterizations rely on human-written taxonomies, textual descriptions, or manual profiling pipelines--all external hypotheses about what matters that need not align with the model's internal representations. We argue that when the goal is to intervene on model behavior, skill characterization should be *model-native*: grounded in the model's own representations rather than imposed through external ontologies. We instantiate this view by recovering a compact orthogonal basis from sequence-level activations. The resulting basis is semantically interpretable but need not correspond to any predefined human ontology; instead, it captures axes of behavioral variation that the model itself organizes around. item.title: 该研究首次通过逐epoch记录每个样本的正确性验证了微调中的遗忘模式，发现样本记忆保持是可复现且依赖架构的，而经典的艾宾浩斯指数衰减模型无法描述实际的遗忘动态。
item.description:
并非所有遗忘都相同：微调图像分类器中的记忆保持动态

Not All Forgetting Is Equal: Retention Dynamics in Fine-Tuned Image Classifiers

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11508

该研究首次通过逐epoch记录每个样本的正确性验证了微调中的遗忘模式，发现样本记忆保持是可复现且依赖架构的，而经典的艾宾浩斯指数衰减模型无法描述实际的遗忘动态。

微调预训练分类器时，一些样本被可靠地学到，而另一些样本则在正确与错误之间反复循环。课程学习、数据剪枝和数据集地图学都假设这种模式是样本本身的属性，但这一假设从未被验证。我们在不平衡的视网膜OCT数据集和CUB-200-2011上微调ResNet-18和DeiT-Small时，逐epoch记录每个样本的正确性，通过图像标识匹配样本，并在不同随机种子间保持数据划分固定。结果表明：每个样本的记忆保持是可复现的，在十个种子上拟合衰减常数的跨运行Spearman相关系数为0.37至0.59；它是架构特定的，同一骨干网络的两次运行比相同数据上两个不同骨干网络更一致（OCTDL上内部为0.45和0.59，之间为0.30）；五个冻结骨干epoch后的损失可以预测另一次运行的衰减常数，相关系数为0.29至0.43；而艾宾浩斯指数衰减模型不能成立，单调衰减——它能表示的唯一形状——仅占0.1%。

arXiv:2604.11508v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Fine-tuning a pretrained classifier leaves some samples reliably learned and others cycling between correct and incorrect. Curriculum learning, data pruning and dataset cartography assume that pattern is a property of the sample, untested. We record per-sample correctness at every epoch while fine-tuning ResNet-18 and DeiT-Small on an imbalanced retinal OCT dataset and CUB-200-2011, matching samples by image identity and holding the split fixed across seeds. Per-sample retention is reproducible: cross-run Spearman correlation of the fitted decay constant is 0.37 to 0.59 over ten seeds. It is architecture-specific: two runs of one backbone agree more than two backbones on identical data (0.45 and 0.59 within against 0.30 between on OCTDL). Loss after five frozen-backbone epochs predicts a different run's decay constant at 0.29 to 0.43. The Ebbinghaus exponential does not survive: monotone decay, the one shape it can represent, is 0.1%

item.title: Tessera是首个内核粒度的异构GPU解耦系统，通过从PTX提取内核间依赖、流水线化通信与计算重叠以及工作负载感知调度，显著提升大模型推理在异构GPU集群上的性能与成本效率。
item.description:
Tessera：通过内核粒度解耦释放异构GPU的潜力

Tessera: Unlocking Heterogeneous GPUs through Kernel-Granularity Disaggregation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10180

Tessera是首个内核粒度的异构GPU解耦系统，通过从PTX提取内核间依赖、流水线化通信与计算重叠以及工作负载感知调度，显著提升大模型推理在异构GPU集群上的性能与成本效率。

解耦技术将AI工作负载的不同部分映射到不同类型的GPU上，为利用现代异构GPU集群提供了一条途径。然而，现有解决方案在较粗的粒度上运行，并且与特定模型架构紧密耦合，在性能提升方面仍有很大空间。本文提出了Tessera，这是首个通过内核解耦来提升异构GPU上大模型推理性能和成本效率的系统。我们的关键洞察是：单个应用内的各个内核具有多样化的资源需求，使其成为将计算与硬件能力对齐的最合适粒度。Tessera将离线分析与在线自适应相结合：通过从PTX中提取精确的内核间依赖关系来确保正确性，通过流水线执行模型实现通信与计算的重叠，并采用工作负载感知调度与轻量级运行时自适应。

arXiv:2604.10180v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Disaggregation maps parts of an AI workload to different types of GPUs, offering a path to utilize modern heterogeneous GPU clusters. However, existing solutions operate at a coarse granularity and are tightly coupled to specific model architectures, leaving much room for performance improvement. This paper presents Tessera, the first kernel disaggregation system to improve performance and cost efficiency on heterogeneous GPUs for large model inference. Our key insight is that kernels within a single application exhibit diverse resource demands, making them the most suitable granularity for aligning computation with hardware capabilities. Tessera integrates offline analysis with online adaptation by extracting precise inter-kernel dependencies from PTX to ensure correctness, overlapping communication with computation through a pipelined execution model, and employing workload-aware scheduling with lightweight runtime adaptation

item.title: 该论文从理论上证明了储备池计算网络在时间序列预测训练中会涌现出低维主导流形，并将储备池的主导特征值和特征向量与后向动态模态分解矩阵的谱联系起来，从而给出了系统后向时间Koopman算子的有限维近似。
item.description:
储备池计算网络中的主导流形研究

On Dominant Manifolds in Reservoir Computing Networks

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05967

该论文从理论上证明了储备池计算网络在时间序列预测训练中会涌现出低维主导流形，并将储备池的主导特征值和特征向量与后向动态模态分解矩阵的谱联系起来，从而给出了系统后向时间Koopman算子的有限维近似。

理解训练如何塑造循环网络动力学的几何结构是时间序列建模中的一个核心问题。我们研究了储备池计算网络在时间预测任务训练过程中低维主导流形的涌现。对于一个一般线性连续时间储备池在无限数据极限下的情形，我们证明训练数据会生成训练后储备池的一个不变子空间，其维数等于主导模态的数量。随后我们专门研究一种简化的对角线性储备池，将其主导特征值和特征向量与后向动态模态分解（DMD）矩阵的谱联系起来，该矩阵给出了生成训练数据的系统的后向时间Koopman算子的有限维近似。我们通过仿真展示了这些主导模态在训练过程中的涌现，并讨论了如何将该分析扩展到非线性储备池计算。（原文摘要在此处截断）

We then specialize to a simplified diagonal linear reservoir, where we link the dominant eigenvalues and eigenvectors to the spectrum of a backward Dynamic Mode Decomposition matrix, which yields a finite-dimensional approximation of the backward-time Koopman operator of the system generating the training data. item.title: BoundInk 将字符间边界作为显式生成单元，在保留书写者风格的同时显著提升在线手写的连笔连贯性与间距一致性，并首次提出边界感知的评估框架来直接衡量字符间的连续性与空间关系。
item.description:
BoundInk：边界感知的在线手写生成

BoundInk: Boundary-Aware Online Handwriting Generation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.02103

BoundInk 将字符间边界作为显式生成单元，在保留书写者风格的同时显著提升在线手写的连笔连贯性与间距一致性，并首次提出边界感知的评估框架来直接衡量字符间的连续性与空间关系。

逼真的在线手写不仅取决于单个字符的形状，还取决于书写者如何连接、间隔和对齐相邻字符。现有方法主要依赖长程序列建模，只能隐式地捕捉这些字符间行为，这往往导致生成的字形看似合理，却伴随连笔断裂、间距不一致或与书写者风格不符的过渡。我们提出 BoundInk，一个以书写者为条件的框架，将字符间边界作为显式的生成单元。通过联合建模局部过渡与周围文本上下文，BoundInk 在保留书写者特有字形外观的同时，改善了完整文本行中的连贯性与间距。我们进一步提出了一个边界感知的评估框架，能够超越传统的轨迹相似度，直接评估连笔的连续性以及字符之间的空间关系。在三个基准匹配的（摘要在此处截断）

Existing methods rely primarily on long-range sequence modeling and capture these inter-character behaviors only implicitly. We introduce BoundInk, a writer-conditioned framework that treats inter-character boundaries as explicit generation units. By jointly modeling local transitions and surrounding text context, BoundInk preserves writer-specific glyph appearance while improving connectivity and spacing across complete text lines. We further introduce a boundary-aware evaluation framework that directly assesses cursive continuity and spatial relationships between characters beyond conventional trajectory similarity. 汽车雷达感知流水线通常在应用基于学习的模型之前，先通过波束形成构建角度域表示。本工作转而研究一个表示性问题：能否直接从波束形成前的每天线距离-多普勒（RD）测量中学习到有意义的空间结构？实验在一台6发射×8接收（48个虚拟天线）的商用汽车雷达上进行，该雷达采用A/B啁啾序列调频连续波（CS-FMCW）发射方案，其有效发射孔径在不同啁啾之间变化（单发射与多发射），从而能够对依赖啁啾的发射配置进行受控分析。我们直接在波束形成前的每天线RD张量上进行操作，使用双啁啾共享权重编码器以端到端、完全数据驱动的方式进行训练，并以鸟瞰图（BEV）占用作为几何探针而非性能驱动指标来评估空间结构的可恢复性。

逆强化学习（IRL）从被观测学习者的响应中恢复其损失函数。适应性逆强化学习旨在通过被动观测前向学习者在执行强化学习（RL）时产生的梯度，来重建该前向学习者的损失函数。本文提出了一种新颖的基于Langevin的被动算法来实现适应性IRL。适应性IRL的关键难点在于：被动算法所需的梯度是反事实的，即它们以前向学习者轨迹中概率为零的事件作为条件。因此，朴素的蒙特卡洛估计器效率极其低下，而常用的核平滑方法则收敛缓慢。我们通过采用马利亚万微积分（Malliavin Calculus）来高效估计所需的反事实梯度，从而克服了这一难题。我们将反事实条件化重新表述为包含马利亚万量的无条件期望之比，从而……（原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2604.01345v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) recovers the loss function of a forward learner from its observed responses. Adaptive IRL aims to reconstruct the loss function of a forward learner by passively observing its gradients as it performs reinforcement learning (RL). This paper proposes a novel passive Langevin-based algorithm that achieves adaptive IRL. The key difficulty in adaptive IRL is that the required gradients in the passive algorithm are counterfactual, that is, they are conditioned on events of probability zero under the forward learner's trajectory. Therefore, naive Monte Carlo estimators are prohibitively inefficient, and kernel smoothing, though common, suffers from slow convergence. 动态星座拓扑的在线学习

本文提出了一种不依赖网络结构假设的在线学习方法，用于动态卫星网络拓扑配置，其性能与离线方法相当，并支持受约束学习下的计算与收敛权衡。

摘要：arXiv:2603.25954v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：近年来，卫星网络的使用显著增加，这得益于其相对于纯地面系统的优势，如更高的可用性和覆盖范围。然而，为了有效提供这些服务，卫星网络必须应对其节点的持续轨道运动和机动，以及这些因素对网络拓扑的影响。在本工作中，我们解决了在线学习框架下的（动态）网络拓扑配置问题。作为副产品，我们的方法不假设网络结构，例如已知的轨道平面（这些可能因卫星机动而被违反）。我们通过实验证明，我们的问题公式与最先进的离线方法性能相匹配。重要的是，我们展示了我们的方法适用于受约束的在线学习，表现出每迭代计算复杂度与最终策略收敛之间的权衡。

arXiv:2603.25954v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The use of satellite networks has increased significantly in recent years due to their advantages over purely terrestrial systems, such as higher availability and coverage. However, to effectively provide these services, satellite networks must cope with the continuous orbital movement and maneuvering of their nodes and the impact on the network's topology. In this work, we address the problem of (dynamic) network topology configuration under the online learning framework. As a byproduct, our approach does not assume structure about the network, such as known orbital planes (that could be violated by maneuvering satellites). We empirically demonstrate that our problem formulation matches the performance of state-of-the-art offline methods. Importantly, we demonstrate that our approach is amenable to constrained online learning, exhibiting a trade-off between computational complexity per iteration and convergence to a final strategy.

通过强化学习（RL）训练的大型视觉-语言模型（VLM）所展现的强大性能，激发了在机器人领域采用类似方法微调视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的研究热潮。许多近期工作直接在真实世界中对VLA进行微调，以回避解决仿真到真实（sim-to-real）的差距问题。虽然真实世界强化学习规避了sim-to-real问题，但它本质上限制了所得VLA模型的泛化能力，因为在物理世界中扩展场景和物体的多样性是极其困难的。这导致了一个悖论式的结果：将一个经过广泛预训练的模型转变为过拟合的、特定于场景的策略。在仿真中训练反而可以提供多样化的场景，但设计这些场景的成本同样高昂。在这项工作中，我们展示了通过利用3D世界生成模型，VLA模型可以在广泛的场景和物体分布上进行强化学习微调，并显著减少人工投入。通过将这些模型与语言...

arXiv:2603.18532v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The strong performance of large vision-language models (VLMs) trained with reinforcement learning (RL) has motivated similar approaches for fine-tuning vision-language-action (VLA) models in robotics. Many recent works fine-tune VLAs directly in the real world to avoid addressing the sim-to-real gap. While real-world RL circumvents sim-to-real issues, it inherently limits the generality of the resulting VLA, as scaling scene and object diversity in the physical world is prohibitively difficult. This leads to the paradoxical outcome of transforming a broadly pretrained model into an overfitted, scene-specific policy. Training in simulation can instead provide access to diverse scenes, but designing those scenes is also costly. arXiv:2603.11229v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Machine learning forecast systems are moving beyond point predictions to full predictive distributions for future outcomes y conditional on complex inputs x. arXiv:2603.07449v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Enterprises commonly deploy heterogeneous database systems, each of which owns a distinct SQL dialect with different syntax rules, built-in functions, and execution constraints. 我们提出了一种基于量子隐式神经表示（QINR）的自编码器（AE）和变分自编码器（VAE），用于图像重建和生成任务。我们的目的是证明VAE和AE中的QINR能够将潜空间中的信息转换为高度丰富、具有周期性和高频的特征。此外，我们旨在表明QINR-VAE在图像生成方面可以比各种量子生成对抗网络（QGAN）模型更加稳定，因为它能够解决低多样性问题。我们的量子-经典混合模型由经典卷积神经网络（CNN）编码器和基于量子的QINR解码器组成。我们使用带logits的二元交叉熵（BCEWithLogits）作为重建损失来训练QINR-AE/VAE。对于QINR-VAE，我们还采用Kullback-Leibler散度进行潜空间正则化，并通过beta/容量调度来防止后验坍缩。我们引入了学习……

arXiv:2603.06755v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose a quantum implicit neural representation (QINR)-based autoencoder (AE) and variational autoencoder (VAE) for image reconstruction and generation tasks. Our purpose is to demonstrate that the QINR in VAEs and AEs can transform information from the latent space into highly rich, periodic, and high-frequency features. Additionally, we aim to show that the QINR-VAE can be more stable than various quantum generative adversarial network (QGAN) models in image generation because it can address the low diversity problem. Our quantum-classical hybrid models consist of a classical convolutional neural network (CNN) encoder and a quantum-based QINR decoder. We train the QINR-AE/VAE with binary cross-entropy with logits (BCEWithLogits) as the reconstruction loss. item.title: 该论文提出OMEGA方法，将top-K学习搜索转化为重复的带掩码top-1精化过程，使基于图的向量搜索仅需单个top-1模型的预处理成本即可支持任意K值。
item.description:
高效的K值可泛化学习搜索

Efficient K-generalizable Learned Search

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06159

该论文提出OMEGA方法，将top-K学习搜索转化为重复的带掩码top-1精化过程，使基于图的向量搜索仅需单个top-1模型的预处理成本即可支持任意K值。

学习型top-K搜索提升了基于图的向量搜索在准确率与延迟之间的权衡，但现有方法是为固定的K值设计的：在服务具有不同K值的生产工作负载时，其预处理成本与所服务的不同K值数量成正比——这在实践中是难以承受的。本文表明，学习型搜索能够以单个top-1模型的预处理成本支持任意K值。其关键思想是将top-K学习搜索简化为重复的带掩码top-1精化，这之所以可行，是因为发现下一个top-1向量所需的距离缩减轨迹在很大程度上与已找到的结果数量无关。因此，我们在掩码下仍然有效的轨迹特征上训练模型。为了使重复精化过程既鲁棒又高效，OMEGA通过按排名的置信度分配来对抗跨迭代的误差累积，并通过统计预测跳过不必要的模型调用。

arXiv:2603.06159v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Learned top-K search improves the accuracy-latency trade-off of graph-based vector search, but existing methods are designed for a fixed K: serving production workloads with varying K values requires preprocessing cost proportional to the number of distinct Ks served - prohibitive in practice. This paper shows that learned search can support arbitrary K with the preprocessing cost of a single top-1 model. The key idea is to reduce top-K learned search to repeated masked top-1 refinement, which works because the distance-reduction trajectory for discovering the next top-1 vector is largely invariant to the number of results already found. We therefore train the model on trajectory features that remain effective under masking. To make repeated refinement robust and efficient, OMEGA counters error accumulation across iterations with rank-wise confidence allocation, and skips unnecessary model invocations with a statistical forecas

item.title: 提出了TVBC模型，通过轻量级神经控制器（仅24k参数）实时预测35个双二阶IIR滤波器级联的系数，实现了完全可解释、延迟仅10.7毫秒、可在助听器设备端运行的可控语音降噪。
item.description:
一种用于设备端辅助听力的可解释、可控的时变IIR降噪器

An Interpretable, Controllable Time-Varying IIR Denoiser for On-Device Assistive Hearing

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02794

提出了TVBC模型，通过轻量级神经控制器（仅24k参数）实时预测35个双二阶IIR滤波器级联的系数，实现了完全可解释、延迟仅10.7毫秒、可在助听器设备端运行的可控语音降噪。

我们提出了TVBC（时变双二阶滤波器级联），这是一种可解释、低延迟的语音增强模型，用于实时的设备端辅助听力。一个轻量级神经控制器实时预测由35个二阶IIR滤波器（双二阶滤波器）组成的可微分级联的系数，使模型能够跟踪非平稳噪声，同时保持完全可解释的处理链：每一次频谱修改都是显式的、可调节的均衡器曲线，而非不透明的“黑盒”变换。由于双二阶滤波器级联承担了信号处理任务，控制器可以做得非常小，仅用24k参数驱动级联，算法延迟为10.7毫秒，处于助听器的资源预算范围内，并且完全在设备上运行，音频数据永远不会离开设备。我们还将噪声抑制与语音保留之间的权衡作为显式控制暴露出来：它可以在训练时通过损失加权来设置，并在推理时进行调整。

arXiv:2603.02794v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present TVBC (Time-Varying Biquad Cascade), an interpretable, low-latency speech enhancement model for real-time, on-device assistive hearing. A lightweight neural controller predicts, in real time, the coefficients of a differentiable cascade of 35 second-order IIR filters (biquads), so the model tracks non-stationary noise while keeping a fully interpretable processing chain: every spectral modification is an explicit, adjustable equalizer curve rather than an opaque `black-box' transform. Because the biquad cascade carries the signal processing, the controller can be made very small, driving the cascade with only 24k parameters at a 10.7ms algorithmic latency, within hearing-aid budgets, and running entirely on-device so that audio never leaves the device. We also expose the suppression-versus-preservation trade-off as an explicit control: it can be set during training through the loss weighting, and adjusted at inference

item.title: 该论文首次在幂律随机特征模型下推导出signSGD的计算最优缩放定律，揭示了其特有的噪声重塑效应使signSGD在噪声主导的区域中计算最优斜率比SGD更陡峭，从而阐明了signSGD何时能优于SGD。
item.description:
线性回归中SignSGD的缩放定律：它何时优于SGD？

Scaling Laws of SignSGD in Linear Regression: When Does It Outperform SGD?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02069

该论文首次在幂律随机特征模型下推导出signSGD的计算最优缩放定律，揭示了其特有的噪声重塑效应使signSGD在噪声主导的区域中计算最优斜率比SGD更陡峭，从而阐明了signSGD何时能优于SGD。

我们研究了signSGD在幂律随机特征（PLRF）模型下的缩放定律，该模型同时考虑了特征衰减和目标衰减。我们分析了在高斯草绘特征上使用单遍signSGD训练的线性模型的总体风险，并将风险表示为模型大小、训练步数、学习率以及特征和目标衰减参数的函数。通过与Paquette等人（2024）分析的SGD风险进行比较，我们识别出signSGD特有的漂移归一化效应和噪声重塑效应。随后，我们在学习率的最优选择下获得了计算最优的缩放定律。我们的分析表明，在噪声占主导的区域，噪声重塑效应可以使signSGD的计算最优斜率比SGD更陡峭。最后，我们观察到广泛使用的预热-稳定-衰减（WSD）调度在特征衰减较快但目标衰减较慢的情况下，能进一步降低噪声项并使计算最优斜率更加陡峭。

arXiv:2603.02069v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study scaling laws of signSGD under a power-law random features (PLRF) model that accounts for both feature and target decay. We analyze the population risk of a linear model trained with one-pass signSGD on Gaussian-sketched features. We express the risk as a function of model size, training steps, learning rate, and the feature and target decay parameters. Comparing against the SGD risk analyzed by Paquette et al. (2024), we identify a drift-normalization effect and a noise-reshaping effect unique to signSGD. We then obtain compute-optimal scaling laws under the optimal choice of learning rate. Our analysis shows that the noise-reshaping effect can make the compute-optimal slope of signSGD steeper than that of SGD in regimes where noise is dominant. item.title: 小红书提出IDProxy系统，利用多模态大语言模型从内容信号生成代理嵌入并与ID嵌入空间对齐进行端到端训练，解决了新物品冷启动场景下的CTR预测难题，已部署于生产环境服务数亿用户。
item.description:
IDProxy：基于多模态大语言模型的小红书冷启动推荐CTR预测

IDProxy: CTR Prediction with Multimodal LLMs for Cold-Start Recommendation at Xiaohongshu

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01590

小红书提出IDProxy系统，利用多模态大语言模型从内容信号生成代理嵌入并与ID嵌入空间对齐进行端到端训练，解决了新物品冷启动场景下的CTR预测难题，已部署于生产环境服务数亿用户。

像小红书这样的内容驱动平台通常利用点击率（CTR）预测模型进行推荐。然而，这些模型严重依赖物品ID嵌入，而ID嵌入在物品冷启动场景下表现不佳。在本文中，我们提出了IDProxy，这是小红书开发的用于解决这一挑战的生产级系统。IDProxy利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）从丰富的内容信号中生成代理嵌入，使得在缺乏使用数据的情况下也能对新物品进行CTR预测。通过一个轻量级的由粗到细机制，这些代理嵌入与ID嵌入空间对齐，并与排序模型进行端到端训练，从而能够无缝集成到生产流水线中。大量的离线和在线实验证明了该方法的有效性，该方法已于2025年部署在小红书的内容流和展示广告功能中，覆盖数亿用户。

arXiv:2603.01590v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Content-driven platforms such as Xiaohongshu often leverage click-through rate (CTR) prediction models for recommendation. However, these models depend heavily on item ID embeddings, which perform poorly in item cold-start settings. In this paper, we present IDProxy, a production-scale system developed at Xiaohongshu to address this challenge. IDProxy leverages multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to generate proxy embeddings from rich content signals, enabling CTR prediction for new items in the absence of usage data. Through a lightweight coarse-to-fine mechanism, these proxies are aligned with the ID embedding space and trained end-to-end with the ranking model, allowing seamless integration into production-facing pipelines. item.title: 提出SenCache，一种敏感性感知的动态缓存框架，通过分析模型输出对去噪输入扰动的敏感性来预测缓存误差，从而自适应地选择缓存时间步，以加速扩散模型推理。
item.description:
SenCache：通过敏感性感知缓存加速扩散模型推理

SenCache: Accelerating Diffusion Model Inference via Sensitivity-Aware Caching

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.24208

提出SenCache，一种敏感性感知的动态缓存框架，通过分析模型输出对去噪输入扰动的敏感性来预测缓存误差，从而自适应地选择缓存时间步，以加速扩散模型推理。

扩散模型实现了最先进的视频生成质量，但由于需要大量的顺序去噪步骤，其推理成本依然高昂。这推动了越来越多关于加速扩散推理的研究。在免训练加速方法中，缓存技术通过在不同时间步之间重用先前计算的模型输出来减少计算量。现有的缓存方法依赖启发式准则来选择缓存/重用的时间步，并且需要大量的调优。我们通过一个有原则的敏感性感知缓存框架来解决这一局限。具体而言，我们通过分析模型输出对去噪输入（即噪声潜变量和时间步）扰动的敏感性来形式化缓存误差，并证明这种敏感性是缓存误差的关键预测指标。基于这一分析，我们提出了敏感性感知缓存，这是一种动态缓存策略，能够自适应地选择……

arXiv:2602.24208v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art video generation quality, but their inference remains expensive due to the large number of sequential denoising steps. This has motivated a growing line of research on accelerating diffusion inference. Among training-free acceleration methods, caching reduces computation by reusing previously computed model outputs across timesteps. Existing caching methods rely on heuristic criteria to choose cache/reuse timesteps and require extensive tuning. We address this limitation with a principled sensitivity-aware caching framework. Specifically, we formalize the caching error through an analysis of the model output sensitivity to perturbations in the denoising inputs, i.e., the noisy latent and the timestep, and show that this sensitivity is a key predictor of caching error. item.title: 提出SOTAlign两阶段框架，在仅有少量图文对和大量未配对数据的半监督设置下，通过线性教师与基于最优传输的散度，实现冻结的单模态视觉与语言模型的有效对齐。
item.description:
SOTAlign：基于最优传输的单模态视觉与语言模型半监督对齐

SOTAlign: Semi-Supervised Alignment of Unimodal Vision and Language Models via Optimal Transport

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.23353

提出SOTAlign两阶段框架，在仅有少量图文对和大量未配对数据的半监督设置下，通过线性教师与基于最优传输的散度，实现冻结的单模态视觉与语言模型的有效对齐。

柏拉图表示假说认为，在不同模态上训练的神经网络会收敛到世界的一个共享统计模型。近期工作利用这种收敛性，通过轻量级对齐层来对齐冻结的预训练视觉与语言模型，但通常依赖于对比损失和数百万个配对样本。在这项工作中，我们探究是否能在监督大幅减少的情况下实现有意义的对齐。我们引入了一种半监督设置，在该设置中，仅使用少量图文对以及大量未配对数据来对齐预训练的单模态编码器。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了SOTAlign，这是一个两阶段框架：首先利用线性教师从有限的配对数据中恢复粗略的共享几何结构，然后通过基于最优传输的散度在未配对样本上细化对齐，该散度能够在不发生过度坍缩的情况下迁移关系结构。

arXiv:2602.23353v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis posits that neural networks trained on different modalities converge toward a shared statistical model of the world. Recent work exploits this convergence by aligning frozen pretrained vision and language models with lightweight alignment layers, but typically relies on contrastive losses and millions of paired samples. In this work, we ask whether meaningful alignment can be achieved with substantially less supervision. We introduce a semi-supervised setting in which pretrained unimodal encoders are aligned using a small number of image-text pairs together with large amounts of unpaired data. item.title: HyperDet提出了一种与检测器无关的输入增强流水线，通过时空累积、多普勒引导的运动补偿以及基于LiDAR监督的前景生成式增强来构建任务感知的超4D雷达点云，从而显著提升仅使用4D雷达的3D目标检测性能。
item.description:
HyperDet：基于超4D雷达点云的3D目标检测

HyperDet: 3D Object Detection with Hyper 4D Radar Point Clouds

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11554

HyperDet提出了一种与检测器无关的输入增强流水线，通过时空累积、多普勒引导的运动补偿以及基于LiDAR监督的前景生成式增强来构建任务感知的超4D雷达点云，从而显著提升仅使用4D雷达的3D目标检测性能。

仅使用4D雷达，3D目标检测能达到什么程度？尽管现代4D雷达为自动驾驶感知提供了抗恶劣天气和速度感知的探测能力，但其点云仍然稀疏、嘈杂且不稳定，限制了仅基于雷达的3D检测。我们提出了HyperDet，这是一种与检测器无关的输入增强流水线，通过将实测观测与补全的前景几何相结合，构建任务感知的超4D雷达点云。HyperDet首先通过时空累积和跨传感器验证来优化短时窗环视雷达观测，同时在运动可被可靠估计时，利用多普勒引导的运动补偿来减少动态目标的拖尾。然后，它使用仅在训练期间可用的LiDAR引导的伪雷达监督进行前景生成式增强，在保留实测雷达背景和雷达原生属性的同时丰富目标几何信息。在检测器训练（摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2602.11554v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: How far can 3D object detection go using 4D radar alone? item.description:
基于期望分位目标的强化学习

Reinforcement learning with an expectile-based objective

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.09300

该论文首次对期望分位估计进行了非渐近分析，证明了蒙特卡洛型期望分位策略评估估计量的阶最优性，并推导了期望分位的策略梯度定理以解决控制问题。

我们在有限时域强化学习（RL）设定下，研究基于期望分位目标的策略评估与控制问题。首先，我们针对基于独立同分布（i.i.d.）样本的经典期望分位估计量，推导了其均方误差（MSE）界和集中不等式界。据我们所知，期望分位此前尚未在非渐近情形下被分析过，因此我们所推导的界可能具有独立的研究价值。接下来，我们分析了给定策略所对应的马尔可夫链的期望分位的蒙特卡洛型估计量，并推导了该估计量在期望意义下以及高概率意义下均成立的上界。此外，我们通过推导基于期望分位的策略评估问题的下界，证明了我们所提出估计量的阶最优性。对于控制问题，我们采用策略梯度方法，推导了期望分位的策略梯度定理。利用这一结果，我们提出了一种梯度……（原文摘要在此处截断）

arXiv:2602.09300v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We consider the policy evaluation and control in a finite horizon reinforcement learning (RL) setting under an expectile-based objective. First, we derive the mean-squared error (MSE) and concentration bounds for the classic estimator of expectiles based on independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) samples. item.title: 本研究利用神经网络变分蒙特卡洛直接求解多电子薛定谔方程，无需任何额外物理输入，仅通过Sz=0扇区的单次计算即预测了莫尔半导体中的巡游铁磁性与反铁磁绝缘体两种磁态。
item.description:
用第一性原理人工智能预测磁性

Predicting magnetism with first-principles AI

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.09093

本研究利用神经网络变分蒙特卡洛直接求解多电子薛定谔方程，无需任何额外物理输入，仅通过Sz=0扇区的单次计算即预测了莫尔半导体中的巡游铁磁性与反铁磁绝缘体两种磁态。

磁性材料的计算发现仍然具有挑战性，因为磁性源于动能与库仑相互作用之间的竞争，这往往超出了标准电子结构方法的能力范围。在这里，我们通过使用神经网络变分蒙特卡洛方法直接求解多电子薛定谔方程来应对这一挑战，该方法为强关联系统提供了高度表达能力的变分波函数。将这一技术应用于过渡金属硫族化合物莫尔半导体，我们使用同一个神经网络，在WSe₂/WS₂中预测了巡游铁磁性，在扭转Γ谷同质双层中预测了反铁磁绝缘体，且除微观哈密顿量之外无需任何物理输入。至关重要的是，两种类型的磁态都是在Sz=0扇区内通过单次计算获得的，从而省去了计算和比较多个Sz扇区的需要。

CytoCrowd是一个包含446张高分辨率细胞学图像的公开基准数据集，每张图像同时提供四位病理医生的冲突标注和资深专家建立的黄金标准，既可用于目标检测等标准视觉任务的评估，也可作为标注聚合算法的现实测试平台。

高质量标注数据集对于推动医学图像分析领域的机器学习发展至关重要。然而，目前存在一个关键缺口：大多数数据集要么只提供单一、干净的黄金标准，掩盖了现实世界中专家之间的分歧；要么提供多个标注，却没有单独的黄金标准用于客观评估。为了弥合这一差距，我们推出了CytoCrowd，一个全新的细胞学分析公开基准数据集。该数据集包含446张高分辨率图像，每张图像具有两个关键组成部分：（1）来自四位独立病理医生的原始、相互冲突的标注；（2）由一位资深专家建立的单独的高质量黄金标准。这种双重结构使CytoCrowd成为一个多功能资源：它既可以作为标准计算机视觉任务（如目标检测和分类）的基准，同时又为评估标注聚合算法提供了现实的测试平台。

该论文提出了在线性与平滑上下文老虎机中抵御对抗性奖励污染的统一基于价值公平性算法，实现了近极小极大最优的遗憾值，并精确刻画了公平的代价（线性情形下遗憾从 log T 升至 log² T）。

现代数字平台使用上下文老虎机在竞争参与者之间分配宝贵的曝光机会和资源，因此公平对待成为一个重要关注点，然而仅靠奖励最大化并不能确保优先分配真正反映参与者的自身价值。我们针对线性和平滑上下文老虎机，在统一基于价值的公平性要求下（即奖励排序须在所有上下文和所有轮次中都能证明优先分配的合理性）开发了相应算法，并研究了这些公平性保证在对抗性奖励污染下的表现。我们的算法实现了 (1-Õ(1/T)) 级别的公平性，其遗憾值在线性奖励下达到公平策略中的极小极大最优，在平滑奖励下接近极小极大最优。在线性情形中，匹配的下界精确刻画了公平的代价：极小极大遗憾从 log T 增加到 log² T。对于平滑奖励，公平的代价至多为多对数级别。

arXiv:2602.04068v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The calculation of shortest-path distances in road networks is a core operation in navigation systems, location-based services, and spatial analytics. Over the past two decades, numerous distance indexes have been proposed to speed up query processing for shortest distance queries. item.description:
超越遗忘：表征误导引发可控的附带行为与能力

Beyond Forgetting: Representation Misdirection Elicits Controllable Side Behaviors and Capabilities

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21702

该论文提出，基于线性表征假设的视角，表征误导（RM）类机器遗忘方法不仅能实现遗忘，还可通过在遗忘表征空间中对高层概念向量进行线性操作，可控地引发与该概念相对应的附带行为与能力。

我们研究表征误导（Representation Misdirection, RM），这是一类大语言模型（LLM）遗忘方法，其通过将待遗忘样本的潜在表征重定向至某个目标向量来实现遗忘。尽管十分重要，但RM中所使用的目标向量的作用仍未得到充分探索。本文从线性表征假设（Linear Representation Hypothesis）的视角出发，重新审视并研究RM。具体而言，如果能够识别出与某一高层概念相对应的一维表征，线性表征假设便允许在遗忘表征空间内对该概念向量进行线性操作。基于这一视角，我们假设：除遗忘之外，通过RM实现的机器遗忘还会引发与该高层概念相对应的、可控的附带行为与能力。我们的假设在广泛的概念与任务上得到了实证验证，包括控制已遗忘模型的（原文摘要在此处截断）

本文提出了基于后见之明决策处累积平方梯度范数的新遗憾度量 $G^\star$ 遗憾，它严格细化了小损失遗憾并在曲率消失时可任意更紧，同时给出了上下界并扩展至动态遗憾和老虎机设置。

本文针对具有光滑损失的在线凸优化问题，引入了一种新的问题依赖型遗憾度量。我们将这一概念称为 $G^\star$ 遗憾，它取决于在后见之明决策处评估的累积平方梯度范数。我们证明 $G^\star$ 遗憾严格地细化了现有的 $L^\star$（小损失）遗憾，并且当损失在后见之明决策附近的曲率趋于零时，它可以任意地更加精确。我们建立了 $G^\star$ 遗憾的上界和下界，并将结果扩展到动态遗憾和老虎机设置。作为副产品，我们改进了插值情形下随机优化算法的现有收敛性分析。一些实验验证了我们的理论发现。

arXiv:2601.13519v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This paper introduces a new problem-dependent regret measure for online convex optimization with smooth losses. The notion, which we call the $G^\star$ regret, depends on the cumulative squared gradient norm evaluated at the decision in hindsight. We show that the $G^\star$ regret strictly refines the existing $L^\star$ (small loss) regret, and that it can be arbitrarily sharper when the losses have vanishing curvature around the hindsight decision. We establish upper and lower bounds on the $G^\star$ regret and extend our results to dynamic regret and bandit settings. As a byproduct, we refine the existing convergence analysis of stochastic optimization algorithms in the interpolation regime. Some experiments validate our theoretical findings.

While the operation of the energy storage and dispatchable sources impacts the optimal sizing of the system, it is challenging to account for the effect of finite-horizon optimal control at the stage of system sizing. In this work, we present a flexible and computationally efficient sizing framework for energy storage and renewable capacity in isolated energy systems, accounting for uncertainty in the renewable generation and the optimal control. item.title: 本文提出基于有限拓扑空间滤流的数据分析框架，通过在同一数据点上构造逐层粗化的拓扑序列，在持续性同调之外保留了点的拓扑不可区分性、邻域重叠、连通分支合并等更丰富的拓扑信息，并建立了基本理论、稳定性结果和从距离矩阵出发的实用构造方法。
item.description:
有限拓扑空间滤流：一种用于数据分析的拓扑框架

Finite Topological Space Filtrations: A Topological Framework for Data Analysis

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.23348

本文提出基于有限拓扑空间滤流的数据分析框架，通过在同一数据点上构造逐层粗化的拓扑序列，在持续性同调之外保留了点的拓扑不可区分性、邻域重叠、连通分支合并等更丰富的拓扑信息，并建立了基本理论、稳定性结果和从距离矩阵出发的实用构造方法。

我们提出了一种基于有限拓扑空间滤流的数据分析框架。从一个有限度量数据集出发，我们在同一组点上构造一系列逐渐粗化的拓扑。这些拓扑以通常的方式给出持续性模和条形码，但它们还保留了当滤流被约化为同调时会丢失的信息。在每一层，例如可以考察哪些点在拓扑上不可区分、它们的最小邻域如何重叠、连通分支如何合并，以及这些特征如何从一层到下一层发生变化。我们发展了这些滤流的基本理论，在适当假设下建立了稳定性结果，并给出了直接从距离矩阵出发的实用构造方法。随后我们研究了从所得的有限拓扑中能够学到什么。在具有不同形状、大小和密度的已知聚类的合成数据上，我们考察……

arXiv:2512.23348v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce a data-analysis framework based on filtrations of finite topological spaces. Starting from a finite metric data set, we construct a sequence of coarsening topologies on the same set of points. These topologies give persistence modules and barcodes in the usual way, but they also retain information that is lost when the filtration is reduced to homology. At each level one can examine, for example, which points are topologically indistinguishable, how their minimal neighbourhoods overlap, how connected components merge, and how these features change from one level to the next. We develop the basic theory of these filtrations, establish stability results under suitable hypotheses, and give practical constructions starting directly from a distance matrix. We then study what can be learned from the resulting finite topologies. On synthetic data with known clusters of different shapes, sizes, and densities, we examine

item.title: 该论文将统计物理学中的渗流理论引入dropout神经网络训练的研究，建立了模拟dropout的新型渗流模型，证明了dropout中存在渗流效应，并刻画了网络拓扑结构与输入输出路径问题之间的关系。
item.description:
从渗流视角看Dropout神经网络训练

Dropout Neural Network Training Viewed from a Percolation Perspective

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.13853

该论文将统计物理学中的渗流理论引入dropout神经网络训练的研究，建立了模拟dropout的新型渗流模型，证明了dropout中存在渗流效应，并刻画了网络拓扑结构与输入输出路径问题之间的关系。

在这项工作中，我们研究了在使用dropout训练深度神经网络（NNs）过程中渗流现象的存在性及其影响。Dropout方法是训练神经网络的正则化技术，最早由G. Hinton等人于2012年提出。这些方法在训练的每个阶段随机地暂时移除神经网络中的连接，并使用随机梯度下降（SGD）更新剩余的子网络。从网络中随机移除连接的过程类似于渗流——统计物理学中的一个范式模型。如果dropout移除了足够多的连接，使得神经网络的输入与输出之间不存在路径，那么神经网络就无法做出基于数据的预测。我们研究了模拟神经网络中dropout的新型渗流模型，并刻画了网络拓扑与这一路径问题之间的关系。该理论证明了dropout中存在渗流效应。我们还表明这种渗流效应……

arXiv:2512.13853v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this work, we investigate the existence and effect of percolation in training deep Neural Networks (NNs) with dropout. Dropout methods are regularisation techniques for training NNs, first introduced by G. Hinton et al. (2012). These methods temporarily remove connections in the NN, randomly at each stage of training, and update the remaining subnetwork with Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD). The process of removing connections from a network at random is similar to percolation, a paradigm model of statistical physics. If dropout were to remove enough connections such that there is no path between the input and output of the NN, then the NN could not make predictions informed by the data. We study new percolation models that mimic dropout in NNs and characterise the relationship between network topology and this path problem. The theory shows the existence of a percolative effect in dropout. We also show that this percolative ef

item.title: CLARITY是一个医学世界模型，通过联合编码影像潜在状态、不规则随访时间间隔和患者临床背景，实现对不同治疗方案下疾病轨迹的反事实模拟，从而指导肿瘤学的临床治疗决策。
item.description:
CLARITY：通过模拟情境感知的疾病轨迹来指导治疗决策的医学世界模型

CLARITY: Medical World Model for Guiding Treatment Decisions by Simulating Context-Aware Disease Trajectories

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.08029

CLARITY是一个医学世界模型，通过联合编码影像潜在状态、不规则随访时间间隔和患者临床背景，实现对不同治疗方案下疾病轨迹的反事实模拟，从而指导肿瘤学的临床治疗决策。

肿瘤学中的临床决策需要预测疾病在治疗下的演变过程，然而大多数AI系统仍然是静态预测器，无法对纵向的、以治疗为条件的疾病进展进行建模。尽管生成式模型和世界模型在通用领域已展现出强大的能力，但它们在医学领域的适配仍然有限，不足以捕捉跨时间尺度上复杂的、由治疗引起的生理动态变化。为了弥补这些差距，我们提出了CLARITY，这是一个医学世界模型，能够对以治疗为条件的疾病轨迹进行反事实模拟，以辅助临床决策。通过联合编码源自影像的潜在状态、捕捉不规则随访的时间间隔以及患者特定的临床背景信息，CLARITY学习到疾病进展的平滑且可解释的表示，使模型能够模拟不同治疗方案如何重塑未来的疾病动态。

arXiv:2512.08029v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Clinical decision-making in oncology requires forecasting how disease evolves under treatment, yet most AI systems remain static predictors that cannot model longitudinal, treatment-conditioned progression. Although generative and world models have demonstrated strong capabilities in general domains, their adaptation to medicine remains limited and insufficient for capturing complex, treatment-induced physiological dynamics across temporal scales. To address these gaps, we introduce CLARITY, a medical world model that enables counterfactual simulation of treatment-conditioned disease trajectories for clinical decision-making. By jointly encoding imaging-derived latent states, temporal intervals that capture irregular follow-ups, and patient-specific clinical context, CLARITY learns smooth and interpretable representations of disease progression, allowing the model to simulate how alternative treatments reshape future disease dynamics

item.title: 该研究发现时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）在过程模型预测任务中，无论是零样本使用还是微调，其预测误差均低于在同一事件日志上从头训练的传统机器学习和专用模型，展现出有效的时间结构迁移能力。
item.description:
面向过程模型预测的时间序列基础模型

Time Series Foundation Models for Process Model Forecasting

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.07624

该研究发现时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）在过程模型预测任务中，无论是零样本使用还是微调，其预测误差均低于在同一事件日志上从头训练的传统机器学习和专用模型，展现出有效的时间结构迁移能力。

过程模型预测（PMF）旨在通过建模直接跟随（DF）关系的时间动态特性，预测过程的控制流结构如何随时间演变，从而补充专注于单案例前缀的预测性过程监控。先前的基准测试表明，机器学习和深度学习模型相比统计基线仅能带来有限的提升，这主要是由于DF时间序列的稀疏性和异质性。我们研究了时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）——针对通用时间序列的大型预训练模型——作为PMF的替代方案。使用从真实事件日志中提取的DF时间序列，我们比较了TSFMs的零样本使用方式（无需额外训练）与在PMF特定数据上微调的变体。TSFMs总体上比在同一日志上从头训练的传统模型和专用模型取得了更低的预测误差（MAE和RMSE），表明其能够有效迁移时间结构知识。

arXiv:2512.07624v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Process Model Forecasting (PMF) aims to predict how the control-flow structure of a process evolves over time by modeling the temporal dynamics of directly-follows (DF) relations, complementing predictive process monitoring that focuses on single-case prefixes. Prior benchmarks show that machine learning and deep learning models provide only modest gains over statistical baselines, mainly due to the sparsity and heterogeneity of the DF time series. We investigate Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs), large pre-trained models for generic time series, as an alternative for PMF. Using DF time series derived from real-life event logs, we compare zero-shot use of TSFMs, without additional training, with fine-tuned variants adapted on PMF-specific data. item.title: 该论文提出了由大语言模型驱动的无训练自动代理发现框架TAP，利用大语言模型与进化搜索策略自动为混合精度量化设计优越的量化代理，无需人工专家参与或任何训练过程。
item.description:
面向混合精度量化的基于大语言模型的无训练自动代理发现方法

Towards Training-free Automatic Proxy Discovery via Large Language Models for Mixed Precision Quantization

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.07419

该论文提出了由大语言模型驱动的无训练自动代理发现框架TAP，利用大语言模型与进化搜索策略自动为混合精度量化设计优越的量化代理，无需人工专家参与或任何训练过程。

arXiv:2512.07419v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：混合精度量化（MPQ）使深度神经网络（DNN）摆脱了内存溢出（OOM）瓶颈，因此获得了越来越多的研究关注。然而，传统方法要么依赖代价高昂的可微分优化搜索，既不高效也不灵活；要么从人工专家手动设计的代理（如HAWQ）中学习量化DNN，这既费时费力，又需要大量专家知识。我们能否在不涉及任何人类专家或训练的情况下设计出这样的代理？在本文中，我们给出了肯定的答案，提出了一种新颖的大语言模型（LLM）驱动的无训练自动代理（TAP）发现框架。该框架利用大语言模型和进化搜索策略，自动寻找为混合精度量化量身定制的优越TAP，从而革新了MPQ的设计范式。此外，为了弥合黑盒大语言模型与具有挑战性的MPQ任务之间的差距，我们引入了一种轻量级的直接偏好（Direct Pref）（摘要在此处被截断）

arXiv:2512.07419v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Mixed-Precision Quantization (MPQ) liberates Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) from the Out-Of-Memory (OOM) bottleneck and has garnered increasing research attention. However, conventional methods either rely on costly differentiable optimization search, which is neither efficient nor flexible, or learn a quantized DNN from a proxy (e.g., HAWQ) manually designed by human experts, which is labor-intensive and requires extensive expert knowledge. Can we design a proxy without involving any human experts or training? In this paper, we provide an affirmative answer by proposing a novel Large Language Model (LLM)-driven Training-free Automatic Proxy (dubbed TAP) discovery framework. It reforms the design paradigm of MPQ by utilizing LLMs and evolutionary search strategies to automatically find superior TAP tailored for MPQ. In addition, to bridge the gap between black-box LLMs and the challenging MPQ task, we introduce a lightweight Direct Pref

item.title: PADiff提出了一种将队友预测信息融入扩散模型去噪过程的自适应策略，能够捕捉多模态合作行为，使智能体在临时团队协作中实时预测并适应未见过的队友。
item.description:
PADiff：面向临时团队协作的预测性与自适应扩散策略

PADiff: Predictive and Adaptive Diffusion Policies for Ad Hoc Teamwork

https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.07260

PADiff提出了一种将队友预测信息融入扩散模型去噪过程的自适应策略，能够捕捉多模态合作行为，使智能体在临时团队协作中实时预测并适应未见过的队友。

临时团队协作（AHT）要求智能体能够与之前未见过的队友进行协作，这对许多现实世界的应用至关重要。AHT的核心挑战在于开发一个能够实时预测并适应未知队友的自我智能体。传统的基于强化学习的方法优化单一期望回报，这往往导致策略坍缩为单一的主导行为，从而无法捕捉AHT中固有的多模态合作模式。在本工作中，我们提出了PADiff，这是一种基于扩散模型的方法，能够捕捉智能体的多模态行为，解锁其与队友的多样化合作模式。然而，标准扩散模型缺乏在高度非平稳的AHT场景中进行预测和适应的能力。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的基于扩散的策略，将关于队友的关键预测信息整合到去噪过程中。在三个（任务上）进行了大量实验……

arXiv:2511.07260v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Ad hoc teamwork (AHT) requires agents to collaborate with previously unseen teammates, which is crucial for many real-world applications. The core challenge of AHT is to develop an ego agent that can predict and adapt to unknown teammates on the fly. Conventional RL-based approaches optimize a single expected return, which often causes policies to collapse into a single dominant behavior, thus failing to capture the multimodal cooperation patterns inherent in AHT. In this work, we introduce PADiff, a diffusion-based approach that captures agent's multimodal behaviors, unlocking its diverse cooperation modes with teammates. However, standard diffusion models lack the ability to predict and adapt in highly non-stationary AHT scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose a novel diffusion-based policy that integrates critical predictive information about teammates into the denoising process. Extensive experiments across three

item.title: 提出了SynthKGQA框架，可从任意知识图谱生成包含完整真值事实的知识图谱问答数据集，既能更有效地评估知识图谱检索器，也能用于训练更好的知识图谱增强大语言模型，并基于Wikidata构建了测试零样本泛化能力的GTSQA数据集。
item.description:
用于更好训练和评估知识图谱增强大语言模型的真值子图

Ground-Truth Subgraphs for Better Training and Evaluation of Knowledge Graph Augmented LLMs

https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.04473

提出了SynthKGQA框架，可从任意知识图谱生成包含完整真值事实的知识图谱问答数据集，既能更有效地评估知识图谱检索器，也能用于训练更好的知识图谱增强大语言模型，并基于Wikidata构建了测试零样本泛化能力的GTSQA数据集。

从图结构知识库中检索信息是提高大语言模型事实性的一个有前景的方向。尽管已提出多种解决方案，但由于缺乏带有图检索真值目标的具有挑战性的问答数据集，方法之间的比较十分困难。我们提出了SynthKGQA，这是一个由大语言模型驱动的框架，可以从任何知识图谱生成高质量的知识图谱问答数据集，并提供知识图谱中用于推理问题的完整真值事实集合。我们展示了SynthKGQA生成的数据除了能够对知识图谱检索器进行更有信息量的基准测试外，还能用于训练更好的模型。我们将SynthKGQA应用于Wikidata，生成了GTSQA——一个旨在测试知识图谱检索器对未见过的图结构和关系类型的零样本泛化能力的新数据集，并在其上对流行的知识图谱增强大语言模型解决方案进行了基准测试。

arXiv:2511.04473v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Retrieval of information from graph-structured knowledge bases represents a promising direction for improving the factuality of LLMs. While various solutions have been proposed, a comparison of methods is difficult due to the lack of challenging QA datasets with ground-truth targets for graph retrieval. We present SynthKGQA, an LLM-powered framework for generating high-quality Knowledge Graph Question Answering datasets from any Knowledge Graph, providing the full set of ground-truth facts in the KG to reason over questions. We show how, in addition to enabling more informative benchmarking of KG retrievers, the data produced with SynthKGQA also allows us to train better models.We apply SynthKGQA to Wikidata to generate GTSQA, a new dataset designed to test zero-shot generalization abilities of KG retrievers with respect to unseen graph structures and relation types, and benchmark popular solutions for KG-augmented LLMs on it.

item.title: 本文证明无需梯度裁剪或归一化等额外修改的原始加速随机近端次梯度方法，即可在重尾噪声下的凸复合优化中达到普遍最优的一阶预言机复杂度。

https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.11676

本文证明无需梯度裁剪或归一化等额外修改的原始加速随机近端次梯度方法，即可在重尾噪声下的凸复合优化中达到普遍最优的一阶预言机复杂度。

我们研究凸复合优化问题，其目标函数由一个易于近端计算的函数与一个凸函数之和构成，其中该凸函数的次梯度是在重尾噪声下估计得到的。现有工作通常在随机一阶方法中采用梯度裁剪或归一化技术来应对重尾噪声。本文分析了原始（vanilla）随机算法——即无需诸如裁剪或归一化等额外修改——求解此类问题的一阶预言机复杂度。特别地，我们证明了一种加速随机近端次梯度方法在期望意义下寻找近似最优解所达到的一阶预言机复杂度是普遍最优的。

arXiv:2510.11676v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study convex composite optimization problems, where the objective function is given by the sum of a prox-friendly function and a convex function whose subgradients are estimated under heavy-tailed noise. Existing work often employs gradient clipping or normalization techniques in stochastic first-order methods to address heavy-tailed noise. %In this paper, we demonstrate that a vanilla stochastic algorithm---without additional modifications such as clipping or normalization---can achieve optimal complexity for these problems. In this paper, we analyze the first-order oracle complexity of vanilla stochastic algorithms---without additional modifications such as clipping or normalization---for solving these problems. In particular, we establish that an accelerated stochastic proximal subgradient method achieves a first-order oracle complexity for finding an approximate optimal solution in expectation that is universally optimal

item.title: 提出PerSyn个性化数据合成策略，采用“先路由后生成”范式，通过综合考虑学生可学习性与教师响应质量的查询级路由器，为每个提示匹配最优教师，从而更高效地为学生模型定制训练数据。
item.description:
寻找你的最优教师：基于路由器引导的多教师蒸馏的个性化数据合成

Find Your Optimal Teacher: Personalized Data Synthesis via Router-Guided Multi-Teacher Distillation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.10925

提出PerSyn个性化数据合成策略，采用“先路由后生成”范式，通过综合考虑学生可学习性与教师响应质量的查询级路由器，为每个提示匹配最优教师，从而更高效地为学生模型定制训练数据。

使用强教师模型生成的合成数据来训练学生模型，是蒸馏教师能力的一种有前景的方法。然而，近期研究表明，更强的模型并不总是最优的教师，这揭示了教师输出与学生可学习性之间的不匹配。为解决这一问题，我们提出了PerSyn（个性化数据合成），一种在全新的“先路由后生成”范式下运行的新型合成策略，可为每个学生模型量身定制数据，使其能够更有效地学习。具体而言，PerSyn首先通过一个查询级路由器将每个提示分配给其最优教师，该路由器综合考虑学生的可学习性和教师的响应质量。随后，每位教师仅为其被分配的提示合成数据，这使得该过程比传统的“先生成后选择”范式更加高效——在传统范式中，所有教师必须为整个提示集并行生成响应。

arXiv:2510.10925v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Training student models on synthetic data generated by strong teacher models is a promising way to distilling the capabilities of teachers. However, recent studies show that stronger models are not always optimal teachers, revealing a mismatch between teacher outputs and student learnability. To address this issue, we propose PerSyn (Personalized data Synthesis), a novel synthesis strategy that operates under a new ``Route then Generate'' paradigm to create data tailored to each student model, enabling it to learn more effectively. Specifically, PerSyn first assigns each prompt to its optimal teacher via a query-level router that jointly considers student learnability and teacher response quality. Each teacher then synthesizes data only for its assigned prompts, making the process more efficient than the conventional ``Generate then Select'' paradigm, where all teachers must generate parallel responses for the entire prompt set

item.title: 该论文提出从单张日常图像预测双手3D运动与关节姿态的方法，通过扩散模型将2D关键点序列提升为4D手部运动标注，并采用扩散损失建模运动的多模态性，在多个数据集上显著超越现有基线并具备良好的零样本泛化能力。
item.description:
日常图像中的双手3D手部运动与关节姿态预测

Bimanual 3D Hand Motion and Articulation Forecasting in Everyday Images

https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.06145

该论文提出从单张日常图像预测双手3D运动与关节姿态的方法，通过扩散模型将2D关键点序列提升为4D手部运动标注，并采用扩散损失建模运动的多模态性，在多个数据集上显著超越现有基线并具备良好的零样本泛化能力。

我们研究从日常场景中的单张图像预测双手3D手部运动与关节姿态的问题。为了解决多样化场景中缺乏3D手部标注的问题，我们设计了一个标注流水线，其中包含一个扩散模型，用于将2D手部关键点序列提升为4D手部运动。对于预测模型，我们采用扩散损失来刻画手部运动分布中的多模态特性。在6个数据集上的大量实验表明，使用我们补全的标签进行训练可带来14%的性能提升，我们的提升模型（提升45%）与预测模型（提升16.4%）相对于最佳基线方法均表现出显著优势，尤其是在对日常图像的零样本泛化能力方面。

arXiv:2510.06145v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We tackle the problem of forecasting bimanual 3D hand motion and articulation from a single image in everyday settings. To address the lack of 3D hand annotations in diverse settings, we design an annotation pipeline consisting of a diffusion model to lift 2D hand keypoint sequences to 4D hand motion. For the forecasting model, we adopt a diffusion loss to account for the multimodality in hand motion distribution. Extensive experiments on 6 datasets show the benefits of training with our imputed labels (14% improvement) and the effectiveness of our lifting (45% better) & forecasting (16.4% gain) models, over the best baselines, especially in zero-shot generalization to everyday images.

item.title: 深度学习训练结果难以预测和复现的根本原因在于损失景观中分形且相互穿透的吸引盆几何结构——即使大幅提高初始化精度，结果的可预测性也几乎不会改善。
item.description:
分形吸引盆几何与深度学习中可预测性和可复现性的极限

Fractal basin geometry and the limits to predictability and reproducibility in deep learning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.05606

深度学习训练结果难以预测和复现的根本原因在于损失景观中分形且相互穿透的吸引盆几何结构——即使大幅提高初始化精度，结果的可预测性也几乎不会改善。

可预测性的基本极限是我们理解许多物理和计算系统的核心。在深度学习中，训练结果以难以预测和复现而著称，然而这些困难背后的机制一直不明确。在这里，我们提出分形的、相互穿透的吸引盆几何作为统一的动力系统机制：每一个导向某一解的初始化都任意接近于导向不同解的初始化，从而形成一个在任意精细尺度上都具有结构的胖分形。利用一个最小化的神经网络模型，我们解析地建立了通往穿透现象的经典路径，并推导出接近于零的不确定性指数：即使初始化精度急剧提高，也只能带来结果可预测性的微小提升。在深度网络中，相互交织的训练终点和接近零的参数空间指数提供了与穿透现象一致的稳健特征标志。

arXiv:2510.05606v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Fundamental limits to predictability are central to our understanding of many physical and computational systems. In deep learning, training outcomes are notoriously difficult to predict and reproduce, yet the mechanism underlying these difficulties has remained unclear. Here we propose fractal, riddled basin geometry as a unifying dynamical-systems mechanism: every initialization leading to one solution lies arbitrarily close to initializations leading to different solutions, forming a fat fractal with structure at arbitrarily fine scales. Using a minimal neural network model, we analytically establish the classical route to riddling and derive a near-zero uncertainty exponent: even sharp increases in initialization precision yield only marginal gains in outcome predictability. In deep networks, intertwined training destinations and near-zero parameter-space exponents provide robust signatures consistent with riddling across tested

item.title: 提出SPID方法，将视觉领域的分数蒸馏技术成功迁移到蛋白质主链生成中，通过结合少步生成与推理时噪声策略，解决了直接蒸馏导致设计性过低的问题，实现了快速高质量的蛋白质主链生成。
item.description:
SPID：蒸馏蛋白质主链生成

SPID: Distilled Protein Backbone Generation

https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.03095

提出SPID方法，将视觉领域的分数蒸馏技术成功迁移到蛋白质主链生成中，通过结合少步生成与推理时噪声策略，解决了直接蒸馏导致设计性过低的问题，实现了快速高质量的蛋白质主链生成。

基于扩散模型和流模型的生成式方法最近在蛋白质主链生成任务中展现出卓越性能，为从头蛋白质设计提供了前所未有的能力。然而，尽管这些模型生成质量很高，但它们受到采样速度缓慢的制约，通常需要数百次迭代步骤。这一计算瓶颈限制了它们在大规模蛋白质发现中的实际应用，因为大规模蛋白质发现需要数千到数百万个候选结构。为了应对这一挑战，我们探索了分数蒸馏技术，该技术在视觉领域已成功地在保持高生成质量的同时大幅减少采样步骤数量。然而，将这些方法直接迁移到蛋白质生成中会导致设计性低到不可接受的程度。我们提出了分数蛋白质恒等蒸馏，通过将少步生成与推理时噪声相结合，解决了这一不兼容性问题。

arXiv:2510.03095v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Diffusion- and flow-based generative models have recently demonstrated strong performance in protein backbone generation tasks, offering unprecedented capabilities for de novo protein design. However, despite their generation quality, these models are constrained by slow sampling, often requiring hundreds of iterative steps. This computational bottleneck limits their practical utility in large-scale protein discovery, where thousands to millions of candidate structures are needed. To address this challenge, we explore the techniques of score distillation, which has shown great success in reducing the number of sampling steps in the vision domain while maintaining high generation quality. However, a straightforward adaptation of these methods results in unacceptably low designability. We introduce Score Protein identity Distillation (SPID), which resolves this incompatibility by combining few-step generation with inference-time noise

item.title: 提出了RheOFormer——一种基于自注意力机制的生成式算子Transformer模型，能够高效学习复杂流体流动的空间相互作用与特征，无需针对不同物理条件重新训练即可模拟多种测黏与非测黏流动。
item.description:
RheOFormer：一种用于复杂流体与流动模拟的生成式Transformer模型

RheOFormer: A generative transformer model for simulation of complex fluids and flows

https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.01365

提出了RheOFormer——一种基于自注意力机制的生成式算子Transformer模型，能够高效学习复杂流体流动的空间相互作用与特征，无需针对不同物理条件重新训练即可模拟多种测黏与非测黏流动。

在流动条件下对软材料力学进行建模的能力，对于设计和工程化具有目标性能的工艺与材料至关重要。这通常需要求解内部应力张量，而该应力张量通过非线性且依赖历史的本构模型与变形张量相关联。传统的非牛顿流体动力学数值方法往往面临高昂的计算成本，且对新问题实例的可扩展性差。数据驱动方法的发展缓解了部分局限，但仍需在不同物理条件下进行重新训练。在本工作中，我们提出了流变算子Transformer（RheOFormer），这是一种生成式算子学习方法，利用自注意力机制高效学习复杂流体流动中不同的空间相互作用与特征。我们在一系列不同类型的测黏流和非测黏流上对RheOFormer进行了基准测试。

arXiv:2510.01365v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The ability to model mechanics of soft materials under flowing conditions is key in designing and engineering processes and materials with targeted properties. This generally requires solution of internal stress tensor, related to the deformation tensor through nonlinear and history-dependent constitutive models. Traditional numerical methods for non-Newtonian fluid dynamics often suffer from prohibitive computational demands and poor scalability to new problem instances. Developments in data-driven methods have mitigated some limitations but still require retraining across varied physical conditions. In this work, we introduce Rheological Operator Transformer (RheOFormer), a generative operator learning method leveraging self-attention to efficiently learn different spatial interactions and features of complex fluid flows. We benchmark RheOFormer across a range of different viscometric and non-viscometric flows with different types

item.title: 该论文提出了HumanAgencyBench（HAB），一个利用大语言模型模拟和验证用户查询、可扩展地评估AI助手在提出澄清问题、避免价值操纵、纠正错误信息等六种行为上支持人类能动性的自适应诊断基准。
item.description:
HumanAgencyBench：AI助手对人类能动性支持的可扩展评估

HumanAgencyBench: Scalable Evaluation of Human Agency Support in AI Assistants

https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.08494

该论文提出了HumanAgencyBench（HAB），一个利用大语言模型模拟和验证用户查询、可扩展地评估AI助手在提出澄清问题、避免价值操纵、纠正错误信息等六种行为上支持人类能动性的自适应诊断基准。

随着人类将越来越多的任务和决策委托给人工智能（AI），我们面临着失去对个人和集体未来控制的风险。相对简单的算法系统已经在引导人类的决策，例如社交媒体信息流算法会让人们无意间、心不在焉地滚动浏览以提升参与度为目标优化的内容。在本文中，我们通过将哲学和科学中的能动性理论与AI辅助评估方法相结合，发展了人类能动性的概念：利用大语言模型（LLM）来模拟和验证用户查询，并评估AI的回复。我们开发了HumanAgencyBench（HAB），这是一个可扩展且自适应的诊断工具，用于评估与人类能动性相关的六种行为。HAB衡量AI助手在以下方面的倾向：提出澄清性问题、避免价值操纵、纠正错误信息、推迟重要决策、鼓励学习以及维持社交边界。我们发现较低的……

arXiv:2509.08494v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: As humans delegate more tasks and decisions to artificial intelligence (AI), we risk losing control of our individual and collective futures. Relatively simple algorithmic systems already steer human decision-making, such as social media feed algorithms that lead people to unintentionally and absent-mindedly scroll through engagement-optimized content. In this paper, we develop the idea of human agency by integrating philosophical and scientific theories of agency with AI-assisted evaluation methods: using large language models (LLMs) to simulate and validate user queries and to evaluate AI responses. We develop HumanAgencyBench (HAB), a scalable and adaptive diagnostic tool for six behaviors related to human agency. HAB measures the tendency of an AI assistant to Ask Clarifying Questions, Avoid Value Manipulation, Correct Misinformation, Defer Important Decisions, Encourage Learning, and Maintain Social Boundaries. We find low

item.title: 本文提出一种基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）的可解释深度学习框架，仅利用AGC测量数据即可有效检测非线性自动发电控制系统中常被忽视的虚假数据注入攻击，并能提取符号方程直接用于攻击检测。
item.description:
面向非线性自动发电控制中虚假数据注入攻击检测的白盒深度学习：一种Kolmogorov-Arnold网络方法

Glass-Box Deep Learning for FDIA Detection in Nonlinear Automatic Generation Control: A Kolmogorov-Arnold Network Approach

https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.05259

本文提出一种基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）的可解释深度学习框架，仅利用AGC测量数据即可有效检测非线性自动发电控制系统中常被忽视的虚假数据注入攻击，并能提取符号方程直接用于攻击检测。

自动发电控制（AGC）在维持多区域电力系统的功率平衡方面发挥着关键作用。然而，其完全依赖远程通信传输的测量数据，使其容易受到网络层面的虚假数据注入攻击（FDIA），此类攻击可篡改测量值并破坏系统运行的稳定性。与以往采用黑盒深度学习（DL）模型进行FDIA检测的研究不同，本文提出了一种基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）的可解释且精确的框架，用于检测AGC系统中的FDIA，并显式考虑了以往工作中常被忽视的非线性特性。所提出的KAN模型仅利用AGC测量数据即可有效识别非线性AGC系统中的FDIA。此外，KAN天然支持符号方程的提取，这是传统深度学习模型所不具备的能力。训练完成后，这些符号方程可直接用于FDIA检测，从而提升检测性能。

arXiv:2509.05259v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Automatic Generation Control (AGC) plays a critical role in maintaining power balance across multi-area power systems. However, its complete reliance on remotely communicated measurements makes it susceptible to cyber-induced False Data Injection Attacks (FDIAs), which can alter measurement values and destabilize system operation. Unlike prior studies that employ black-box Deep Learning (DL) models for FDIA detection, this paper proposes an interpretable and accurate Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN)-based framework for detecting FDIAs in AGC systems, explicitly accounting for nonlinearities often overlooked in previous work. The proposed KAN model effectively identifies FDIAs in nonlinear AGC systems using only AGC measurements. Moreover, KANs inherently facilitate the extraction of symbolic equations, a capability absent in conventional DL models. After training, these equations can be directly utilized for FDIA detection, enhancing

item.title: 该论文提出帧选择敏感度（FSS）诊断方法，发现现有视频问答基准中仅5.5%–31%的样本真正需要时间维度的帧选择，并据此构建了聚焦时间敏感样本的紧凑评估集TempCore。
item.description:
TempCore：视频问答基准是否真正基于时间维度？

TempCore: Are Video QA Benchmarks Temporally Grounded?

https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.01167

该论文提出帧选择敏感度（FSS）诊断方法，发现现有视频问答基准中仅5.5%–31%的样本真正需要时间维度的帧选择，并据此构建了聚焦时间敏感样本的紧凑评估集TempCore。

视觉-语言模型（VLM）只能处理有限数量的视频帧，这使得帧选择成为一种实际需求。但当前的视频问答基准是否真正需要时间维度的帧选择，还是说无论展示哪些帧，大多数问题都能被回答？我们提出了帧选择敏感度，这是一种逐样本的诊断方法，用于衡量当最相关的帧被最不相关的帧替换时，VLM准确率的变化程度。在六个基准和八个VLM上的实验表明，绝大多数样本对帧选择不敏感：只有少数样本真正对帧的选择敏感。将FSS与语言独立得分相结合后发现，仅有5.5%–31%的样本具有时间敏感性。我们构建了TempCore，这是从现有基准中分离出这些时间敏感样本的紧凑评估子集，并将在论文发表后发布代码和逐样本标注。

arXiv:2509.01167v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can ingest only a limited number of video frames, making frame selection a practical necessity. But do current Video QA benchmarks genuinely require temporal frame selection, or can most questions be answered regardless of which frames are shown? We introduce Frame Selection Sensitivity (FSS), a per-sample diagnostic that measures how much VLM accuracy changes when the most relevant frames are replaced with the least relevant ones. Across six benchmarks and eight VLMs, we find that a large majority of samples are frame-agnostic: only a minority are genuinely sensitive to frame choice. Combining FSS with a Language Independence Score (LIS) reveals that merely 5.5--31% of samples are Temporally Sensitive. We construct TempCore, compact evaluation subsets that isolate these temporal samples from existing benchmarks, and will release code and per-sample annotations upon publication.

item.title: 提出否定感知加权信息融合方法NAWIF，通过将类级可能性分布转换为否定感知的简单BPA并基于可靠性与不确定性进行折扣加权，从而更充分地表示模糊性并实现可靠的多源证据推理。
item.description:
面向可靠证据推理的否定感知加权信息融合

Negation-Aware Weighted Information Fusion for Reliable Evidential Reasoning

https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.00754

提出否定感知加权信息融合方法NAWIF，通过将类级可能性分布转换为否定感知的简单BPA并基于可靠性与不确定性进行折扣加权，从而更充分地表示模糊性并实现可靠的多源证据推理。

Dempster-Shafer理论（DST）为多源信息融合提供了一个极具吸引力的框架。然而，其有效性关键取决于如何为每个信息源构建基本概率分配（BPA）。现有方法通常依赖启发式映射，或将信念分配限制在单例假设和全集上，从而未能充分利用BPA的表达性信念结构来刻画模糊性。本文提出了否定感知加权信息融合方法（NAWIF）。首先，NAWIF将每个信息源的类级可能性分布转换为一组否定感知的简单BPA，这些BPA通过互补命题编码类排除信息，并在全集中保留残余不确定性。它们的组合在复合假设上产生闭式解的BPA，保留了未被该信息源排除的类之间的模糊性。该方法进一步基于各信息源的可靠性和不确定性执行特定于源的BPA折扣，抑制……（摘要原文在此处截断）

arXiv:2509.00754v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Dempster--Shafer theory (DST) provides an attractive framework for multi-source information fusion. However, its effectiveness critically depends on how a BPA is constructed for each source. Their combination produces a closed-form BPA over composite hypotheses, preserving ambiguity among the classes not excluded by the source.
